     Workbooks are stored in ERPNext through the durar_sheets Server Script;
     without it the block still works and keeps files on this device. */

  if (!host) return
  host.__durarSheetsDestroy?.()

  const METHOD = "durar_sheets"
  const VERSION = "1.0.0"

  /* ERP locale: date order, display format and currency (called at boot, after CFG exists). */
  function applyLocale() {
    const df = String(F.boot?.sysdefaults?.date_format || "dd-mm-yyyy").toLowerCase()
    CFG.dateFmt = df
    CFG.dateOrder = df.startsWith("mm") ? "MDY" : df.startsWith("yyyy") ? "YMD" : "DMY"
    CFG.curSym = F.boot?.sysdefaults?.currency || "SAR"
    CFG.lang = AR ? "ar" : "en"
  }

  /* ---------- small helpers ---------- */
  const esc = (s) => String(s ?? "").replace(/[&<>"']/g, (c) => ({ "&": "&", "<": "<", ">": ">", '"': """, "'": "'" })[c])
  const uid = () => (crypto.randomUUID ? crypto.randomUUID() : Date.now().toString(36) + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2)).replace(/-/g, "").slice(0, 20)
  const clamp = (v, a, b) => Math.max(a, Math.min(b, v))
  const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms))
  const isMac = /Mac|iPhone|iPad/.test(navigator.platform || navigator.userAgent)
  const MOD = isMac ? "⌘" : "Ctrl"
  const touchy = () => matchMedia("(pointer: coarse)").matches
  const debounce = (fn, ms) => {
    let id
    const d = (...a) => {
      clearTimeout(id)
      id = setTimeout(() => fn(...a), ms)
    }
    d.cancel = () => clearTimeout(id)
    d.flush = (...a) => {
      clearTimeout(id)
      fn(...a)
    }
    return d
  }
  /* h("div.cls#id", {attrs, on: {click}}, ...children) */
  function h(sel, attrs, ...kids) {
    const m = /^([a-z0-9-]+)?((?:\.[\w-]+)*)(#[\w-]+)?$/i.exec(sel)
    const el = document.createElement(m[1] || "div")
    if (m[2]) el.className = m[2].slice(1).replace(/\./g, " ")
    if (m[3]) el.id = m[3].slice(1)
    if (attrs && (typeof attrs !== "object" || attrs instanceof Node || Array.isArray(attrs))) {
      kids.unshift(attrs)
      attrs = null
    }
    if (attrs)
      for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(attrs)) {
        if (v == null || v === false) continue
        if (k === "on") for (const [ev, fn] of Object.entries(v)) el.addEventListener(ev, fn)
        else if (k === "style" && typeof v === "object") Object.assign(el.style, v)
        else if (k === "html") el.innerHTML = v
        else if (k === "text") el.textContent = v
        else if (k in el && typeof v !== "string") el[k] = v
        else el.setAttribute(k, v === true ? "" : v)
      }
    for (const k of kids.flat(Infinity)) if (k != null && k !== false) el.append(k instanceof Node ? k : String(k))
    return el
  }

      else col = head.indexOf(String(f ?? "").toLowerCase())

    }
    const ch = c.v[0].map((h) => String(h ?? "").toLowerCase())
    const tests = c.v.slice(1).map((row) =>
      row

        .filter(Boolean)
    )
    const out = []
    for (const row of d.v.slice(1)) {
      const okRow = !tests.length || tests.some((ts) => ts.every(([k, t]) => k >= 0 && t(row[k])))

        id ? this.styles.set(i, id) : this.styles.delete(i)

    toJSON(styleIndex) {
      const o = { d: this.def }

      if (this.hidden.size) o.h = [...this.hidden]
      if (this.fhidden.size) o.fh = [...this.fhidden]
      if (this.levels.size) o.l = [...this.levels]
      if (this.collapsed.size) o.c = [...this.collapsed]

    }
    static from(o, def, styles) {
      const a = new Axis(o?.d || def)
      if (!o) return a
      for (const [i, v] of o.s || []) a.sizes.set(i, v)
      for (const i of o.h || []) a.hidden.add(i)
      for (const i of o.fh || []) a.fhidden.add(i)
      for (const [i, v] of o.l || []) a.levels.set(i, v)
      for (const i of o.c || []) a.collapsed.add(i)
      for (const [i, s] of o.st || []) {
        const id = styleId(styles[s])
        if (id) a.styles.set(i, id)
      }
      return a
    }
  }

  /* ---------- a sheet ---------- */
  class Sheet {
    constructor(id, name) {
      this.id = id
      this.name = name
      this.cells = new Map()
      this.rows = new Axis(DEF_ROW_H)
      this.cols = new Axis(DEF_COL_W)
      this.merges = []
      this.mi = null
      this.freeze = { r: 0, c: 0 }
      this.color = null
      this.hidden = false
      this.grid = true
      this.heads = true
      this.cf = []
      this.dv = []
      this.tables = []
      this.filter = null
      this.charts = []
      this.pivots = []
      this.slicers = []
      this.comments = new Map()
      this.protect = null
      this.print = {}
      this.breaks = { rows: [], cols: [] }
      this.spills = new Map() // anchor ck -> { r2, c2 }
      this.spillOwner = new Map() // ck -> anchor ck
      this.blocked = new Map() // anchor ck -> { r2, c2 } wanted but blocked (#SPILL!)
      this.colVer = new Uint32Array(MAXC)
      this.maxR = -1
      this.maxC = -1
    }
    get(r, c) {
      return this.cells.get(ck(r, c))
    }
    hasContent(r, c) {
      const cell = this.cells.get(ck(r, c))
      return !!cell && (cell.f != null || (cell.v != null && cell.v !== ""))
    }
    grow(r, c) {
      if (r > this.maxR) this.maxR = r
      if (c > this.maxC) this.maxC = c
    }
    mergeAt(r, c) {
      if (!this.merges.length) return null
      if (!this.mi) {
        this.mi = new Map()
        for (const m of this.merges) for (let rr = m.r1; rr <= m.r2; rr++) for (let cc = m.c1; cc <= m.c2; cc++) this.mi.set(ck(rr, cc), m)

    styleIdAt(r, c) {

      let c1 = Infinity

        const r = ckR(k)
        const c = ckC(k)
        if (r > r2) r2 = r
        if (c > c2) c2 = c
        if (r < r1) r1 = r
        if (c < c1) c1 = c
      }
      for (const [k, s] of this.spills) {
        r2 = Math.max(r2, s.r2)
        c2 = Math.max(c2, s.c2)
        r1 = Math.min(r1, ckR(k))
        c1 = Math.min(c1, ckC(k))

      if (r2 < 0) return null
      return { r1, c1, r2, c2 }
    }
    recomputeExtent() {
      const u = this.usedRange(true)
      this.maxR = u ? u.r2 : -1
      this.maxC = u ? u.c2 : -1
    }
  }

  /* ---------- the workbook ---------- */
  class Workbook {
    constructor() {

    /* ---------- values for the evaluator ---------- */
    getValue(sid, r, c) {
      if (this.calc?.job && !this.calc.running && !this.staleOk) this.calc.finish()
      const sh = this.byId.get(sid)
      if (!sh) return ERR.REF
      const k = ck(r, c)
      const cell = sh.cells.get(k)
      if (cell) {

          if (this.calc.dirty.size && (this.calc.running || !this.calc.job) && this.calc.dirty.has(gk(sid, r, c))) this.calc.evalCell(gk(sid, r, c))

      let r2 = ref.r2
      let c2 = ref.c2
      if (ref.r1 === 0 && r2 === MAXR - 1) r2 = Math.max(0, Math.min(r2, sh.maxR))
      if (ref.c1 === 0 && c2 === MAXC - 1) c2 = Math.max(0, Math.min(c2, sh.maxC))
      const h = r2 - ref.r1 + 1
      const w = c2 - ref.c1 + 1
      if (h <= 0 || w <= 0) return new Mat([[null]])
      if (h * w > 25e6) return new Mat([[ERR.NUM]])
      const cacheable = h * w >= 32 && w <= 64
      const key = cacheable ? ref.sid + ":" + ref.r1 + ":" + ref.c1 + ":" + r2 + ":" + c2 : null

        let s = 0
        for (let c = ref.c1; c <= c2; c++) s += sh.colVer[c]

        for (let r = 0; r < h; r++) rows[r] = new Array(w).fill(null)
        for (const [k, cell] of sh.cells) {
          const r = ckR(k) - ref.r1
          const c = ckC(k) - ref.c1
          if (r < 0 || r >= h || c < 0 || c >= w) continue
          rows[r][c] = cell.v

      } else {

      const m = new Mat(rows)
      if (cacheable) {

    name(NAME, sid) {

    table(NAME) {

    }
    tableAt(sid, r, c) {
      const sh = this.byId.get(sid)

      for (const t of sh.tables) if (r >= t.r1 && r <= t.r2 && c >= t.c1 && c <= t.c2) return t

    /* A formula typed in the column just right or left of a table may use [@Col]. */

      for (const t of sh.tables) if (r > t.r1 && r <= t.r2 && (c === t.c2 + 1 || c === t.c1 - 1)) return t

    indexTables() {
      this.tableMap.clear()

          this.tableMap.set(t.name.toUpperCase(), t)
        }
    }
    cellFormula(sid, r, c) {
      const cell = this.byId.get(sid)?.cells.get(ck(r, c))
      return cell && cell.f != null ? cell.f : null
    }
    rowHidden(sid, r) {
      return !!this.byId.get(sid)?.rows.hidden.has(r)
    }
    rowFiltered(sid, r) {
      return !!this.byId.get(sid)?.rows.fhidden.has(r)
    }
    spillRect(sid, r, c) {
      return this.byId.get(sid)?.spills.get(ck(r, c)) || null
    }
    cellFormat(sid, r, c) {
      const nf = this.byId.get(sid)?.styleAt(r, c).nf || ""
      if (!nf) return "G"
      if (/%/.test(nf)) return "P" + ((nf.split(".")[1] || "").replace(/[^0]/g, "").length)
      if (/[dmy]/i.test(nf)) return "D1"
      return "F" + ((nf.split(".")[1] || "").replace(/[^0]/g, "").length)
    }
    colWidthChars(sid, c) {
      return Math.round((this.byId.get(sid)?.cols.raw(c) || DEF_COL_W) / 7.5)
    }

    /* ---------- serialization ---------- */
    toJSON() {
      return {
        v: 1,
        title: this.title,
        props: this.props,
        active: this.active,
        names: [...this.names.values()].map((n) => ({ name: n.name, ref: n.ref, scope: n.scope ?? null, comment: n.comment || "" })),
        scenarios: this.scenarios,
        scripts: this.scripts,

    static fromJSON(o, opts) {

    }
    load(o, opts = {}) {
      this.sheets = []
      this.byId.clear()
      this.byName.clear()
      this.names.clear()
      this.rcache.clear()
      this.title = o.title || ""
      this.props = { ...this.props, ...(o.props || {}) }
      this.active = o.active || 0
      this.scenarios = o.scenarios || []
      this.scripts = o.scripts || []
      this.queries = o.queries || []
      this.protect = o.protect || null
      this.styles = o.styles || []
      for (const n of o.names || []) this.setName(n)
      for (const s of o.sheets || []) sheetFromJSON(this, s)

      if (n.ref == null) this.names.delete(key)
      else this.names.set(key, { name: n.name, ref: n.ref, scope: n.scope ?? null, comment: n.comment || "" })

  }

  const encVal = (v) => (v instanceof XErr ? { e: v.code } : v)
  const decVal = (v) => (v && typeof v === "object" && v.e ? errFromCode(v.e) || new XErr(v.e) : v)
  /* Cell content as stored and sent in operations: style objects, never ids. */
  function cellContent(cell) {
    if (!cell) return null
    const o = {}
    if (cell.f != null) o.f = cell.f
    else if (cell.v != null) o.v = encVal(cell.v)
    if (cell.s) o.s = styleOf(cell.s)

    if (cell.rt) o.rt = cell.rt

  function sheetToJSON(sh) {
    const styleList = []

        styleMap.set(id, k)
      }
      return k
    }

    for (const [k, cell] of sh.cells) {
      const r = ckR(k)
      const c = ckC(k)
      const extra = {}
      if (cell.l) extra.l = cell.l
      if (cell.rt) extra.rt = cell.rt
      const row = [r, c, cell.f != null ? null : encVal(cell.v), cell.f != null ? cell.f : 0, sidx(cell.s)]

      name: sh.name,
      color: sh.color,
      hidden: sh.hidden,
      grid: sh.grid,
      heads: sh.heads,

      rows: sh.rows.toJSON(sidx),
      cols: sh.cols.toJSON(sidx),

      merges: sh.merges.map((m) => [m.r1, m.c1, m.r2, m.c2]),
      comments: [...sh.comments].map(([k, v]) => [ckR(k), ckC(k), v]),

      charts: sh.charts,
      pivots: sh.pivots,

    sh.heads = o.heads !== false

    for (const [r, c, v] of o.comments || []) sh.comments.set(ck(r, c), v)
    sh.cf = o.cf || []
    sh.dv = o.dv || []
    sh.tables = o.tables || []
    sh.filter = o.filter || null
    sh.charts = o.charts || []
    sh.pivots = o.pivots || []
    sh.slicers = o.slicers || []

  /* ======================================================================
     Recalculation. Each formula registers what it reads: single cells in a
     reverse index, ranges in column buckets. An edit marks its dependents
     dirty (breadth-first), then dirty formulas are evaluated in topological
     order (Kahn) without recursion, so 100k-row running totals are safe.
     Whatever is left over is a cycle: #REF! (circular), or iterated when
     iterative calculation is on. Dynamic arrays spill, and a spill that

  class Calc {
    constructor(wb) {

      if (!cell.ast) return

      collectDeps(cell.ast, this.wb, sh.id, r, c, info, new Set())
      for (const k of info.cells) Calc.addTo(this.cellDeps, k, g)
      for (const e of info.ranges) {
        e.f = g
        this.addRange(e)
      }
      for (const n of info.names) Calc.addTo(this.nameDeps, n, g)
      for (const t of info.tables) Calc.addTo(this.tableDeps, t, g)
      if (info.vol) this.volatile.add(g)

      const sid = gkSid(g)
      const m = this.rangeIdx.get(sid)
      if (m) {
        const r = gkR(g)
        const c = gkC(g)
        const s = m.b.get(c >> 5)
        if (s) for (const e of s) if (r >= e.r1 && r <= e.r2 && c >= e.c1 && c <= e.c2) out.add(e.f)
        for (const e of m.wide) if (r >= e.r1 && r <= e.r2 && c >= e.c1 && c <= e.c2) out.add(e.f)
      }
      return out
    }

    isFormula(g) {
      const cell = this.wb.byId.get(gkSid(g))?.cells.get(g % GKS)
      return !!cell && cell.f != null
    }
    /* Re-register every formula (after structural edits) and recalculate all. */
    rebuild(recalcAll = true) {
      if (this.job) {

      }
      this.cellDeps.clear()
      this.rangeIdx.clear()
      this.nameDeps.clear()
      this.tableDeps.clear()

      for (const sh of this.wb.sheets) {

        sh.blocked.clear()
        for (const [k, cell] of sh.cells) {
          if (cell.f == null) continue
          delete cell.a
          this.track(sh, ckR(k), ckC(k), cell)
          seeds.push(gk(sh.id, ckR(k), ckC(k)))
        }
      }
      if (recalcAll) this.async ? this.start(seeds, true) : this.run(seeds, true)
    }
    /* Mark changed cells; recalc now (automatic) or remember them (manual). */
    changed(keys) {
      if (this.wb.props.calc === "manual") {
        const now = []
        for (const g of keys) {
          this.pending.add(g)
          if (this.isFormula(g)) now.push(g)
        }
        if (now.length) this.run(now, false, true)
        return
      }
      if (this.async) this.start(keys)
      else this.run(keys)
    }
    recalcNow(all = false) {
      if (all) return this.rebuild(true)
      const seeds = [...this.pending]
      this.pending.clear()
      if (this.async) this.start(seeds, true)
      else this.run(seeds, true)
    }
    /* Synchronous: finishes any background job first, then calculates everything now. */
    run(seeds, force = false, only = false) {
      if (this.job) this.finish()
      const t0 = performance.now()
      const gen = this.runGen(seeds, force, only, false)
      let r
      do r = gen.next()
      while (!r.done)
      this.lastMs = performance.now() - t0
      return r.value
    }
    *runGen(seeds, force, only, sliced) {
      this.circular.clear()
      let round = 0
      let next = [...seeds]
      let total = 0
      while (next.length && round < 32) {
        this.spillChanged.clear()
        total += yield* this.pass(next, round === 0 || force, only, sliced)
        next = [...this.spillChanged]
        round++
      }
      this.lastCount = total
      return total
    }
    /* Background recalculation: 12 ms slices between frames, so the page keeps scrolling and
       taking input. A new change restarts the job with the cells it hadn't reached yet, as
       Excel does. Reading a value (Workbook.getValue) finishes the job first, unless the
       reader accepts stale values (the grid while drawing). Small recalculations finish inside
       the first slice, so they behave exactly like run(). */
    start(seeds, force = false, only = false) {
      if (this.job) {
        seeds = [...this.dirty, ...this.spillChanged, ...seeds]
        force = force || this.job.force
        this.abort()
      }
      this.job = { gen: this.runGen(seeds, force, only, true), force, t0: performance.now(), sliced: false, progress: null }
      this.step()
    }
    step() {
      const job = this.job
      if (!job) return
      clearTimeout(this.timer)
      const end = performance.now() + this.budget
      let r
      this.running = true
      try {
        do r = job.gen.next()
        while (!r.done && performance.now() < end)
      } finally {
        this.running = false
      }
      if (r.done) return this.done(job)
      job.sliced = true
      job.progress = r.value
      this.onProgress?.(r.value)
      this.timer = setTimeout(() => this.step(), 0)
    }
    finish() {
      const job = this.job
      if (!job) return
      clearTimeout(this.timer)
      let r
      this.running = true
      try {
        do r = job.gen.next()
        while (!r.done)
      } finally {
        this.running = false
      }
      this.done(job)
    }
    done(job) {
      this.job = null
      this.lastMs = performance.now() - job.t0
      if (job.sliced) this.onIdle?.()
    }
    abort() {
      clearTimeout(this.timer)
      if (this.job) this.job.gen.return()
      this.job = null
      this.dirty = new Set()
    }
    *pass(seeds, withVolatile, only, sliced) {
      const dirty = new Set()
      const edges = new Map()
      const indeg = new Map()
      const visit = []
      const seen = new Set()
      for (const g of seeds) {
        if (seen.has(g)) continue
        seen.add(g)
        visit.push(g)
        if (this.isFormula(g)) dirty.add(g)
        else this.unblockAt(g, dirty, visit, seen)
      }
      if (withVolatile && !only)
        for (const g of this.volatile)
          if (!seen.has(g)) {
            seen.add(g)
            dirty.add(g)
            visit.push(g)
          }
      if (!only)
        for (let i = 0; i < visit.length; i++) {
          const g = visit[i]
          const deps = this.dependents(g)
          if (!deps.size) continue
          const isF = dirty.has(g)
          for (const d of deps) {
            if (isF) {
              let arr = edges.get(g)
              if (!arr) edges.set(g, (arr = []))
              arr.push(d)
              indeg.set(d, (indeg.get(d) || 0) + 1)
            }
            if (!seen.has(d)) {
              seen.add(d)
              dirty.add(d)
              visit.push(d)
            }
          }
        }
      const count = dirty.size
      this.dirty = dirty
      const ready = []
      for (const g of dirty) if (!indeg.get(g)) ready.push(g)
      // only big passes pause; a pause leaves the evaluator idle (nothing mid-formula)
      const slice = sliced && count > 3000
      let n = 0
      while (ready.length) {
        if (slice && ++n % 64 === 0) yield { done: n, total: count }
        const g = ready.pop()
        if (this.dirty.has(g)) this.evalCell(g)
        const out = edges.get(g)
        if (out)
          for (const d of out) {
            const n = indeg.get(d) - 1
            indeg.set(d, n)
            if (n === 0) ready.push(d)
          }
      }
      if (this.dirty.size) this.cycles(edges, indeg, ready)
      this.dirty = new Set()
      return count
    }
    /* A cell written inside a blocked spill area may unblock it (or block a spill). */
    unblockAt(g, dirty, visit, seen) {
      const sh = this.wb.byId.get(gkSid(g))
      if (!sh) return
      const r = gkR(g)
      const c = gkC(g)
      const add = (a) => {
        const ag = gk(sh.id, ckR(a), ckC(a))
        if (!seen.has(ag)) {
          seen.add(ag)
          dirty.add(ag)
          visit.push(ag)
        }
      }
      const owner = sh.spillOwner.get(ck(r, c))
      if (owner !== undefined && owner !== ck(r, c)) add(owner)
      for (const [a, rect] of sh.blocked) if (r >= ckR(a) && r <= rect.r2 && c >= ckC(a) && c <= rect.c2) add(a)
    }
    cycles(edges, indeg, ready) {
      const remaining = [...this.dirty]
      const inSet = new Set(remaining)
      // Tarjan's SCC, iterative
      const index = new Map()
      const low = new Map()
      const onStack = new Set()
      const stack = []
      const sccs = []
      let idx = 0
      for (const start of remaining) {
        if (index.has(start)) continue
        const work = [[start, 0]]
        index.set(start, idx)
        low.set(start, idx++)
        stack.push(start)
        onStack.add(start)
        while (work.length) {
          const top = work[work.length - 1]
          const [v, i] = top
          const out = (edges.get(v) || []).filter((w) => inSet.has(w))
          if (i < out.length) {
            top[1]++
            const w = out[i]
            if (!index.has(w)) {
              index.set(w, idx)
              low.set(w, idx++)
              stack.push(w)
              onStack.add(w)
              work.push([w, 0])
            } else if (onStack.has(w)) low.set(v, Math.min(low.get(v), index.get(w)))
          } else {
            work.pop()
            if (work.length) {
              const p = work[work.length - 1][0]
              low.set(p, Math.min(low.get(p), low.get(v)))
            }
            if (low.get(v) === index.get(v)) {
              const comp = []
              let w
              do {
                w = stack.pop()
                onStack.delete(w)
                comp.push(w)
              } while (w !== v)
              sccs.push(comp)
            }
          }
        }
      }
      const iterate = this.wb.props.iter
      // Tarjan emits components in reverse topological order
      for (let k = sccs.length - 1; k >= 0; k--) {
        const comp = sccs[k]
        const self = comp.length === 1 && (edges.get(comp[0]) || []).includes(comp[0])
        if (comp.length > 1 || self) {
          if (iterate) this.iterateCycle(comp)
          else
            for (const g of comp) {
              this.dirty.delete(g)
              this.circular.add(g)
              const sh = this.wb.byId.get(gkSid(g))
              const cell = sh?.cells.get(g % GKS)
              if (cell) {
                this.clearSpill(sh, gkR(g), gkC(g), cell)
                cell.v = ERR.CIRC
                sh.colVer[gkC(g)]++
              }
            }
        } else if (this.dirty.has(comp[0])) this.evalCell(comp[0])
      }
      void ready
      void indeg
    }
    iterateCycle(comp) {
      const max = this.wb.props.iterMax || 100
      const eps = this.wb.props.iterDelta || 0.001
      for (const g of comp) {
        const cell = this.wb.byId.get(gkSid(g))?.cells.get(g % GKS)
        if (cell && !(typeof cell.v === "number")) cell.v = 0
      }
      for (let it = 0; it < max; it++) {
        let delta = 0
        for (const g of comp) {
          const cell = this.wb.byId.get(gkSid(g))?.cells.get(g % GKS)
          const before = cell?.v
          this.dirty.delete(g)
          this.evalCell(g, true)
          const after = cell?.v
          if (typeof before === "number" && typeof after === "number") delta = Math.max(delta, Math.abs(after - before))
          else if (before !== after) delta = Infinity
        }
        if (delta < eps) break
      }
    }
    evalCell(g, force) {
      this.dirty.delete(g)
      const sid = gkSid(g)
      const r = gkR(g)
      const c = gkC(g)
      const sh = this.wb.byId.get(sid)
      const cell = sh?.cells.get(ck(r, c))
      if (!cell || cell.f == null) return
      if (this.evaluating.has(g) && !force) {
        cell.v = ERR.CIRC
        this.circular.add(g)
        return
      }
      this.evaluating.add(g)
      if (cell.ast === undefined) {
        try {
          cell.ast = parseFormula(cell.f, r, c)
        } catch {
          cell.ast = null
        }
      }
      let v
      try {
        v = cell.ast ? this.settle(evalAst(cell.ast, this.wb, sid, r, c), sid, r, c) : ERR.NAME
      } catch (e) {
        console.error("Durar Sheets: formula failed", cell.f, e)
        v = ERR.VALUE
      }
      this.evaluating.delete(g)
      this.store(sh, r, c, cell, v)
    }
    settle(v, sid, r, c) {
      if (v instanceof Ref) {
        if (v.single) {
          const x = this.wb.getValue(v.sid, v.r1, v.c1)
          return x == null ? 0 : x
        }
        return this.wb.rangeMat(v)
      }
      if (v === MISSING || v == null) return 0
      if (v instanceof Lambda) return ERR.CALC
      if (v instanceof RefList) return ERR.VALUE
      if (typeof v === "number" && !isFinite(v)) return ERR.NUM
      void sid
      void r
      void c
      return v
    }
    clearSpill(sh, r, c, cell) {
      const a = ck(r, c)
      const rect = sh.spills.get(a)
      sh.blocked.delete(a)
      if (!rect) {
        delete cell.a
        return
      }
      for (let rr = r; rr <= rect.r2; rr++)
        for (let cc = c; cc <= rect.c2; cc++) {
          const k = ck(rr, cc)
          if (sh.spillOwner.get(k) === a) {
            sh.spillOwner.delete(k)
            if (k !== a) this.spillChanged.add(gk(sh.id, rr, cc))
          }
          sh.colVer[cc]++
        }
      sh.spills.delete(a)
      delete cell.a
    }
    store(sh, r, c, cell, v) {
      const a = ck(r, c)
      if (v instanceof Mat && (v.h > 1 || v.w > 1)) {
        const r2 = r + v.h - 1
        const c2 = c + v.w - 1
        let blocked = r2 >= MAXR || c2 >= MAXC
        if (!blocked)
          outer: for (let rr = r; rr <= r2; rr++)
            for (let cc = c; cc <= c2; cc++) {
              if (rr === r && cc === c) continue
              const k = ck(rr, cc)
              const other = sh.cells.get(k)
              if (other && (other.f != null || (other.v != null && other.v !== ""))) {
                blocked = true
                break outer
              }
              const own = sh.spillOwner.get(k)
              if (own !== undefined && own !== a) {
                blocked = true
                break outer
              }
              if (sh.merges.length && sh.mergeAt(rr, cc)) {
                blocked = true
                break outer
              }
            }
        const old = cell.a
        const oldRect = sh.spills.get(a)
        if (blocked) {
          this.clearSpill(sh, r, c, cell)
          sh.blocked.set(a, { r2: Math.min(r2, MAXR - 1), c2: Math.min(c2, MAXC - 1) })
          cell.v = ERR.SPILL
          sh.colVer[c]++
          return
        }
        const mat = v.map((x) => (x == null ? 0 : x instanceof Ref || x instanceof Mat ? ERR.VALUE : x))
        const same = old && oldRect && oldRect.r2 === r2 && oldRect.c2 === c2 && old.v.every((row, i) => row.every((x, j) => x === mat.v[i][j] || (x instanceof XErr && mat.v[i][j] instanceof XErr && x.code === mat.v[i][j].code)))
        if (!same) {
          if (oldRect) this.clearSpill(sh, r, c, cell)
          sh.blocked.delete(a)
          for (let rr = r; rr <= r2; rr++)
            for (let cc = c; cc <= c2; cc++) {
              sh.spillOwner.set(ck(rr, cc), a)
              if (rr !== r || cc !== c) this.spillChanged.add(gk(sh.id, rr, cc))
            }
          for (let cc = c; cc <= c2; cc++) sh.colVer[cc]++
          sh.spills.set(a, { r2, c2 })
          sh.grow(r2, c2)
        }
        cell.a = mat
        cell.v = mat.v[0][0]
        return
      }
      if (v instanceof Mat) v = v.v[0][0] ?? 0
      if (v instanceof Ref || v instanceof Mat) v = ERR.VALUE
      if (cell.a || sh.blocked.has(a)) this.clearSpill(sh, r, c, cell)
      if (cell.v !== v) sh.colVer[c]++
      cell.v = v
    }
  }

  /* Static dependencies of an AST at a cell. */
  function collectDeps(n, wb, sid, row, col, info, seen) {
    if (!n) return
    switch (n.k) {
      case "ref": {
        const s = n.sh == null ? sid : wb.sheetId(n.sh)
        if (s == null) return
        const r1 = n.ar1 ? n.r1 : row + n.r1
        const c1 = n.ac1 ? n.c1 : col + n.c1
        const r2 = n.ar2 ? n.r2 : row + n.r2
        const c2 = n.ac2 ? n.c2 : col + n.c2
        if (r1 === r2 && c1 === c2) info.cells.push(gk(s, r1, c1))
        else info.ranges.push({ sid: s, r1: Math.min(r1, r2), c1: Math.min(c1, c2), r2: Math.max(r1, r2), c2: Math.max(c1, c2) })
        return
      }
      case "name": {
        info.names.push(n.n)
        const s = n.sh != null ? wb.sheetId(n.sh) : sid
        const nm = wb.name(n.n, s)
        if (nm && !seen.has(nm)) {
          seen.add(nm)
          try {
            if (nm.ast === undefined) nm.ast = parseFormula(String(nm.ref).replace(/^=/, ""), 0, 0)
            collectDeps(nm.ast, wb, s ?? sid, 0, 0, info, seen)
          } catch {
            nm.ast = null
          }
        }
        const t = wb.table(n.n)
        if (t) {
          info.tables.push(n.n)
          info.ranges.push({ sid: t.sid, r1: t.r1, c1: t.c1, r2: t.r2, c2: t.c2 })
        }
        return
      }
      case "struct": {
        const t = n.table ? wb.table(n.table) : wb.tableAt(sid, row, col) || wb.tableBeside(sid, row, col)
        if (n.table) info.tables.push(n.table)
        if (t) {
          if (!n.table) info.tables.push(t.name.toUpperCase())
          info.ranges.push({ sid: t.sid, r1: t.r1, c1: t.c1, r2: t.r2, c2: t.c2 })
        }
        return
      }
      case "fn": {
        const d = FN[n.n]
        if (d?.volatile) info.vol = true
        if (!d) {
          info.names.push(n.n)
          const nm = wb.name(n.n, sid)
          if (nm && !seen.has(nm)) {
            seen.add(nm)
            try {
              if (nm.ast === undefined) nm.ast = parseFormula(String(nm.ref).replace(/^=/, ""), 0, 0)
              collectDeps(nm.ast, wb, sid, 0, 0, info, seen)
            } catch {
              nm.ast = null
            }
          }
        }
        for (const a of n.args) collectDeps(a, wb, sid, row, col, info, seen)
        return
      }
      case "call":
        collectDeps(n.f, wb, sid, row, col, info, seen)
        for (const a of n.args) collectDeps(a, wb, sid, row, col, info, seen)
        return
      case "bin":
        collectDeps(n.a, wb, sid, row, col, info, seen)
        collectDeps(n.b, wb, sid, row, col, info, seen)
        return
      case "un":
      case "pct":
      case "at":
      case "spill":
      case "paren":
        collectDeps(n.a, wb, sid, row, col, info, seen)
        if (n.k === "spill") info.vol = true
        return
      case "union":
        for (const it of n.items) collectDeps(it, wb, sid, row, col, info, seen)
        return
      default:
    }
  }

  /* ======================================================================
     Operations. Every change is a small deterministic op: applying the same
     ops to the same state gives the same workbook on every collaborator.
     apply() returns the exact inverse ops (undo). xform() rebases a local op
     over a remote structural one (insert/delete rows, renamed sheet ...).
     ====================================================================== */
  const ALL_ROWS = (r) => r[0] === 0 && r[2] === MAXR - 1
  const ALL_COLS = (r) => r[1] === 0 && r[3] === MAXC - 1
  const clone = (v) => (v == null ? v : JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(v)))

  /* Adjust [r1,c1,r2,c2] for insert/delete; null when removed entirely. */
  function adjRect(rect, axis, at, n) {
    const ref = { kind: "area", r1: rect[0], c1: rect[1], r2: rect[2], c2: rect[3] }
    if (axis === "r" && ALL_ROWS(rect)) return rect
    if (axis === "c" && ALL_COLS(rect)) return rect
    const r = adjustRefStruct(ref, axis, at, n)
    if (r === undefined) return rect
    if (r === null) return null
    return [r.r1, r.c1, r.r2, r.c2]
  }
  const adjIndex = (i, at, n) => (n > 0 ? (i >= at ? i + n : i) : i >= at - n ? i + n : i >= at ? null : i)

  /* Sheet-level structures that hold ranges, adjusted for insert/delete. */
  function adjustMetaValue(k, v, axis, at, n, sheetName) {
    if (v == null) return v
    const fx = (f) => (typeof f === "string" ? structFormula(f, sheetName, sheetName, axis, at, n) : f)
    switch (k) {
      case "cf":
      case "dv":
        return v
          .map((rule) => {
            const ranges = rule.ranges.map((r) => adjRect(r, axis, at, n)).filter(Boolean)
            if (!ranges.length) return null
            const o = { ...rule, ranges }
            for (const key of ["f1", "f2", "formula", "list"]) if (typeof o[key] === "string" && o[key][0] === "=") o[key] = "=" + fx(o[key].slice(1))
            return o
          })
          .filter(Boolean)
      case "tables":
        return v
          .map((t) => {
            const r = adjRect([t.r1, t.c1, t.r2, t.c2], axis, at, n)
            if (!r) return null
            const o = { ...t, r1: r[0], c1: r[1], r2: r[2], c2: r[3] }
            const w = o.c2 - o.c1 + 1
            if (o.columns.length !== w) {
              const cols = []
              for (let c = t.c1, k2 = 0; c <= t.c2; c++, k2++) {
                const nc = axis === "c" ? adjIndex(c, at, n) : c
                if (nc != null) cols.push(t.columns[k2])
              }
              while (cols.length < w) {
                let name = "Column" + (cols.length + 1)
                let s = 1
                while (cols.includes(name)) name = "Column" + (cols.length + 1) + "_" + s++
                cols.splice(axis === "c" && n > 0 ? at - t.c1 + cols.length - (w - n) : cols.length, 0, name)
              }
              o.columns = cols.slice(0, w)
            }
            return o
          })
          .filter(Boolean)
      case "filter": {
        const r = adjRect([v.r1, v.c1, v.r2, v.c2], axis, at, n)
        if (!r) return null
        const o = { ...v, r1: r[0], c1: r[1], r2: r[2], c2: r[3] }
        if (axis === "c" && v.cols) {
          o.cols = {}
          for (const [k2, crit] of Object.entries(v.cols)) {
            const nc = adjIndex(v.c1 + Number(k2), at, n)
            if (nc != null) o.cols[nc - o.c1] = crit
          }
        }
        return o
      }
      case "charts":
      case "slicers":
      case "pivots":
        return v.map((o) => {
          const out = { ...o }
          if (o.anchor) {
            const nr = axis === "r" ? adjIndex(o.anchor.r, at, n) : o.anchor.r
            const nc = axis === "c" ? adjIndex(o.anchor.c, at, n) : o.anchor.c
            out.anchor = { ...o.anchor, r: nr ?? at, c: nc ?? at }
          }
          if (typeof o.src === "string") out.src = fx(o.src)
          if (o.out) {
            const r = adjRect(o.out, axis, at, n)
            out.out = r || o.out
          }
          if (Array.isArray(o.series)) out.series = o.series.map((s) => ({ ...s, ref: typeof s.ref === "string" ? fx(s.ref) : s.ref, name: typeof s.name === "string" && s.name[0] === "=" ? "=" + fx(s.name.slice(1)) : s.name }))
          if (typeof o.cats === "string") out.cats = fx(o.cats)
          return out
        })
      case "print": {
        const o = { ...v }
        if (o.area) o.area = adjRect(o.area, axis, at, n)
        if (o.titleRows && axis === "r") o.titleRows = adjRect([o.titleRows[0], 0, o.titleRows[1], 0], "r", at, n)?.filter((_, i) => i === 0 || i === 2) || null
        if (o.titleCols && axis === "c") o.titleCols = adjRect([0, o.titleCols[0], 0, o.titleCols[1]], "c", at, n)?.filter((_, i) => i === 1 || i === 3) || null
        return o
      }
      case "breaks":
        return { rows: axis === "r" ? v.rows.map((i) => adjIndex(i, at, n)).filter((i) => i != null) : v.rows, cols: axis === "c" ? v.cols.map((i) => adjIndex(i, at, n)).filter((i) => i != null) : v.cols }
      case "merges":

        if (br && (!m || col.i === m.c2)) strokeBorder(br, x2 - 1, y1 - 1, x2 - 1, y2)
        if (st.dd) strokeBorder(parseBorder(st.dd), x1, y1, x2, y2)
        if (st.du) strokeBorder(parseBorder(st.du), x1, y2, x2, y1)
      }
    // indicators: comments, invalid circles, filter buttons
    for (const row of rows)
      for (const col of cols) {
        const k = ck(row.i, col.i)
        if (sh.comments.size && sh.comments.has(k)) {
          const cm = sh.comments.get(k)
          const m = inMerge(row.i, col.i)
          const x2 = m ? p.mx(m.c2 + 1) : col.p + col.s
          ctx.fillStyle = cm.resolved ? "#9ca3af" : cm.note ? "#d32f2f" : "#7c3aed"
          ctx.beginPath()
          ctx.moveTo(x2 - 7, row.p)
          ctx.lineTo(x2 - 1, row.p)
          ctx.lineTo(x2 - 1, row.p + 6)
          ctx.fill()
        }
        if (invalidCircles && invalidCircles.has(k)) {
          ctx.strokeStyle = "#e00000"
          ctx.lineWidth = 1.5
          ctx.beginPath()
          ctx.ellipse(col.p + col.s / 2, row.p + row.s / 2, col.s / 2 + 2, row.s / 2 + 1, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2)

        }
      }
    drawFilterButtons(p)
    ctx.restore()
  }

  function drawBar(bar, x, y, w, h) {
    const { lo, hi, v } = bar
    const span = hi - lo || 1
    const pad = 2
    const inner = w - pad * 2
    const zeroPos = lo < 0 ? ((0 - lo) / span) * inner : 0
    const end = ((clamp(v, lo, hi) - lo) / span) * inner
    const a = Math.min(zeroPos, end)
    const b = Math.max(zeroPos, end)
    const color = v < 0 ? bar.neg : bar.color
    const bx = x + pad + a
    const bw = Math.max(1, b - a)
    if (bar.gradient) {
      const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(bx, 0, bx + bw, 0)
      g.addColorStop(v < 0 ? 1 : 0, color)
      g.addColorStop(v < 0 ? 0 : 1, tint(color, 0.85))
      ctx.fillStyle = g
    } else ctx.fillStyle = color
    ctx.fillRect(bx, y + 3, bw, h - 7)
    ctx.strokeStyle = color
    ctx.lineWidth = 1
    ctx.strokeRect(bx + 0.5, y + 3.5, bw - 1, h - 8)
    if (lo < 0) {
      ctx.fillStyle = "#555"
      ctx.fillRect(x + pad + zeroPos, y + 2, 1, h - 5)
    }
  }

  function drawIcon(name, x, y, s) {
    const cx = x + s / 2
    const cy = y + s / 2
    const R = s / 2 - 1
    const col = { green: "#1e9e4a", yellow: "#f1b400", red: "#d62828", grey: "#8c8c8c" }
    ctx.save()
    ctx.lineWidth = 1.5
    const arrow = (angle, color) => {
      ctx.translate(cx, cy)
      ctx.rotate(angle)
      ctx.fillStyle = color
      ctx.beginPath()
      ctx.moveTo(0, -R)
      ctx.lineTo(R * 0.8, 0)
      ctx.lineTo(R * 0.3, 0)
      ctx.lineTo(R * 0.3, R)
      ctx.lineTo(-R * 0.3, R)
      ctx.lineTo(-R * 0.3, 0)
      ctx.lineTo(-R * 0.8, 0)
      ctx.closePath()
      ctx.fill()
    }
    const circle = (color) => {
      ctx.fillStyle = color
      ctx.beginPath()
      ctx.arc(cx, cy, R * 0.85, 0, Math.PI * 2)
      ctx.fill()
    }
    switch (name) {
      case "up":
        arrow(0, col.green)
        break
      case "upright":
        arrow(Math.PI / 4, "#8bc34a")
        break
      case "side":
        arrow(Math.PI / 2, col.yellow)
        break
      case "downright":
        arrow((3 * Math.PI) / 4, "#ff9800")
        break
      case "down":
        arrow(Math.PI, col.red)
        break
      case "tri-up":
      case "tri-down":
        ctx.fillStyle = name === "tri-up" ? col.green : col.red
        ctx.beginPath()
        if (name === "tri-up") {
          ctx.moveTo(cx, cy - R * 0.6)
          ctx.lineTo(cx + R * 0.7, cy + R * 0.5)
          ctx.lineTo(cx - R * 0.7, cy + R * 0.5)
        } else {
          ctx.moveTo(cx, cy + R * 0.6)
          ctx.lineTo(cx + R * 0.7, cy - R * 0.5)
          ctx.lineTo(cx - R * 0.7, cy - R * 0.5)
        }
        ctx.fill()
        break
      case "dash":
        ctx.fillStyle = col.yellow
        ctx.fillRect(cx - R * 0.7, cy - 1.5, R * 1.4, 3)
        break
      case "green":
      case "yellow":
      case "red":
      case "green-circle":
        circle(col[name.replace("-circle", "")])
        break
      case "yellow-tri":
        ctx.fillStyle = col.yellow
        ctx.beginPath()
        ctx.moveTo(cx, cy - R)
        ctx.lineTo(cx + R, cy + R * 0.8)
        ctx.lineTo(cx - R, cy + R * 0.8)
        ctx.fill()
        break
      case "red-diamond":
        ctx.fillStyle = col.red
        ctx.beginPath()
        ctx.moveTo(cx, cy - R)
        ctx.lineTo(cx + R, cy)
        ctx.lineTo(cx, cy + R)
        ctx.lineTo(cx - R, cy)
        ctx.fill()
        break
      case "check":
      case "warn":
      case "cross":
        circle(name === "check" ? col.green : name === "warn" ? col.yellow : col.red)
        ctx.strokeStyle = "#fff"
        ctx.lineWidth = 1.6
        ctx.beginPath()
        if (name === "check") {
          ctx.moveTo(cx - R * 0.45, cy)
          ctx.lineTo(cx - R * 0.1, cy + R * 0.35)
          ctx.lineTo(cx + R * 0.5, cy - R * 0.35)
        } else if (name === "warn") {
          ctx.moveTo(cx, cy - R * 0.5)
          ctx.lineTo(cx, cy + R * 0.1)
          ctx.moveTo(cx, cy + R * 0.35)
          ctx.lineTo(cx, cy + R * 0.45)
        } else {
          ctx.moveTo(cx - R * 0.4, cy - R * 0.4)
          ctx.lineTo(cx + R * 0.4, cy + R * 0.4)
          ctx.moveTo(cx + R * 0.4, cy - R * 0.4)
          ctx.lineTo(cx - R * 0.4, cy + R * 0.4)
        }
        ctx.stroke()
        break
      case "flag-green":
      case "flag-yellow":
      case "flag-red":
        ctx.fillStyle = col[name.slice(5)]
        ctx.fillRect(x + 3, y + 2, 1.5, s - 3)
        ctx.beginPath()
        ctx.moveTo(x + 4.5, y + 2)
        ctx.lineTo(x + s - 2, y + s * 0.35)
        ctx.lineTo(x + 4.5, y + s * 0.65)
        ctx.fill()
        break
      case "star-full":
      case "star-half":
      case "star-empty": {
        const pts = []
        for (let k = 0; k < 10; k++) {
          const rr = k % 2 ? R * 0.45 : R
          const ang = -Math.PI / 2 + (k * Math.PI) / 5
          pts.push([cx + rr * Math.cos(ang), cy + rr * Math.sin(ang)])
        }
        ctx.beginPath()
        pts.forEach(([px, py], k) => (k ? ctx.lineTo(px, py) : ctx.moveTo(px, py)))
        ctx.closePath()
        ctx.strokeStyle = "#f1b400"
        ctx.stroke()
        if (name !== "star-empty") {
          ctx.save()
          if (name === "star-half") {
            ctx.beginPath()
            ctx.rect(x, y, s / 2, s)
            ctx.clip()
            ctx.beginPath()
            pts.forEach(([px, py], k) => (k ? ctx.lineTo(px, py) : ctx.moveTo(px, py)))
            ctx.closePath()
          }
          ctx.fillStyle = "#f1b400"
          ctx.fill()
          ctx.restore()
        }
        break
      }
      default: {
        if (/^bars\d$/.test(name)) {
          const n = +name.slice(4)
          for (let k = 0; k < 4; k++) {
            ctx.fillStyle = k < n ? "#2563eb" : "#cbd5e1"
            const bh = ((k + 1) / 4) * (s - 3)
            ctx.fillRect(x + 2 + k * (s / 4.5), y + s - 1.5 - bh, s / 6, bh)
          }
        } else if (/^q\d$/.test(name)) {
          const n = +name.slice(1)
          ctx.strokeStyle = "#555"
          ctx.beginPath()
          ctx.arc(cx, cy, R * 0.85, 0, Math.PI * 2)
          ctx.stroke()
          if (n) {
            ctx.fillStyle = "#555"
            ctx.beginPath()
            ctx.moveTo(cx, cy)
            ctx.arc(cx, cy, R * 0.85, -Math.PI / 2, -Math.PI / 2 + (n / 4) * Math.PI * 2)
            ctx.fill()
          }
        }
      }
    }
    ctx.restore()
  }

  function drawCellText(l, r, c, x, y, w, h, overflow, colInfo, look) {
    const st = l.st
    const icon = l.cf?.icon
    if (l.cell?.rt && !showFormulas) return drawRich(l, x, y, w, h)
    const { text, align, color } = cellText(l, w)
    if (!text && !icon) return
    const font = fontOf(st)
    ctx.font = font
    const fsPx = (st.fs || 11) * PT
    const ind = (st.ind || 0) * 9
    const isLink = !!l.cell?.l || (l.cell?.f && /^\s*HYPERLINK\s*\(/i.test(l.cell.f))
    ctx.fillStyle = color || st.fc || (isLink ? pal.link : pal.text)

    let right = x + w - 4
    if (icon) {
      drawIcon(icon, x + 2, y + (h - 16) / 2, 16)
      left += 18
    }
    if (!text) return
    const va = st.va || "bottom"
    if (st.rot) return drawRotated(text, st, font, fsPx, x, y, w, h)
    if (st.wr) {
      const lines = wrapLines(font, text, Math.max(4, w - 7 - ind))
      const lh = fsPx * 1.22
      const total = lines.length * lh
      let ty = va === "top" ? y + 2 + fsPx : va === "middle" ? y + (h - total) / 2 + fsPx * 0.95 : y + h - 4 - total + lh - fsPx * 0.15
      ctx.save()
      ctx.beginPath()
      ctx.rect(x, y, w - 1, h - 1)
      ctx.clip()
      if (isRtlText(text)) ctx.direction = "rtl"
      for (const line of lines) {
        const lw = measure(font, line)
        const lx = align === "center" ? x + (w - lw) / 2 : align === "right" ? right - lw - ind : left + ind
        ctx.fillText(line, lx, ty)
        decorate(st, lx, ty, lw, fsPx)
        ty += lh
      }
      ctx.restore()
      return
    }
    let drawFont = font
    let tw = measure(font, text)
    if (st.sh && tw > w - 7) {
      const k = (w - 7) / tw
      drawFont = fontOf({ ...st, fs: (st.fs || 11) * k })
      ctx.font = drawFont
      tw = measure(drawFont, text)
    }
    let clipL = x
    let clipR = x + w - 1
    // overflow into empty neighbours (text only, not numbers)
    const canOverflow = overflow && typeof l.v === "string" && !st.sh && align !== "fill" && align !== "justify"
    if (canOverflow && tw > w - 7) {
      const empty = (cc) => {
        if (cc < 0 || cc >= MAXC) return false
        if (sh.mergeAt(r, cc)) return false
        const v = wb.getValue(sh.id, r, cc)
        return v == null || v === ""
      }
      if (align === "left" || align === "center") {
        let cc = c + 1
        let need = tw - (w - 7)
        if (align === "center") need /= 2
        while (need > 0 && empty(cc) && cc < c + 60) {
          const ci = colInfo(cc)
          clipR = ci.p + ci.s - 1
          need -= ci.s
          cc++
        }
      }
      if (align === "right" || align === "center") {
        let cc = c - 1
        let need = tw - (w - 7)
        if (align === "center") need /= 2
        while (need > 0 && empty(cc) && cc > c - 60) {
          const ci = colInfo(cc)
          clipL = ci.p
          need -= ci.s
          cc--
        }
      }
    }
    void look
    let tx = align === "center" ? x + (w - tw) / 2 : align === "right" ? right - tw - ind : left + ind
    const ty = va === "top" ? y + 3 + fsPx * 0.85 : va === "middle" ? y + h / 2 + fsPx * 0.33 : y + h - 5
    ctx.save()
    ctx.beginPath()
    ctx.rect(clipL, y, clipR - clipL, h)
    ctx.clip()
    // bidi order follows the text ("Context" reading order); "left" alignment keeps tx a left edge
    if (isRtlText(text)) ctx.direction = "rtl"
    if (align === "fill" && tw > 0) {
      let s = text
      while (measure(drawFont, s + text) < w - 6) s += text
      ctx.fillText(s, left, ty)
    } else {
      ctx.fillText(text, tx, ty)
      decorate(st, tx, ty, tw, fsPx, isLink)

    ctx.restore()
  }
  function decorate(st, x, y, w, fsPx, link) {
    if (st.u || link) {
      ctx.fillRect(x, y + Math.max(1, fsPx * 0.12), w, Math.max(1, fsPx / 14))
      if (st.u === 2) ctx.fillRect(x, y + Math.max(3, fsPx * 0.24), w, Math.max(1, fsPx / 14))
    }
    if (st.st) ctx.fillRect(x, y - fsPx * 0.3, w, Math.max(1, fsPx / 14))
  }
  function drawRotated(text, st, font, fsPx, x, y, w, h) {
    ctx.save()
    ctx.beginPath()
    ctx.rect(x, y, w - 1, h - 1)
    ctx.clip()
    if (st.rot === 255) {
      // stacked vertically
      const chars = [...text]
      let ty = y + 2 + fsPx
      for (const ch of chars) {
        ctx.fillText(ch, x + (w - measure(font, ch)) / 2, ty)
        ty += fsPx * 1.1
      }
    } else {
      const a = (-st.rot * Math.PI) / 180
      ctx.translate(x + w / 2, y + h / 2)
      ctx.rotate(a)
      const tw = measure(font, text)
      ctx.fillText(text, -tw / 2, fsPx * 0.33)
    }
    ctx.restore()
  }
  /* Rich text: runs of differently formatted text in one cell. */
  function drawRich(l, x, y, w, h) {
    const base = l.st
    const runs = l.cell.rt
    ctx.save()
    ctx.beginPath()
    ctx.rect(x, y, w - 1, h - 1)
    ctx.clip()
    const tokens = []
    for (const run of runs) {
      const st = { ...base, ...(run.s || {}) }
      for (const piece of String(run.t).split(/(\n|\s+)/)) if (piece) tokens.push({ t: piece, st, font: fontOf(st) })
    }
    const maxW = w - 7
    const lines = [[]]
    let lw = 0
    for (const tk of tokens) {
      if (tk.t === "\n") {
        lines.push([])
        lw = 0
        continue
      }
      const tw = measure(tk.font, tk.t)
      if (base.wr && lw + tw > maxW && lines[lines.length - 1].length && !/^\s+$/.test(tk.t)) {
        lines.push([])
        lw = 0
      }
      lines[lines.length - 1].push({ ...tk, w: tw })
      lw += tw
    }
    const fsPx = Math.max(...tokens.map((tk) => (tk.st.fs || 11) * PT), (base.fs || 11) * PT)
    const lh = fsPx * 1.22
    const total = lines.length * lh
    const va = base.va || "bottom"
    let ty = va === "top" ? y + 2 + fsPx : va === "middle" ? y + (h - total) / 2 + fsPx * 0.95 : y + h - 4 - total + lh - fsPx * 0.15
    for (const line of lines) {
      const width = line.reduce((s, tk) => s + tk.w, 0)
      let tx = base.ha === "center" ? x + (w - width) / 2 : base.ha === "right" ? x + w - 4 - width : x + 3
      for (const tk of line) {
        ctx.font = tk.font
        ctx.fillStyle = tk.st.fc || pal.text
        ctx.fillText(tk.t, tx, ty)
        decorate(tk.st, tx, ty, tk.w, (tk.st.fs || 11) * PT)
        tx += tk.w
      }
      ty += lh
    }
    ctx.restore()
  }

  function filterHeaderRow() {
    const out = []
    if (sh.filter) out.push({ r: sh.filter.r1, c1: sh.filter.c1, c2: sh.filter.c2, cols: sh.filter.cols || {}, table: null })
    for (const t2 of sh.tables) if (t2.header && t2.filter !== false) out.push({ r: t2.r1, c1: t2.c1, c2: t2.c2, cols: t2.fcols || {}, table: t2 })
    return out
  }
  function drawFilterButtons(p) {
    for (const f of filterHeaderRow()) {
      const row = p.rows.find((x) => x.i === f.r)
      if (!row) continue
      for (const col of p.cols) {
        if (col.i < f.c1 || col.i > f.c2) continue
        const s = Math.min(17, row.s - 4)
        const bx = col.p + col.s - s - 3
        const by = row.p + (row.s - s) / 2
        const active = f.cols[col.i - f.c1] || (f.sort && f.sort.c === col.i)
        ctx.fillStyle = active ? pal.accentSoft : pal.btn
        ctx.strokeStyle = pal.btnLine
        ctx.lineWidth = 1
        ctx.fillRect(bx, by, s, s)
        ctx.strokeRect(bx + 0.5, by + 0.5, s - 1, s - 1)
        ctx.fillStyle = active ? pal.accent : pal.sub
        ctx.beginPath()
        if (active && f.cols[col.i - f.c1]) {
          ctx.moveTo(bx + 4, by + 5)
          ctx.lineTo(bx + s - 4, by + 5)
          ctx.lineTo(bx + s / 2 + 1, by + s / 2 + 1)
          ctx.lineTo(bx + s / 2 + 1, by + s - 4)
          ctx.lineTo(bx + s / 2 - 1, by + s - 5)
          ctx.lineTo(bx + s / 2 - 1, by + s / 2 + 1)
        } else {
          ctx.moveTo(bx + 4.5, by + s / 2 - 2)
          ctx.lineTo(bx + s - 4.5, by + s / 2 - 2)
          ctx.lineTo(bx + s / 2, by + s / 2 + 2.5)
        }
        ctx.closePath()
        ctx.fill()
      }
    }
  }

  /* ---------- headers and outline ---------- */
  function selectedAxis(axis) {
    const set = []
    for (const g of sel.ranges) set.push(axis === "c" ? [g.c1, g.c2, g.r1 === 0 && g.r2 === MAXR - 1] : [g.r1, g.r2, g.c1 === 0 && g.c2 === MAXC - 1])
    return set
  }
  function drawHeaders(P) {
    if (!G.HH && !G.HW) return
    const hFont = `${12}px "Segoe UI", system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif`
    ctx.font = hFont
    ctx.textBaseline = "alphabetic"
    const csel = selectedAxis("c")
    const rsel = selectedAxis("r")
    const inSel = (list, i) => list.find(([a, b]) => i >= a && i <= b)
    // column headers
    const drawCols = (cols, clipX, clipW) => {
      ctx.save()
      ctx.beginPath()
      ctx.rect(clipX, G.gutH, clipW, G.HH)
      ctx.clip()
      ctx.fillStyle = pal.head
      ctx.fillRect(clipX, G.gutH, clipW, G.HH)
      for (const col of cols) {
        const s = inSel(csel, col.i)
        if (s) {
          ctx.fillStyle = s[2] ? pal.headSelFull : pal.headSel
          ctx.fillRect(col.p, G.gutH, col.s, G.HH)
          ctx.fillStyle = pal.accent
          ctx.fillRect(col.p, G.gutH + G.HH - 2, col.s, 2)
        }
        ctx.fillStyle = pal.headLine
        ctx.fillRect(col.p + col.s - 1, G.gutH + 3, 1, G.HH - 3)
        if (sh.cols.hidden.has(col.i + 1)) {
          ctx.fillStyle = pal.accent
          ctx.fillRect(col.p + col.s - 2.5, G.gutH, 3, G.HH)
        }
        ctx.fillStyle = s && s[2] ? pal.headSelFg : s ? pal.accentText : pal.headFg
        const label = wb.props.r1c1 ? String(col.i + 1) : colName(col.i)
        const lw = measure(hFont, label)
        if (lw < col.s - 2) ctx.fillText(label, col.p + (col.s - lw) / 2, G.gutH + G.HH / 2 + 4.5)
      }
      ctx.restore()
    }
    const drawRows = (rows, clipY, clipH) => {
      ctx.save()
      ctx.beginPath()
      ctx.rect(G.gutW, clipY, G.HW, clipH)
      ctx.clip()
      ctx.fillStyle = pal.head
      ctx.fillRect(G.gutW, clipY, G.HW, clipH)
      for (const row of rows) {
        const s = inSel(rsel, row.i)
        if (s) {
          ctx.fillStyle = s[2] ? pal.headSelFull : pal.headSel
          ctx.fillRect(G.gutW, row.p, G.HW, row.s)
          ctx.fillStyle = pal.accent
          ctx.fillRect(G.gutW + G.HW - 2, row.p, 2, row.s)
        }
        ctx.fillStyle = pal.headLine
        ctx.fillRect(G.gutW + 3, row.p + row.s - 1, G.HW - 3, 1)
        if (sh.rows.hidden.has(row.i + 1) || sh.rows.fhidden.has(row.i + 1)) {
          ctx.fillStyle = sh.rows.fhidden.has(row.i + 1) ? pal.link : pal.accent
          ctx.fillRect(G.gutW, row.p + row.s - 2.5, G.HW, 3)
        }
        ctx.fillStyle = s && s[2] ? pal.headSelFg : s ? pal.accentText : sh.rows.fhidden.size && sh.filter ? pal.link : pal.headFg
        const label = String(row.i + 1)
        const lw = measure(hFont, label)
        if (row.s > 9) ctx.fillText(label, G.gutW + (G.HW - lw) / 2, row.p + row.s / 2 + 4.5)
      }
      ctx.restore()
    }
    if (G.HH) {
      drawCols(P.colsS, G.left0 + G.FW, G.vw - G.left0 - G.FW)
      if (G.FW) drawCols(P.colsF, G.left0, G.FW)
      ctx.fillStyle = pal.headLine
      ctx.fillRect(G.gutW, G.gutH + G.HH - 1, G.vw, 1)
    }
    if (G.HW) {
      drawRows(P.rowsS, G.top0 + G.FH, G.vh - G.top0 - G.FH)
      if (G.FH) drawRows(P.rowsF, G.top0, G.FH)
      ctx.fillStyle = pal.headLine
      ctx.fillRect(G.gutW + G.HW - 1, G.gutH, 1, G.vh)
    }
    // corner (select all)
    if (G.HH && G.HW) {
      ctx.fillStyle = pal.head
      ctx.fillRect(G.gutW, G.gutH, G.HW - 1, G.HH - 1)
      ctx.fillStyle = pal.headLine
      ctx.beginPath()
      ctx.moveTo(G.gutW + G.HW - 5, G.gutH + 6)
      ctx.lineTo(G.gutW + G.HW - 5, G.gutH + G.HH - 5)
      ctx.lineTo(G.gutW + G.HW - 5 - (G.HH - 11), G.gutH + G.HH - 5)
      ctx.fill()
    }
  }
  /* Outline (group) bars with +/- buttons and level buttons. */

  /* Arrow keys in Enter/Point mode move the reference being pointed at. */
  function arrowPoint(dr, dc, extend) {
    const p = edit.point
    let g = p ? p.g : { r1: edit.r, c1: edit.c, r2: edit.r, c2: edit.c }
    if (!p && sh.id !== edit.sid) g = { r1: sel.r, c1: sel.c, r2: sel.r, c2: sel.c }
    if (extend) {
      const anchor = p?.anchor || { r: g.r1, c: g.c1 }
      const cur = p?.cur || { r: g.r2, c: g.c2 }
      cur.r = clamp(cur.r + dr, 0, MAXR - 1)
      cur.c = clamp(cur.c + dc, 0, MAXC - 1)
      g = { r1: Math.min(anchor.r, cur.r), c1: Math.min(anchor.c, cur.c), r2: Math.max(anchor.r, cur.r), c2: Math.max(anchor.c, cur.c) }
      insertRef(g)
      edit.point.anchor = anchor
      edit.point.cur = cur
    } else {
      const r = clamp(g.r1 + dr, 0, MAXR - 1)
      const c = clamp(g.c1 + dc, 0, MAXC - 1)
      insertRef({ r1: r, c1: c, r2: r, c2: c })
    }
    scrollToCell(edit.point.g.r2, edit.point.g.c2)
  }
  /* F4: cycle A1 → $A$1 → A$1 → $A1 on the reference at the caret. */
  function toggleAbsolute() {
    const el = inputEl()
    const text = el.value
    if (!isFormulaText(text)) return
    const pos = el.selectionStart
    const toks = tokenize(text.slice(1))
    for (const tk of toks) {
      const a = tk.p + 1
      const b = a + tk.s.length
      if (tk.t !== "ref" || tk.err || pos < a || pos > b) continue
      const cycle = (ar, ac) => (ar && ac ? [true, false] : ar && !ac ? [false, true] : !ar && ac ? [false, false] : [true, true])
      const [nr, nc] = cycle(tk.ar1, tk.ac1)
      const r = { sheet: tk.sheet, sheetText: tk.sheetText, kind: tk.kind, r1: tk.r1, c1: tk.c1, r2: tk.r2, c2: tk.c2, ar1: nr, ac1: nc, ar2: nr, ac2: nc, keepSheetText: true }
      const out = refToText(r)
      el.value = text.slice(0, a) + out + text.slice(b)
      const caret = a + out.length
      el.setSelectionRange(caret, caret)
      edit.point = null
      syncHighlight()
      return
    }
  }

  /* ---------- autocomplete and argument hints ---------- */
  let auto = null
  const POPULAR_FNS = ["SUM", "AVERAGE", "COUNT", "COUNTA", "IF", "IFERROR", "VLOOKUP", "XLOOKUP", "INDEX", "MATCH", "SUMIF", "SUMIFS", "COUNTIF", "COUNTIFS", "MAX", "MIN", "ROUND", "TODAY", "TEXT", "CONCAT", "LEFT", "RIGHT", "MID", "LEN", "TRIM", "DATE", "AND", "OR", "FILTER", "SORT", "UNIQUE"]
  function currentToken() {
    const el = inputEl()
    const text = el.value
    if (!isFormulaText(text)) return null
    const pos = el.selectionStart
    if (pos !== el.selectionEnd) return null
    const before = text.slice(0, pos)
    const m = /([A-Za-z_\\][\w.]*)$/.exec(before)
    if (!m) return null
    const pre = before.slice(0, before.length - m[1].length)
    if (!/[=(,+\-*/^&<>:;{\s]$/.test(pre)) return null
    // inside a string?
    if ((before.match(/"/g) || []).length % 2) return null
    return { word: m[1], start: pos - m[1].length, end: pos }
  }
  function updateAuto() {
    const tk = currentToken()
    if (!tk || tk.word.length < 1) return hideAuto()
    const q = tk.word.toUpperCase()
    const items = []
    for (const name of FN_NAMES()) if (name.startsWith(q)) items.push({ name, kind: "fn", desc: fnHelp(name)?.desc || "" })
    for (const n of wb.names.values()) if (n.name.toUpperCase().startsWith(q)) items.push({ name: n.name, kind: "name", desc: String(n.ref) })
    for (const tb of wb.tableMap.values()) if (tb.name.toUpperCase().startsWith(q)) items.push({ name: tb.name, kind: "table", desc: t("Table", "جدول") })
    if (!items.length || (items.length === 1 && items[0].name.toUpperCase() === q && items[0].kind !== "fn")) return hideAuto()
    // exact matches, then everyday functions, then alphabetical
    const rank = (it) => (it.name.toUpperCase() === q ? 0 : POPULAR_FNS.includes(it.name) ? 1 + POPULAR_FNS.indexOf(it.name) / 100 : 2)
    items.sort((a, b) => rank(a) - rank(b) || a.name.localeCompare(b.name))
    auto = { tk, items: items.slice(0, 40), i: 0 }
    renderAuto()
  }
  function renderAuto() {
    if (!auto) return
    ui.auto.innerHTML = auto.items
      .map((it, i) => `<li role="option" class="${i === auto.i ? "on" : ""}" data-i="${i}"><b>${esc(it.name)}</b><span>${esc(it.kind === "fn" ? it.desc : it.kind === "name" ? it.desc : it.desc)}</span></li>`)
      .join("")
    ui.auto.hidden = false
    ui.auto.querySelector(".on")?.scrollIntoView({ block: "nearest" })
    positionAuto()
  }
  function positionAuto() {
    if (!auto || ui.auto.hidden) return
    const box = (edit.from === "bar" ? ui.fxWrap : ui.editWrap).getBoundingClientRect()
    const rootBox = ui.root.getBoundingClientRect()
    const below = box.bottom - rootBox.top + 2
    ui.auto.style.left = Math.min(box.left - rootBox.left, rootBox.width - 300) + "px"
    ui.auto.style.top = (below + 230 > rootBox.height ? box.top - rootBox.top - 232 : below) + "px"
  }
  function hideAuto() {
    auto = null
    if (ui.auto) ui.auto.hidden = true
  }
  function acceptAuto(i = auto?.i) {
    if (!auto) return false
    const it = auto.items[i]
    const el = inputEl()
    const text = el.value
    const ins = it.kind === "fn" ? it.name + "(" : it.name
    el.value = text.slice(0, auto.tk.start) + ins + text.slice(auto.tk.end)
    const caret = auto.tk.start + ins.length
    el.setSelectionRange(caret, caret)
    hideAuto()
    syncHighlight()
    return true
  }
  /* The function call around the caret and which argument it is in. */
  function callAtCaret() {
    const el = inputEl()
    const text = el.value
    if (!isFormulaText(text)) return null
    const pos = el.selectionStart
    let depth = 0
    let arg = 0
    let inStr = false
    // scan backwards skipping strings
    const s = text.slice(0, pos)
    for (let i = s.length - 1; i >= 1; i--) {
      const ch = s[i]
      if (ch === '"') {
        inStr = !inStr
        continue
      }
      if (inStr) continue
      if (ch === ")" || ch === "}") depth++
      else if (ch === "(" || ch === "{") {
        if (depth === 0) {
          if (ch === "{") return null
          const m = /([A-Za-z_][\w.]*)\s*$/.exec(s.slice(0, i))
          return m ? { name: m[1].toUpperCase(), arg } : null
        }
        depth--
      } else if (ch === "," && depth === 0) arg++
    }
    return null
  }
  function updateHint() {
    const call = callAtCaret()
    const help = call && fnHelp(call.name)
    if (!help || auto) return hideHint()
    const args = help.args ? help.args.split(/,\s*/) : []
    // past the last named argument of a repeating list, keep the repeating one bold
    let idx = Math.min(call.arg, args.length - 1)
    if (args[idx]?.includes("…") && idx > 0) idx--
    const parts = args.map((a, k) => (k === idx ? `<b>${esc(a)}</b>` : esc(a)))
    ui.hint.innerHTML = `<div><span class="fn">${esc(help.name)}</span>(${parts.join(", ")})</div><small>${esc(help.desc)}</small>`
    ui.hint.hidden = false
    const box = (edit.from === "bar" ? ui.fxWrap : ui.editWrap).getBoundingClientRect()
    const rootBox = ui.root.getBoundingClientRect()
    ui.hint.style.left = Math.max(4, Math.min(box.left - rootBox.left, rootBox.width - 380)) + "px"
    const top = box.top - rootBox.top - ui.hint.offsetHeight - 4
    ui.hint.style.top = (top < 0 ? box.bottom - rootBox.top + 4 : top) + "px"
  }
  function hideHint() {
    if (ui.hint) ui.hint.hidden = true
  }

  /* ---------- rich text editing (format part of a cell's text) ---------- */
  function beginRich(runs) {
    edit.rich = true
    ui.rich.hidden = false
    ui.editor.hidden = true
    ui.rich.innerHTML = runs.map((x) => `<span data-s='${esc(JSON.stringify(x.s || {}))}' style="${esc(runCss(x.s || {}))}">${esc(x.t)}</span>`).join("")
    ui.rich.focus()
    placeCaretEnd(ui.rich)
  }
  const runCss = (s) => [s.b ? "font-weight:700" : "", s.i ? "font-style:italic" : "", s.u ? "text-decoration:underline" : "", s.st ? "text-decoration:line-through" : "", s.fc ? "color:" + s.fc : "", s.fs ? "font-size:" + s.fs * PT * zoomOf() + "px" : "", s.ff ? "font-family:" + s.ff : ""].filter(Boolean).join(";")
  function getSelection2() {
    return host.getSelection ? host.getSelection() : document.getSelection()
  }
  function placeCaretEnd(el) {
    const s = getSelection2()
    const range = document.createRange()
    range.selectNodeContents(el)
    range.collapse(false)
    s.removeAllRanges()
    s.addRange(range)
  }
  function readRich() {
    const runs = []
    const walk = (node, style) => {
      for (const ch of node.childNodes) {
        if (ch.nodeType === 3) {
          if (!ch.nodeValue) continue
          const last = runs[runs.length - 1]
          if (last && JSON.stringify(last.s) === JSON.stringify(style)) last.t += ch.nodeValue
          else runs.push({ t: ch.nodeValue, s: { ...style } })
        } else if (ch.nodeName === "BR") runs.push({ t: "\n", s: { ...style } })
        else if (ch.nodeType === 1) {
          let st = { ...style }
          if (ch.dataset?.s) {
            try {
              st = { ...st, ...JSON.parse(ch.dataset.s) }
            } catch {
              /* ignore */
            }
          }
          if (ch.nodeName === "B" || ch.nodeName === "STRONG") st.b = 1
          if (ch.nodeName === "I" || ch.nodeName === "EM") st.i = 1
          if (ch.nodeName === "U") st.u = 1
          if (ch.nodeName === "DIV" && runs.length) runs.push({ t: "\n", s: { ...style } })
          walk(ch, st)
        }
      }
    }
    walk(ui.rich, {})
    for (const r of runs) for (const k of Object.keys(r.s)) if (!r.s[k]) delete r.s[k]
    return runs.filter((r) => r.t)
  }
  const richText = () => readRich().map((r) => r.t).join("")
  /* Apply a style to the selected characters (switches the editor to rich mode). */
  function styleSelectedText(patch) {
    if (!edit.active || editingFormula()) return false
    if (!edit.rich) {
      const el = ui.editor
      const a = el.selectionStart
      const b = el.selectionEnd
      if (a === b) return false
      const text = el.value
      beginRich([{ t: text.slice(0, a), s: {} }, { t: text.slice(a, b), s: {} }, { t: text.slice(b), s: {} }].filter((x) => x.t))
      // select the middle run
      const spans = [...ui.rich.querySelectorAll("span")]
      const mid = spans[a ? 1 : 0]
      const s = getSelection2()
      const range = document.createRange()
      range.selectNodeContents(mid)
      s.removeAllRanges()
      s.addRange(range)
    }
    const s = getSelection2()
    if (!s.rangeCount) return true
    const range = s.getRangeAt(0)
    if (range.collapsed) return true
    const frag = range.extractContents()
    const span = document.createElement("span")
    const toggle = {}
    for (const k in patch) toggle[k] = patch[k]
    span.dataset.s = JSON.stringify(toggle)
    span.style.cssText = runCss(toggle)
    span.append(frag)
    range.insertNode(span)
    s.removeAllRanges()
    const r2 = document.createRange()
    r2.selectNodeContents(span)
    s.addRange(r2)
    return true
  }

  /* ---------- editor keyboard ---------- */
  function editorKey(e) {
    const ctrl = e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey
    const k = e.key
    if (auto && !ui.auto.hidden) {
      if (k === "ArrowDown" || k === "ArrowUp") {
        auto.i = (auto.i + (k === "ArrowDown" ? 1 : -1) + auto.items.length) % auto.items.length
        renderAuto()
        e.preventDefault()
        return
      }
      if (k === "Tab" || (k === "Enter" && !e.altKey && !ctrl)) {
        e.preventDefault()
        acceptAuto()
        return
      }
      if (k === "Escape") {
        e.preventDefault()
        hideAuto()
        return
      }
    }
    if (k === "Enter" && e.altKey) {
      e.preventDefault()
      insertAtCaret("\n")
      return
    }
    if (k === "Enter") {
      e.preventDefault()
      if (ctrl && e.shiftKey) return commitEdit({ dr: 0, dc: 0 })
      if (ctrl) return commitEdit(null, { all: true })
      return commitEdit({ dr: e.shiftKey ? -1 : 1, dc: 0 })
    }
    if (k === "Tab") {
      e.preventDefault()
      return commitEdit({ dr: 0, dc: e.shiftKey ? -1 : 1 })
    }
    if (k === "Escape") {
      e.preventDefault()
      return cancelEdit()
    }
    if (k === "F4") {
      e.preventDefault()
      return toggleAbsolute()
    }
    if (k === "F2") {
      e.preventDefault()
      setMode(mode === "edit" ? "enter" : "edit")
      return
    }
    if (k.startsWith("Arrow") && (mode === "enter" || mode === "point")) {
      const dr = k === "ArrowUp" ? -1 : k === "ArrowDown" ? 1 : 0
      const dc = k === "ArrowLeft" ? -1 : k === "ArrowRight" ? 1 : 0
      if (canPoint()) {
        e.preventDefault()
        return arrowPoint(dr, dc, e.shiftKey)
      }
      if (edit.from === "cell" && !e.shiftKey) {
        e.preventDefault()
        return commitEdit({ dr, dc })
      }
    }
    if (ctrl && !e.altKey && ["b", "i", "u", "5"].includes(k.toLowerCase())) {
      e.preventDefault()
      const key = { b: "b", i: "i", u: "u", 5: "st" }[k.toLowerCase()]
      // selected characters get the style; otherwise the whole cell does (the edit stays open)
      if (edit.from === "cell" && styleSelectedText({ [key]: 1 })) return
      const sheet = wb.byId.get(edit.sid)
      const cur = styleOf(sheet.styleIdAt(edit.r, edit.c))[key]
      doOps([{ t: "fmt", s: sheet.id, items: [{ rects: [[edit.r, edit.c, edit.r, edit.c]], p: { [key]: cur ? null : 1 } }] }], { label: t("Format", "تنسيق") })
      placeEditor()
      return
    }
    if (ctrl && k === ";") {
      e.preventDefault()
      insertAtCaret(formatValue(todaySerial(), CFG.dateFmt).t)
      return
    }
    if (ctrl && k === "z") {
      // undo inside the editor is the browser's own
      return
    }
    // typing anything else ends "pointing": the next click inserts a new reference
    if (k !== "Shift" && k !== "Control" && k !== "Alt" && k !== "Meta" && !k.startsWith("Arrow")) edit.point = null
    if (!k.startsWith("Arrow") && k !== "Shift") setTimeout(() => mode === "point" && !canPoint() && setMode(edit.mode === "edit" ? "edit" : "enter"), 0)
  }
  function insertAtCaret(s) {
    if (edit.rich) {
      document.execCommand?.("insertText", false, s)
      return
    }
    const el = inputEl()
    const a = el.selectionStart
    const b = el.selectionEnd
    el.value = el.value.slice(0, a) + s + el.value.slice(b)
    el.setSelectionRange(a + s.length, a + s.length)
    syncHighlight()
  }

  /* ---------- formula bar ---------- */
  function updateFormulaBar() {
    return staleOk(formulaBarNow)
  }
  function formulaBarNow() {
    if (!ui.fx || edit.active) return
    const cell = sh.get(sel.r, sel.c)
    const hidden = sh.protect && styleOf(cell?.s || 0).hd
    ui.fx.value = hidden ? "" : editText(sel.r, sel.c)
    ui.fxHL.textContent = ui.fx.value + "\n"
    const g = lastRange()
    const name = namedRangeFor(g)
    if (document.activeElement !== host.host || host.activeElement !== ui.namebox) ui.namebox.value = name || (g.r1 === g.r2 && g.c1 === g.c2 ? addr(sel.r, sel.c) : rangeText(g))
    ui.fx.readOnly = readOnlyNow()
  }
  function namedRangeFor(g) {
    for (const n of wb.names.values()) {
      const r = parseA1(String(n.ref).replace(/^=/, ""))
      if (r && (r.sheet == null || sameSheet(r.sheet, sh.name)) && r.r1 === g.r1 && r.c1 === g.c1 && r.r2 === g.r2 && r.c2 === g.c2) return n.name
    }
    for (const tb of sh.tables) if (tb.r1 === g.r1 && tb.c1 === g.c1 && tb.r2 === g.r2 && tb.c2 === g.c2) return tb.name
    return null
  }

  /* ---------- validation prompts and errors ---------- */
  function validationPrompt(r, c) {
    const rule = dvFor(sh, r, c)
    if (!rule || !rule.prompt?.msg) return hidePrompt()
    ui.prompt.innerHTML = `${rule.prompt.title ? `<b>${esc(rule.prompt.title)}</b>` : ""}<div>${esc(rule.prompt.msg)}</div>`
    ui.prompt.hidden = false

    ui.prompt.style.left = box.left - rootBox.left + "px"

  async function validationError(rule) {
    const style = rule.error?.style || "stop"

      return false
    }
    if (style === "warning") return confirmBox(msg + "\n\n" + t("Continue?", "هل تريد المتابعة؟"), title)
    await alertBox(msg, title)
    return true
  }

  function statsNow() {
    if (!sh || destroyed) return

    for (const g of sel.ranges) {
      const r2 = Math.min(g.r2, sh.maxR + 1)
      const c2 = Math.min(g.c2, sh.maxC + 1)
      if ((r2 - g.r1 + 1) * (c2 - g.c1 + 1) > limit) continue
      const m = wb.rangeMat(new Ref(sh.id, g.r1, g.c1, Math.max(g.r1, r2), Math.max(g.c1, c2)))

          cells++
          if (v != null && v !== "") count++
          if (typeof v === "number") nums.push(v)
        })
      })
    }
    if (count <= 1 && cells <= 1) {
      ui.stats.textContent = ""
      return
