    else if (kind === "insRight") op = u.c2 >= g.c1 ? { t: "move", s: sh.id, src: [g.r1, g.c1, g.r2, Math.max(g.c1, u.c2)], ds: sh.id, dr: 0, dc: wid } : null
    else if (kind === "delUp") op = u.r2 > g.r2 ? { t: "move", s: sh.id, src: [g.r2 + 1, g.c1, u.r2, g.c2], ds: sh.id, dr: -hgt, dc: 0 } : { t: "clear", s: sh.id, rects: [rectOf(g)], what: "all" }
    else if (kind === "delLeft") op = u.c2 > g.c2 ? { t: "move", s: sh.id, src: [g.r1, g.c2 + 1, g.r2, u.c2], ds: sh.id, dr: 0, dc: -wid } : { t: "clear", s: sh.id, rects: [rectOf(g)], what: "all" }
    const ops = [op]
    if (kind === "delUp" && u.r2 > g.r2) ops.unshift({ t: "clear", s: sh.id, rects: [rectOf(g)], what: "all" })
    if (kind === "delLeft" && u.c2 > g.c2) ops.unshift({ t: "clear", s: sh.id, rects: [rectOf(g)], what: "all" })
    doOps(ops.filter(Boolean), { label: kind.startsWith("ins") ? t("Insert cells", "إدراج خلايا") : t("Delete cells", "حذف خلايا") })
  }
  async function insertCellsDialog(del) {
    const g = lastRange()
    if (isWholeRows(g)) return del ? deleteRows() : insertRows()
    if (isWholeCols(g)) return del ? deleteCols() : insertCols()
    const opts = del
      ? [["delLeft", t("Shift cells left", "إزاحة الخلايا لليسار")], ["delUp", t("Shift cells up", "إزاحة الخلايا لأعلى")], ["row", t("Entire row", "صف كامل")], ["col", t("Entire column", "عمود كامل")]]
      : [["insRight", t("Shift cells right", "إزاحة الخلايا لليمين")], ["insDown", t("Shift cells down", "إزاحة الخلايا لأسفل")], ["row", t("Entire row", "صف كامل")], ["col", t("Entire column", "عمود كامل")]]
    const body = h("div.ds-stack", opts.map(([v, l], i) => radio("how", v, l, i === (del ? 1 : 1))))
    const r = await dialog({ title: del ? t("Delete", "حذف") : t("Insert", "إدراج"), body, buttons: [{ label: t("Cancel", "إلغاء") }, { label: t("OK", "موافق"), primary: true, action: () => body.querySelector("input:checked").value }] }).done
    if (!r || r === true) return
    if (r === "row") return del ? deleteRows() : insertRows()
    if (r === "col") return del ? deleteCols() : insertCols()
    shiftCells(r)
  }

  /* ---------- rows / columns ---------- */
  function hideAxis(axis, hide) {
    const items = []
    for (const g of sel.ranges) {
      if (axis === "r") items.push([g.r1, g.r2, { hd: hide || null }])
      else items.push([g.c1, g.c2, { hd: hide || null }])
    }
    if (!hide) {
      // unhide also catches hidden neighbours of a single selected header
      for (const it of items) {
        const ax = axis === "r" ? sh.rows : sh.cols
        if (it[0] > 0 && ax.hidden.has(it[0] - 1) && it[0] === it[1]) it[0]--
      }
    }
    doOps([{ t: "axis", s: sh.id, ax: axis, items }], { label: hide ? t("Hide", "إخفاء") : t("Unhide", "إظهار") })
  }
  async function axisSizeDialog(axis) {
    const ax = axis === "r" ? sh.rows : sh.cols
    const cur = ax.raw(axis === "r" ? sel.r : sel.c)
    const v = await promptBox(axis === "r" ? t("Row height (pixels)", "ارتفاع الصف (بكسل)") : t("Column width (pixels)", "عرض العمود (بكسل)"), String(cur), axis === "r" ? t("Row height", "ارتفاع الصف") : t("Column width", "عرض العمود"), { type: "number" })
    if (v == null) return
    const n = clamp(Math.round(Number(v)), 0, axis === "r" ? 800 : 2000)
    if (isNaN(n)) return
    const items = sel.ranges.map((g) => (axis === "r" ? [g.r1, Math.min(g.r2, g.r1 + 100000), { sz: n || null, hd: n === 0 || null }] : [g.c1, g.c2, { sz: n || null, hd: n === 0 || null }]))
    doOps([{ t: "axis", s: sh.id, ax: axis, items }], { label: t("Resize", "تغيير الحجم") })
  }
  /* Fit columns to their widest text, rows to their tallest (wrapped) text. */
  function autofit(axis, list) {
    const items = []
    const u = sh.usedRange() || { r1: 0, c1: 0, r2: 0, c2: 0 }
    if (axis === "c") {
      for (const c of list) {
        let w = 0
        let n = 0
        for (let r = u.r1; r <= u.r2 && n < 20000; r++, n++) {
          if (sh.rows.isHidden(r) || sh.mergeAt(r, c)) continue
          const l = lookAt(r, c)
          if (l.v == null || l.v === "") continue
          const { text } = cellText(l, 10000)
          const font = fontOf(l.st)
          const lines = String(text).split("\n")
          for (const line of lines) w = Math.max(w, measure(font, line) + 10 + (l.st.ind || 0) * 9 + (filterHeaderRow().some((f) => f.r === r && c >= f.c1 && c <= f.c2) ? 20 : 0))
        }
        items.push([c, c, { sz: w ? Math.ceil(Math.max(w, 20)) : null, hd: null }])
      }
    } else {
      for (const r of list) {
        let hgt = 0
        for (let c = u.c1; c <= Math.min(u.c2, u.c1 + 300); c++) {
          const cell = sh.get(r, c)
          if (!cell || sh.mergeAt(r, c)) continue
          const l = lookAt(r, c)
          const fs = (l.st.fs || 11) * PT
          let lines = 1
          const { text } = cellText(l, sh.cols.size(c))
          if (l.st.wr) lines = wrapLines(fontOf(l.st), text, Math.max(4, sh.cols.size(c) - 7)).length
          else lines = String(text).split("\n").length
          hgt = Math.max(hgt, lines * fs * 1.22 + 8)
        }
        items.push([r, r, { sz: hgt > DEF_ROW_H ? Math.ceil(hgt) : null, hd: null }])
      }
    }
    if (items.length) doOps([{ t: "axis", s: sh.id, ax: axis, items: compressAxisItems(items) }], { label: t("AutoFit", "احتواء تلقائي") })
  }
  function autofitSelection(axis) {
    const list = []
    for (const g of sel.ranges) {
      const b = boundedRect(g, 0)
      if (axis === "c") for (let c = b.c1; c <= Math.min(b.c2, b.c1 + 500); c++) list.push(c)
      else for (let r = b.r1; r <= Math.min(b.r2, b.r1 + 5000); r++) list.push(r)
    }
    autofit(axis, list)
  }

  /* ---------- fill ---------- */
  function runFill(src, dst, mode = "series") {
    doOps([{ t: "fill", s: sh.id, src: rectOf(src), dst: rectOf(dst), mode }], { label: t("Fill", "تعبئة") })
    setRange({ r1: Math.min(src.r1, dst.r1), c1: Math.min(src.c1, dst.c1), r2: Math.max(src.r2, dst.r2), c2: Math.max(src.c2, dst.c2) }, { r: src.r1, c: src.c1 })
    showFillOptions(src, dst)
  }
  function fillDir(dir) {
    const g = lastRange()
    if (dir === "down") {
      if (g.r1 === g.r2) {
        if (g.r1 === 0) return
        return runFill({ r1: g.r1 - 1, c1: g.c1, r2: g.r1 - 1, c2: g.c2 }, g, "copy")
      }
      return runFill({ r1: g.r1, c1: g.c1, r2: g.r1, c2: g.c2 }, { r1: g.r1 + 1, c1: g.c1, r2: g.r2, c2: g.c2 }, "copy")
    }
    if (dir === "right") {
      if (g.c1 === g.c2) {
        if (g.c1 === 0) return
        return runFill({ r1: g.r1, c1: g.c1 - 1, r2: g.r2, c2: g.c1 - 1 }, g, "copy")
      }
      return runFill({ r1: g.r1, c1: g.c1, r2: g.r2, c2: g.c1 }, { r1: g.r1, c1: g.c1 + 1, r2: g.r2, c2: g.c2 }, "copy")
    }
    if (dir === "up" && g.r2 > g.r1) return runFill({ r1: g.r2, c1: g.c1, r2: g.r2, c2: g.c2 }, { r1: g.r1, c1: g.c1, r2: g.r2 - 1, c2: g.c2 }, "copy")
    if (dir === "left" && g.c2 > g.c1) return runFill({ r1: g.r1, c1: g.c2, r2: g.r2, c2: g.c2 }, { r1: g.r1, c1: g.c1, r2: g.r2, c2: g.c2 - 1 }, "copy")
  }
  /* Double-clicking the fill handle fills down as far as the neighbouring column has data. */
  function fillDownToData() {
    const g = lastRange()
    const probe = (c) => {
      if (c < 0 || c >= MAXC) return g.r2
      let r = g.r2
      while (r + 1 < MAXR && sh.hasContent(r + 1, c)) r++
      return r
    }
    const end = Math.max(probe(g.c1 - 1), probe(g.c2 + 1))
    if (end <= g.r2) return
    runFill(g, { r1: g.r2 + 1, c1: g.c1, r2: end, c2: g.c2 }, "series")
  }
  function showFillOptions(src, dst) {
    if (!G) return
    const b = h("button.ds-fillopt", { title: t("Auto Fill options", "خيارات التعبئة التلقائية"), html: icon("fillDown") })
    const r = Math.max(src.r2, dst.r2)
    const c = Math.max(src.c2, dst.c2)
    const x = (xOf(c + 1) + 2) * G.z
    const y = (yOf(r + 1) + 2) * G.z
    Object.assign(b.style, { left: x + "px", top: y + "px" })
    ui.stage.querySelector(".ds-fillopt")?.remove()
    ui.stage.append(b)
    const redo2 = (mode) => {
      undo()
      runFill(src, dst, mode)
    }
    b.addEventListener("click", () =>
      menu(
        [
          { label: t("Copy cells", "نسخ الخلايا"), run: () => redo2("copy") },
          { label: t("Fill series", "تعبئة سلسلة"), run: () => redo2("series1") },
          { label: t("Fill formatting only", "تعبئة التنسيق فقط"), run: () => redo2("format") },
          { label: t("Fill without formatting", "تعبئة بدون تنسيق"), run: () => redo2("values") },
          { label: t("Flash fill", "تعبئة سريعة"), run: () => (undo(), flashFill()) },
        ],
        b
      )
    )
    later(() => b.remove(), 8000)
    selListeners.push(function off() {
      b.remove()
      selListeners = selListeners.filter((f) => f !== off)
    })
  }

  /* ---------- AutoSum ---------- */
  function autoSum(fn = "SUM") {
    const g = lastRange()
    if (g.r1 === g.r2 && g.c1 === g.c2) {
      // find the numbers above (or to the left)
      const isNum = (r, c) => typeof wb.getValue(sh.id, r, c) === "number"
      let r = g.r1 - 1
      while (r >= 0 && !isNum(r, g.c1) && r > g.r1 - 2) r--
      let start = r
      while (start - 1 >= 0 && isNum(start - 1, g.c1)) start--
      let ref = ""
      if (r >= 0 && isNum(r, g.c1)) ref = rectAddr(start, g.c1, r, g.c1)
      else {
        let c = g.c1 - 1
        let s2 = c
        while (s2 - 1 >= 0 && isNum(g.r1, s2 - 1)) s2--
        if (c >= 0 && isNum(g.r1, c)) ref = rectAddr(g.r1, s2, g.r1, c)
      }
      startEdit({ mode: "enter", text: `=${fn}(${ref})` })
      const el = inputEl()
      if (ref) el.setSelectionRange(fn.length + 2, fn.length + 2 + ref.length)
      syncHighlight()
      return
    }
    // a range: totals below each column (or right of each row when one row is selected)
    const d = []
    if (g.r1 === g.r2) d.push([g.r1, g.c2 + 1, { f: `${fn}(${rectAddr(g.r1, g.c1, g.r1, g.c2)})` }])
    else
      for (let c = g.c1; c <= Math.min(g.c2, g.c1 + 500); c++) {
        let end = g.r2
        if (sh.hasContent(g.r2, c) || !sh.hasContent(g.r2, c)) end = g.r2
        d.push([end + 1, c, { f: `${fn}(${rectAddr(g.r1, c, end, c)})` }])
      }
    doOps([{ t: "cells", s: sh.id, d }], { label: "AutoSum" })
  }

  /* ---------- view ---------- */
  function setZoom(z) {
    const v = view()
    const old = v.zoom
    v.zoom = clamp(Math.round(z * 100) / 100, 0.25, 4)
    if (old === v.zoom) return
    ui.zoomRange.value = Math.round(v.zoom * 100)
    ui.zoomVal.textContent = Math.round(v.zoom * 100) + "%"
    MEASURE.clear()
    updateSizer()
    applyScroll()
    invalidate()
    refreshObjects()
  }
  function zoomToSelection() {
    const g = boundedRect(lastRange(), 0)
    const geo = geometry()
    const w = sh.cols.pos(g.c2 + 1) - sh.cols.pos(g.c1)
    const hgt = sh.rows.pos(g.r2 + 1) - sh.rows.pos(g.r1)
    const z = Math.min((geo.W - geo.left0 * geo.z) / w, (geo.H - geo.top0 * geo.z) / hgt)
    setZoom(clamp(z * 0.95, 0.25, 4))
    view().sx = sh.cols.pos(g.c1) - sh.cols.pos(sh.freeze.c)
    view().sy = sh.rows.pos(g.r1) - sh.rows.pos(sh.freeze.r)
    updateSizer()
    applyScroll()
  }
  function freeze(kind) {
    let v
    if (kind === "none") v = [0, 0]
    else if (kind === "row") v = [1, 0]
    else if (kind === "col") v = [0, 1]
    else {
      const g = geometry()
      void g
      v = [sel.r, sel.c]
      if (v[0] === 0 && v[1] === 0) v = [Math.floor(MAXR / 2) > 0 ? 1 : 0, 0]
    }
    view().sx = 0
    view().sy = 0
    view().split = null
    doOps([{ t: "meta", s: sh.id, k: "freeze", v }], { label: t("Freeze panes", "تجميد الأجزاء") })
    updateSizer()
    applyScroll()
  }
  /* View › Split: a window setting, so it isn't an op and other people's screens don't move. */
  function setSplit(sp) {
    const v = view()
    const old = v.split
    const on = sp && (sp.w || sp.h)
    // keep the bottom-right pane's content where it is on screen
    v.sx = Math.max(0, v.sx + ((on ? sp.w : 0) - (old?.w || 0)))
    v.sy = Math.max(0, v.sy + ((on ? sp.h : 0) - (old?.h || 0)))
    v.split = on ? { w: sp.w || 0, h: sp.h || 0 } : null
    if (!on) v.ap = {}
    G = geometry()
    updateSizer()
    applyScroll()
    invalidate()
    updateRibbonState()
  }
  function toggleSplit() {
    if (view().split) return setSplit(null)
    if (sh.freeze.r || sh.freeze.c) freeze("none")
    const g = geometry()
    const v = view()
    let w = xOf(sel.c) - g.left0
    let hgt = yOf(sel.r) - g.top0
    if (w < 24 && hgt < 16) {
      w = (g.vw - g.left0) / 2
      hgt = (g.vh - g.top0) / 2
    }
    // the new top/left panes start where the window was looking
    v.sx0 = v.sx
    v.sy0 = v.sy
    setSplit({ w: w >= 24 ? w : 0, h: hgt >= 16 ? hgt : 0 })
  }
  async function toggleFullscreen() {
    const on = !ui.root.classList.contains("ds-full")
    ui.root.classList.toggle("ds-full", on)
    try {
      if (on && ui.root.requestFullscreen && !document.fullscreenElement) await ui.root.requestFullscreen()
      else if (!on && document.fullscreenElement) await document.exitFullscreen()
    } catch {
      /* the CSS full-window mode still applies */
    }
    requestAnimationFrame(() => {
      updateSizer()
      invalidate()
    })
  }

  /* ---------- go to ---------- */
  function goToRef(text) {
    const s = String(text).trim()
    if (!s) return false
    const nm = wb.name(s.toUpperCase(), sh.id)
    let target = nm ? parseA1(String(nm.ref).replace(/^=/, "")) : parseA1(s)
    if (!target) {
      const tb = wb.table(s.toUpperCase())
      if (tb) target = { sheet: wb.sheetName(tb.sid), r1: tb.r1, c1: tb.c1, r2: tb.r2, c2: tb.c2 }
    }
    if (!target) {
      // "R5C3" style
      const m = /^R(\d+)C(\d+)$/i.exec(s)
      if (m) target = { r1: +m[1] - 1, c1: +m[2] - 1, r2: +m[1] - 1, c2: +m[2] - 1 }
    }
    if (!target) return false
    if (target.sheet != null) {
      const sid = wb.sheetId(target.sheet)
      if (sid == null) return false
      if (sid !== sh.id) activateSheet(sid)
    }
    setRange({ r1: target.r1, c1: target.c1, r2: target.r2, c2: target.c2 })
    scrollToCell(target.r1, target.c1)
    return true
  }
  function uniqueTableName(base = "Table") {
    let n = 1
    let name = base.replace(/\d+$/, "") + n
    while (wb.table(name.toUpperCase()) || wb.names.has(name.toUpperCase())) name = base.replace(/\d+$/, "") + ++n
    return name
  }

  /* ======================================================================
     Commands, ribbon, quick access toolbar, shortcuts, context menus and
     sheet tabs.
     ====================================================================== */
  const C = Object.create(null)
  function cmd(id, label, ic, run, extra = {}) {
    C[id] = { id, label, icon: ic, run, ...extra }
  }
  function runCmd(id, ...args) {
    const c = C[id]
    if (!c) return console.warn("Durar Sheets: no command", id)
    if (c.enabled && !c.enabled()) return
    if (c.write && readOnlyNow()) return toast(t("You can view this workbook but not change it.", "يمكنك عرض هذا الملف دون تعديله."))
    closePopups()
    if (edit.active && !c.inEdit) {
      if (c.fmt && !editingFormula()) {
        /* formatting while editing applies to the selected characters if any */
      }
      if (!c.keepEdit) commitEdit(null)
    }
    try {
      const r = c.run(...args)
      if (r && r.catch) r.catch((e) => (console.error(e), toast(e.message || String(e), { error: true })))
    } catch (e) {
      console.error("Durar Sheets:", id, e)
      toast(e.message || String(e), { error: true })
    }
  }
  const W = { write: true }

    cmd("copy", t("Copy", "نسخ"), "copy", () => copyCmd(false), { key: "Ctrl+C" })
    cmd("paste", t("Paste", "لصق"), "paste", () => pasteCmd(), { key: "Ctrl+V", ...W })
    cmd("pasteValues", t("Paste values", "لصق القيم"), "hash", () => pasteCmd({ values: true }), { key: "Ctrl+Shift+V", ...W })
    cmd("pasteFormulas", t("Paste formulas", "لصق الصيغ"), "fx", () => pasteCmd({ formulas: true }), W)
    cmd("pasteFormats", t("Paste formatting", "لصق التنسيق"), "brush", () => pasteCmd({ formats: true }), W)
    cmd("pasteTranspose", t("Transpose", "تبديل الصفوف والأعمدة"), "rotate", () => pasteCmd({ transpose: true }), W)
    cmd("pasteLink", t("Paste link", "لصق ارتباط"), "link", () => pasteCmd({ link: true }), W)
    cmd("pasteSpecial", t("Paste special…", "لصق خاص…"), "paste", () => pasteSpecialDialog(), { key: "Ctrl+Alt+V", ...W })
    cmd("formatPainter", t("Format painter", "نسخ التنسيق"), "brush", (sticky) => {
      if (painter && sticky) painter.sticky = true
      else if (painter) painter = null
      else startPainter(!!sticky)
      updateRibbonState()
      updateStatusMode()
    }, { active: () => !!painter, ...W })
    cmd("undo", t("Undo", "تراجع"), "undo", () => undo(), { key: "Ctrl+Z", enabled: () => undoStack.length > 0 || edit.active, keepEdit: true })
    cmd("redo", t("Redo", "إعادة"), "redo", () => redo(), { key: "Ctrl+Y", enabled: () => redoStack.length > 0 })
    // font
    const fmtCmd = (id, label, ic, key, k, v = 1) => cmd(id, label, ic, () => (edit.active && styleSelectedText({ [k]: v }) ? null : toggleFmt(k, v)), { key, active: () => !!activeStyle()[k], fmt: true, keepEdit: true, ...W })
    fmtCmd("bold", t("Bold", "غامق"), "bold", "Ctrl+B", "b")
    fmtCmd("italic", t("Italic", "مائل"), "italic", "Ctrl+I", "i")

  function keyString(e) {
    let k = e.key
    if (k === " ") k = "Space"
    if (k.length === 1) k = k.toUpperCase()
    if (k === "+" && !e.shiftKey) k = "="

      const tab = h("button.ds-sheettab" + (s === sh ? ".on" : ""), { role: "tab", type: "button", "aria-selected": String(s === sh), draggable: "true", title: s.name + (s.protect ?       if (s.color) tab.style.setProperty("--tab", s.color)
      tab.addEventListener("click", () => {
        if (edit.active && editingFormula()) {
          activateSheet(s.id)
          return
        }
        activateSheet(s.id)
        focusGrid()
      })
      tab.addEventListener("dblclick", () => inlineRename(tab, s))

      })
      tab.addEventListener("dragleave", () => tab.classList.remove("drop"))
      tab.addEventListener("drop", (e) => {
        e.preventDefault()
        tab.classList.remove("drop")
        const id = Number(e.dataTransfer.getData("text/x-durar-sheet"))
        if (id && id !== s.id) moveSheet(id, wb.sheetIndex(s.id))

  /* ---------- Format Cells ---------- */
  function formatCellsDialog(tab = "number") {
    const st = { ...styleOf(sh.styleIdAt(sel.r, sel.c)) }
    const v = wb.getValue(sh.id, sel.r, sel.c)
    const sample = typeof v === "number" || typeof v === "string" ? v : 1234.5678
    const patch = {}
    const set = (k, val) => {
      patch[k] = val
      st[k] = val
      preview()
    }
    // Number
    const cats = [
      ["general", t("General", "عام")],
      ["number", t("Number", "رقم")],
      ["currency", t("Currency", "عملة")],
      ["accounting", t("Accounting", "محاسبي")],
      ["date", t("Date", "تاريخ")],
      ["time", t("Time", "وقت")],
      ["percent", t("Percentage", "نسبة مئوية")],
      ["fraction", t("Fraction", "كسر")],
      ["scientific", t("Scientific", "علمي")],
      ["text", t("Text", "نص")],
      ["special", t("Special", "خاص")],
      ["custom", t("Custom", "مخصص")],
    ]
    const catList = h("select.ds-input.ds-catlist", { size: 12 }, cats.map(([k, l]) => h("option", { value: k }, l)))
    const opts = h("div.ds-nfopts")
    const prev = h("div.ds-nfprev")
    const custom = input(st.nf || "General", { spellcheck: "false" })
    const guessCat = (nf) => {
      if (!nf) return "general"
      const f = compileFormat(nf)
      if (nf === "@") return "text"
      if (f?.isDate) return /[hs]/i.test(nf.replace(/\[[^\]]*\]|"[^"]*"/g, "")) && !/[dy]/i.test(nf.replace(/\[[^\]]*\]|"[^"]*"/g, "")) ? "time" : "date"
      if (f?.isPct) return "percent"
      if (/E[+-]/i.test(nf)) return "scientific"
      if (/\?\/|#\s\?/.test(nf)) return "fraction"
      if (/_\(|\*/.test(nf)) return "accounting"
      if (new RegExp("\\[\\$|" + CFG.curSym.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, "\\$&") + "|[$€£¥₹]").test(nf)) return "currency"
      if (/^#,##0(\.0+)?$|^0(\.0+)?$/.test(nf)) return "number"
      return "custom"
    }
    let cat = guessCat(st.nf)
    catList.value = cat
    const decs = (nf) => ((nf || "").split(";")[0].split(".")[1] || "").replace(/[^0#]/g, "").length
    function numOpts() {
      opts.innerHTML = ""
      const nf = st.nf
      const d = input(String(nf ? decs(nf) : 2), { type: "number", min: 0, max: 30, style: { width: "80px" } })
      const sep = check(t("Use 1000 separator (,)", "استخدام فاصل الآلاف (,)"), /,/.test(nf || "#,##0"))
      const neg = select(
        [
          ["-", "-1,234.10"],
          ["red", "1,234.10 (" + t("red", "أحمر") + ")"],
          ["paren", "(1,234.10)"],
          ["parenred", "(1,234.10) (" + t("red", "أحمر") + ")"],
        ],
        /\[Red\]\(/.test(nf || "") ? "parenred" : /\[Red\]/.test(nf || "") ? "red" : /;\(/.test(nf || "") ? "paren" : "-"
      )
      const symList = [...new Set([CFG.curSym, "SAR", "$", "€", "£", "AED", "KWD", "EGP", "¥", "₹"])]
      const sym = select(symList, symList.find((s) => (nf || "").includes(s)) || CFG.curSym)
      const build = () => {
        const n = clamp(+d.value || 0, 0, 30)
        const dd = n ? "." + "0".repeat(n) : ""
        let body = (sep.querySelector("input").checked || cat === "currency" || cat === "accounting" ? "#,##0" : "0") + dd
        if (cat === "currency") body = currencyFormat(sym.value, n)
        if (cat === "accounting") return `_("${sym.value}" * #,##0${dd}_);_("${sym.value}" * (#,##0${dd});_("${sym.value}" * "-"${"?".repeat(n)}_);_(@_)`
        if (cat === "percent") return "0" + dd + "%"
        if (cat === "scientific") return "0" + dd + "E+00"
        const ng = neg.value
        if (ng === "red") return body + ";[Red]" + body
        if (ng === "paren") return body + ";(" + body + ")"
        if (ng === "parenred") return body + ";[Red](" + body + ")"
        return body
      }
      const apply = () => set("nf", build())
      for (const el of [d, sep, neg, sym]) el.addEventListener("change", apply)
      d.addEventListener("input", apply)
      opts.append(field(t("Decimal places", "المنازل العشرية"), d))
      if (cat === "number") opts.append(sep, field(t("Negative numbers", "الأرقام السالبة"), neg))
      if (cat === "currency" || cat === "accounting") opts.append(field(t("Symbol", "الرمز"), sym))
      if (cat === "currency") opts.append(field(t("Negative numbers", "الأرقام السالبة"), neg))
      if (!nf || guessCat(nf) !== cat) apply()
    }
    function listOpts(list) {
      opts.innerHTML = ""
      const l = h("select.ds-input", { size: 8 }, list.map((f) => h("option", { value: f, selected: f === st.nf }, formatValue(typeof sample === "number" ? sample : 46000.5625, f).t + "    (" + f + ")")))
      l.addEventListener("change", () => set("nf", l.value))
      opts.append(l)
      if (!list.includes(st.nf)) set("nf", list[0])
    }
    function catChanged() {
      cat = catList.value
      if (cat === "general") {
        opts.innerHTML = `<p class="ds-note">${t("General format cells have no specific number format.", "الخلايا ذات التنسيق العام ليس لها تنسيق أرقام محدد.")}</p>`

  /* ---------- Find & Replace ---------- */
  let findState = { q: "", rep: "", within: "sheet", by: "rows", look: "values", mc: false, whole: false, re: false, pos: null }
  function findDialog(replace) {
    const q = input(findState.q, { placeholder: t("Find what", "البحث عن"), autofocus: true })
    const rep = input(findState.rep, { placeholder: t("Replace with", "الاستبدال بـ") })
    const within = select([["sheet", t("Sheet", "الورقة")], ["book", t("Workbook", "المصنف")], ["sel", t("Selection", "التحديد")]], findState.within)
    const look = select([["values", t("Values", "القيم")], ["formulas", t("Formulas", "الصيغ")], ["comments", t("Comments", "التعليقات")]], findState.look)
    const by = select([["rows", t("By rows", "حسب الصفوف")], ["cols", t("By columns", "حسب الأعمدة")]], findState.by)
    const mc = check(t("Match case", "مطابقة حالة الأحرف"), findState.mc)
    const whole = check(t("Match entire cell contents", "مطابقة محتويات الخلية بالكامل"), findState.whole)
    const re = check(t("Use regular expressions", "استخدام التعابير النمطية"), findState.re)
    const results = h("div.ds-findresults")
    const status = h("p.ds-note")
    const read = () => {
      Object.assign(findState, { q: q.value, rep: rep.value, within: within.value, look: look.value, by: by.value, mc: mc.querySelector("input").checked, whole: whole.querySelector("input").checked, re: re.querySelector("input").checked })
    }
    const body = h("div.ds-find", field(t("Find what", "البحث عن"), q), replace ? field(t("Replace with", "الاستبدال بـ"), rep) : null, h("div.ds-grid3", field(t("Within", "ضمن"), within), field(t("Search", "البحث"), by), field(t("Look in", "البحث في"), look)), h("div.ds-row", mc, whole, re), status, results)
    const d = dialog({
      title: replace ? t("Find and replace", "بحث واستبدال") : t("Find", "بحث"),
      body,
      modeless: true,
      wide: true,
      cls: "find",
      onClose: () => {
        findHits = null
        invalidate()
      },
      buttons: [
        ...(replace
          ? [
              { label: t("Replace all", "استبدال الكل"), left: true, action: () => (read(), replaceAll(status), false) },
              { label: t("Replace", "استبدال"), left: true, action: () => (read(), replaceOne(status), false) },
            ]
          : []),
        {
          label: t("Find all", "بحث عن الكل"),
          action: () => {
            read()
            const hits = findAll()
            findHits = hits.slice(0, 2000)
            invalidate()
            status.textContent = t(`${hits.length} cell(s) found`, `تم العثور على ${hits.length} خلية`)
            results.innerHTML = ""
            const table = h("table.ds-table")
            for (const hit of hits.slice(0, 500)) {

              tr.addEventListener("click", () => {

          },

  function findMatcher() {
    const s = findState
    if (!s.q) return null
    let re
    try {
      re = s.re ? new RegExp(s.whole ? "^(?:" + s.q + ")$" : s.q, s.mc ? "gu" : "giu") : new RegExp(s.whole ? "^" + wildRe(s.q, false).source + "$" : wildRe(s.q, false).source, s.mc ? "gu" : "giu")
    } catch {
      return null
    }
    return re
  }
  function cellSearchText(sheet, r, c) {
    const cell = sheet.cells.get(ck(r, c))
    if (findState.look === "comments") return sheet.comments.get(ck(r, c))?.thread?.map((m) => m.text).join("\n") || ""
    if (!cell) return ""
    if (findState.look === "formulas" && cell.f != null) return "=" + cell.f
    return displayOf(sheet, r, c)
  }
  function findAll() {
    const re = findMatcher()
    if (!re) return []
    const sheets = findState.within === "book" ? wb.sheets : [sh]
    const hits = []
    for (const sheet of sheets) {
      const keys = findState.look === "comments" ? [...sheet.comments.keys()] : [...sheet.cells.keys()]
      if (sheet.spillOwner.size && findState.look === "values") for (const k of sheet.spillOwner.keys()) keys.push(k)
      const sorted = [...new Set(keys)].sort((a, b) => (findState.by === "cols" ? ckC(a) - ckC(b) || ckR(a) - ckR(b) : a - b))
      for (const k of sorted) {
        const r = ckR(k)
        const c = ckC(k)
        if (findState.within === "sel" && !inSelection(r, c)) continue
        const text = cellSearchText(sheet, r, c)
        re.lastIndex = 0
        if (text && re.test(text)) hits.push({ sid: sheet.id, r, c, text })
      }
    }
    return hits
  }
  function findNext(status) {
    const hits = findAll()
    if (!hits.length) {
      status.textContent = t("We couldn't find what you were looking for.", "لم نتمكن من العثور على ما تبحث عنه.")
      return null
    }
    const cur = { sid: sh.id, r: sel.r, c: sel.c }
    const order = (h2) => wb.sheetIndex(h2.sid) * 1e12 + (findState.by === "cols" ? h2.c * MAXR + h2.r : h2.r * MAXC + h2.c)
    const curKey = order(cur)
    const next = hits.find((h2) => order(h2) > curKey) || hits[0]
    if (next.sid !== sh.id) activateSheet(next.sid)
    setSel(next.r, next.c)
    status.textContent = `${addr(next.r, next.c)} · ${hits.length} ${t("matches", "نتيجة")}`
    return next
  }
  function replaceIn(text) {
    const re = findMatcher()
    return text.replace(re, findState.re ? findState.rep : () => findState.rep)
  }
  function replaceOne(status) {
    const re = findMatcher()
    if (!re) return
    const text = cellSearchText(sh, sel.r, sel.c)
    re.lastIndex = 0
    if (!text || !re.test(text)) return findNext(status)
    const cell = sh.get(sel.r, sel.c)
    const src = findState.look === "formulas" && cell?.f != null ? "=" + cell.f : editText(sel.r, sel.c)
    const out = replaceIn(src)
    doOps([{ t: "cells", s: sh.id, d: [[sel.r, sel.c, inputPatch(sh, sel.r, sel.c, out)]] }], { label: t("Replace", "استبدال") })
    findNext(status)
  }
  function replaceAll(status) {
    const hits = findAll()
    const bySheet = new Map()
    for (const hit of hits) {
      const sheet = wb.byId.get(hit.sid)
      const cell = sheet.get(hit.r, hit.c)
      if (!cell) continue
      if (sheet.protect && !styleOf(cell.s).ul) continue
      const src = findState.look === "formulas" && cell.f != null ? "=" + cell.f : cell.f != null ? null : editText.call(null, hit.r, hit.c)
      if (src == null) continue
      const out = replaceIn(sheet === sh ? src : plainText(cell.v))
      if (out === src) continue
      if (!bySheet.has(hit.sid)) bySheet.set(hit.sid, [])
      bySheet.get(hit.sid).push([hit.r, hit.c, inputPatch(sheet, hit.r, hit.c, out)])
    }
    const ops = [...bySheet].map(([sid, d]) => ({ t: "cells", s: sid, d }))

  function selectSpecial(kind) {
    const scope = sel.ranges.length === 1 && lastRange().r1 === lastRange().r2 && lastRange().c1 === lastRange().c2 ? sh.usedRange(true) || R0() : boundedRect(lastRange())
    const pick = []
    if (kind === "region") {
      const g = currentRegion(sel.r, sel.c)
      if (g) setRange(g, sel)
      return
    }
    if (kind === "last") {
      const u = sh.usedRange(true)
      if (u) setSel(u.r2, u.c2)
      return
    }
    for (let r = scope.r1; r <= Math.min(scope.r2, scope.r1 + 100000); r++) {
      if (kind === "visible" && sh.rows.isHidden(r)) continue
      for (let c = scope.c1; c <= Math.min(scope.c2, scope.c1 + 1000); c++) {
        const cell = sh.get(r, c)
        let ok = false
        switch (kind) {
          case "blanks":
            ok = !sh.hasContent(r, c) && !sh.spillOwner.has(ck(r, c))
            break
          case "constants":
            ok = !!cell && cell.f == null && cell.v != null && cell.v !== ""
            break
          case "formulas":
            ok = !!cell && cell.f != null
            break
          case "errors":
            ok = wb.getValue(sh.id, r, c) instanceof XErr
            break
          case "comments":
            ok = sh.comments.has(ck(r, c))
            break
          case "visible":
            ok = !sh.cols.isHidden(c)
            break
          case "cf":
            ok = sh.cf.some((rule) => inRanges(rule.ranges, r, c))
            break
          case "validation":
            ok = !!dvFor(sh, r, c)
            break
          case "diffrow":
            ok = cmpVals(wb.getValue(sh.id, r, c), wb.getValue(sh.id, r, scope.c1)) !== 0
            break
          default:
        }
        if (ok) pick.push({ r1: r, c1: c, r2: r, c2: c })
      }
    }
    if (!pick.length) return toast(t("No cells were found.", "لم يتم العثور على خلايا."))
    // merge horizontal runs to keep the selection compact
    const merged = []
    for (const g of pick) {
      const last = merged[merged.length - 1]
      if (last && last.r1 === g.r1 && last.r2 === g.r2 && last.c2 === g.c1 - 1) last.c2 = g.c2
      else merged.push({ ...g })
    }
    sel.ranges = merged.slice(0, 5000)
    sel.ri = 0
    sel.r = merged[0].r1
    sel.c = merged[0].c1
    scrollToCell(sel.r, sel.c)
    selChanged()
    toast(t(`${pick.length} cell(s) selected.`, `تم تحديد ${pick.length} خلية.`))
  }

  function trace(dependents) {

    if (dependents) {
      const deps = wb.calc.dependents(g)
      if (!deps.size) return toast(t("This cell has no dependent formulas.", "لا توجد صيغ تعتمد على هذه الخلية."))
      for (const d of deps) {
        if (gkSid(d) !== sh.id) {
          toast(t("Some dependents are on other sheets: ", "بعض التابعات في أوراق أخرى: ") + wb.sheetName(gkSid(d)) + "!" + addr(gkR(d), gkC(d)))

        traces.push({ sid: sh.id, from: { r1: sel.r, c1: sel.c, r2: sel.r, c2: sel.c }, to: { r: gkR(d), c: gkC(d) }, color: colors.ok })

      const info = wb.calc.precedentsOf(g)
      if (!info) return toast(t("This cell has no formula precedents.", "لا توجد سابقات صيغة لهذه الخلية."))
      const err = wb.getValue(sh.id, sel.r, sel.c) instanceof XErr
      for (const k of info.cells) {

      }

  /* Evaluate Formula: shows every part of the active cell's formula with its value. */
  function evaluateDialog() {
    const cell = sh.get(sel.r, sel.c)
    if (!cell?.f) return toast(t("The active cell does not contain a formula.", "الخلية النشطة لا تحتوي على صيغة."))
    let ast
    try {
      ast = parseFormula(cell.f, sel.r, sel.c)
    } catch (e) {
      return alertBox(e.message)
    }
    const show = (v) => {
      if (v instanceof Ref) return v.single ? plainText(wb.getValue(v.sid, v.r1, v.c1)) : `{${rectAddr(v.r1, v.c1, v.r2, v.c2)}: ${wb.rangeMat(v).flat().slice(0, 8).map(plainText).join(", ")}${v.h * v.w > 8 ? ", …" : ""}}`
      if (v instanceof Mat) return "{" + v.v.slice(0, 4).map((r) => r.slice(0, 6).map(plainText).join(", ")).join("; ") + (v.h > 4 ? "; …" : "") + "}"
      if (v instanceof Lambda) return "LAMBDA"
      if (v === MISSING) return t("(missing)", "(مفقود)")
      return typeof v === "string" ? '"' + v + '"' : plainText(v)
    }
    const text = (n) => {
      switch (n.k) {
        case "num":
          return numText(n.v)
        case "str":
          return '"' + n.v + '"'
        case "bool":
          return n.v ? "TRUE" : "FALSE"
        case "err":
          return n.v.code
        case "ref":
          return (n.sh ? quoteSheet(n.sh) + "!" : "") + rectAddr(n.ar1 ? n.r1 : sel.r + n.r1, n.ac1 ? n.c1 : sel.c + n.c1, n.ar2 ? n.r2 : sel.r + n.r2, n.ac2 ? n.c2 : sel.c + n.c2)
        case "name":
          return n.n
        case "fn":
          return n.n + "(" + n.args.map(text).join(", ") + ")"
        case "bin":
          return text(n.a) + n.op + text(n.b)
        case "un":
          return n.op + text(n.a)
        case "paren":
          return "(" + text(n.a) + ")"
        case "pct":
          return text(n.a) + "%"
        default:
          return "…"
      }
    }
    const tree = h("ul.ds-evaltree")
    const walk = (n, parent, depth) => {
      if (depth > 30) return
      let v
      try {
        v = evalAst(n, wb, sh.id, sel.r, sel.c)
      } catch {
        v = ERR.VALUE
      }
      const li = h("li", h("code", text(n)), h("span", " = "), h("b", show(v)))
      parent.append(li)
      const kids = n.k === "fn" ? n.args : n.k === "bin" ? [n.a, n.b] : n.k === "un" || n.k === "paren" || n.k === "pct" ? [n.a] : []
      if (kids.some((k) => k.k !== "num" && k.k !== "str" && k.k !== "bool")) {
        const ul = h("ul")
        li.append(ul)
        for (const k of kids) walk(k, ul, depth + 1)
      }
    }
    walk(ast, tree, 0)
    dialog({ title: t("Evaluate formula", "تقييم الصيغة") + " · " + addr(sel.r, sel.c), wide: true, body: h("div", h("code.ds-mono", "=" + cell.f), tree), buttons: [{ label: t("Close", "إغلاق"), primary: true }] })
  }

  /* ---------- flash fill: learn a string program from examples ---------- */
  function flashTokens(s) {

  function flashAtoms(srcs) {

      }
      case "ini": {

      case "after":

      case "afterLast":

    for (let p = 0; p < n; p++) {

        const cost = best[p].cost + a.cost + (prefer && a.k === prefer ? -0.05 : 0)

      const q = p + 1
      const cost = best[p].cost + 2
      if (!best[q] || cost < best[q].cost) {

        const last = prog[prog.length - 1]

  /* ---------- writing a block of data (imports, queries) ---------- */
  /* rows: array of arrays (first row = headers when asTable). Returns the written rect. */
  function writeBlock(sheet, r0, c0, rows, opts = {}) {
    const d = []
    rows.forEach((row, i) =>
      row.forEach((v, j) => {
        if (v === undefined) return
        const r = r0 + i
        const c = c0 + j
        if (r >= MAXR || c >= MAXC) return
        if (v == null || v === "") d.push([r, c, { v: null, f: null }])
        else if (typeof v === "number" || typeof v === "boolean") d.push([r, c, { v, f: null }])
        else if (opts.typed !== false && i > 0) d.push([r, c, { ...inputPatch(sheet, r, c, String(v)), f: null }])
        else d.push([r, c, { v: String(v), f: null }])
      })
    )
    const w = Math.max(1, ...rows.map((r) => r.length))
    const rect = { r1: r0, c1: c0, r2: r0 + Math.max(1, rows.length) - 1, c2: c0 + w - 1 }
    const ops = [{ t: "cells", s: sheet.id, d }]
    if (opts.clearRect) ops.unshift({ t: "clear", s: sheet.id, rects: [opts.clearRect], what: "contents" })
    if (opts.asTable && rows.length) {
      const columns = []
      for (const h0 of rows[0]) {
        let name = String(h0 ?? "").trim() || "Column" + (columns.length + 1)
        let u = name
        let k = 2
        while (columns.some((x) => x.toLowerCase() === u.toLowerCase())) u = name + k++
        columns.push(u)
      }
      const existing = opts.tableName && sheet.tables.find((x) => x.name === opts.tableName)
      const tb = { ...(existing || {}), name: existing ? existing.name : uniqueTableName(opts.tableName || "Table1"), r1: r0, c1: c0, r2: rect.r2, c2: rect.c2, header: true, totals: false, columns, style: existing?.style || "medium-2", banded: true, filter: true, fcols: {} }
      ops.push({ t: "meta", s: sheet.id, k: "tables", v: [...sheet.tables.filter((x) => x !== existing), tb] })
      rect.table = tb.name
    }
    return { ops, rect }
  }

  async function erpCall(method, args, opts = {}) {

      method: opts.get ? "GET" : "POST",

      body: opts.get ? undefined : new URLSearchParams(Object.entries(args).map(([k, v]) => [k, typeof v === "string" ? v : JSON.stringify(v)])),
    })
    const body = await res.json().catch(() => ({}))
    if (!res.ok || body.exc) {
      let msg = ""
      try {
        msg = JSON.parse(JSON.parse(body._server_messages || "[]")[0] || "{}").message || ""
      } catch {
        /* none */
      }
      throw new Error(String(msg || body.exception || res.statusText || "Request failed").replace(/<[^>]+>/g, "").slice(0, 300))

  async function runErpQuery(q) {
    if (q.kind === "report") {

      const cols = (res.columns || []).map((c) => (typeof c === "string" ? { label: c.split(":")[0], fieldname: c.split(":")[0] } : { label: c.label || c.fieldname, fieldname: c.fieldname || c.label }))

      for (const row of res.result || []) {

      return rows

    const fields = q.fields?.length ? q.fields : ["name"]

  async function runSource(q) {

      const sid = r?.sheet != null ? wb.sheetId(r.sheet) : q.sid
      if (!r || sid == null) throw new Error(t("The source range no longer exists.", "نطاق المصدر لم يعد موجودًا."))
      const s = wb.byId.get(sid)
      const m = wb.rangeMat(new Ref(sid, r.r1, r.c1, Math.min(r.r2, s.maxR), Math.min(r.c2, s.maxC)))
      return m.v.map((row) => row.map((v) => (v instanceof XErr ? v.code : v)))

    const text = await res.text()
    if (/json/.test(type) || /^\s*[[{]/.test(text)) return jsonToRows(JSON.parse(text), q.path)
    if (/html/.test(type) || /<table/i.test(text)) {
      const tables = new DOMParser().parseFromString(text, "text/html").querySelectorAll("table")
      const tb = tables[q.tableIndex || 0]
      if (!tb) throw new Error(t("No table was found on that page.", "لم يتم العثور على جدول في تلك الصفحة."))
      return [...tb.rows].map((tr) => [...tr.cells].map((td) => td.textContent.trim()))
    }
    return parseDelimited(text, detectDelimiter(text))

  }
  function jsonToRows(data, path) {
    if (path) for (const k of path.split(".").filter(Boolean)) data = data?.[k]
    if (Array.isArray(data) && data.length && Array.isArray(data[0])) return data
    if (Array.isArray(data)) {
      const flat = data.map((x) => flattenObj(x))
      const keys = []
      for (const o of flat) for (const k of Object.keys(o)) if (!keys.includes(k)) keys.push(k)
      return [keys, ...flat.map((o) => keys.map((k) => o[k] ?? null))]
    }
    if (data && typeof data === "object") {
      const vals = Object.values(data)
      if (vals.length && vals.every(Array.isArray)) {
        const keys = Object.keys(data)
        const n = Math.max(...vals.map((v) => v.length))
        return [keys, ...Array.from({ length: n }, (_, i) => keys.map((k) => data[k][i] ?? null))]
      }
      const flat = flattenObj(data)
      return [[t("Key", "المفتاح"), t("Value", "القيمة")], ...Object.entries(flat)]
    }
    return [[data]]
  }
  function flattenObj(o, pre = "", out = {}) {
    if (o == null || typeof o !== "object") {
      out[pre || "value"] = o
      return out
    }
    for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(o)) {
      const key = pre ? pre + "." + k : k
      if (v && typeof v === "object" && !Array.isArray(v)) flattenObj(v, key, out)
      else out[key] = Array.isArray(v) ? v.map((x) => (typeof x === "object" ? JSON.stringify(x) : x)).join(", ") : v
    }
    return out
  }

  /* ---------- queries: transform steps (Power Query style) ---------- */
  const STEP_LABEL = () => ({
    removeCols: t("Remove columns", "إزالة أعمدة"),
    keepCols: t("Keep columns", "الاحتفاظ بأعمدة"),
    rename: t("Rename column", "إعادة تسمية عمود"),
    filter: t("Filter rows", "تصفية الصفوف"),
    sort: t("Sort", "فرز"),
    type: t("Change type", "تغيير النوع"),
    trim: t("Trim text", "قص النص"),
    upper: t("UPPERCASE", "أحرف كبيرة"),
    lower: t("lowercase", "أحرف صغيرة"),
    replace: t("Replace values", "استبدال القيم"),
    split: t("Split column", "تقسيم عمود"),
    merge: t("Merge columns", "دمج أعمدة"),
    addCol: t("Add column", "إضافة عمود"),
    group: t("Group by", "تجميع حسب"),
    dedupe: t("Remove duplicates", "إزالة التكرارات"),
    fillDown: t("Fill down", "تعبئة لأسفل"),
    top: t("Keep top rows", "الاحتفاظ بالصفوف العليا"),
    unpivot: t("Unpivot columns", "إلغاء تمحور الأعمدة"),
    removeBlank: t("Remove blank rows", "إزالة الصفوف الفارغة"),
  })
  function applySteps(rows, steps) {
    let head = rows[0] ? rows[0].map((x) => String(x ?? "")) : []
    let body = rows.slice(1).map((r) => head.map((_, i) => r[i] ?? null))
    const ci = (name) => head.findIndex((x) => x.toLowerCase() === String(name).toLowerCase())
    for (const s of steps) {
      switch (s.op) {
        case "removeCols":
        case "keepCols": {
          const idx = s.cols.map(ci).filter((i) => i >= 0)
          const keep = head.map((_, i) => (s.op === "removeCols" ? !idx.includes(i) : idx.includes(i)))
          head = head.filter((_, i) => keep[i])
          body = body.map((r) => r.filter((_, i) => keep[i]))
          break
        }
        case "rename": {
          const i = ci(s.col)
          if (i >= 0) head[i] = s.to
          break
        }
        case "filter": {
          const i = ci(s.col)
          if (i < 0) break
          body = body.filter((r) => filterPasses({ cond: { op: s.cmp, a: s.a, b: s.b } }, r[i], r[i] == null ? "" : String(r[i])))
          break
        }
        case "sort": {
          const i = ci(s.col)
          if (i >= 0) body.sort((a, b) => cmpVals(a[i], b[i]) * (s.desc ? -1 : 1))
          break
        }
        case "type": {
          const i = ci(s.col)
          if (i < 0) break
          for (const r of body) {
            const v = r[i]
            if (s.to === "number") r[i] = typeof v === "number" ? v : textToNumber(String(v ?? "")) ?? null
            else if (s.to === "text") r[i] = v == null ? null : plainText(v)
            else if (s.to === "date") r[i] = typeof v === "number" ? Math.floor(v) : parseDateText(String(v ?? ""))?.v ?? null
            else if (s.to === "bool") r[i] = v == null ? null : toBool(v) === true
          }
          break
        }
        case "trim":
        case "upper":
        case "lower": {
          const i = ci(s.col)
          for (const r of body) if (typeof r[i] === "string") r[i] = s.op === "trim" ? r[i].trim().replace(/\s+/g, " ") : s.op === "upper" ? r[i].toUpperCase() : r[i].toLowerCase()
          break
        }
        case "replace": {
          const i = ci(s.col)
          for (const r of body) if (r[i] != null && plainText(r[i]) === String(s.find)) r[i] = s.rep
          break
        }
        case "split": {
          const i = ci(s.col)
          if (i < 0) break
          const parts = body.map((r) => String(r[i] ?? "").split(s.sep || ","))
          const n = Math.max(1, ...parts.map((p) => p.length))
          head.splice(i, 1, ...Array.from({ length: n }, (_, k) => head[i] + "." + (k + 1)))
          body = body.map((r, k) => [...r.slice(0, i), ...Array.from({ length: n }, (_, j) => (parts[k][j] ?? "").trim() || null), ...r.slice(i + 1)])
          break
        }
        case "merge": {
          const idx = s.cols.map(ci).filter((i) => i >= 0)
          head.push(s.name || idx.map((i) => head[i]).join(" "))
          for (const r of body) r.push(idx.map((i) => plainText(r[i])).join(s.sep ?? " "))
          break
        }
        case "addCol": {
          // {Column} placeholders; numeric expressions are evaluated with the formula engine
          head.push(s.name || "Custom")
          for (const r of body) {
            let expr = String(s.expr || "").replace(/\{([^}]+)\}/g, (_, n) => {
              const v = r[ci(n)]
              return typeof v === "number" ? String(v) : JSON.stringify(plainText(v ?? ""))
            })
            let v = expr
            try {
              const ast = parseFormula(expr.replace(/^=/, ""))
              v = evalAst(ast, wb, sh.id, 0, 0)
              if (v instanceof XErr) v = v.code
              else if (v instanceof Mat || v instanceof Ref) v = null
            } catch {
              /* plain text */
            }
            r.push(v)
          }
          break
        }
        case "group": {
          const keys = s.by.map(ci).filter((i) => i >= 0)
          const groups = new Map()
          for (const r of body) {
            const k = keys.map((i) => lookupKey(r[i])).join("\u0001")
            if (!groups.has(k)) groups.set(k, { key: keys.map((i) => r[i]), rows: [] })
            groups.get(k).rows.push(r)
          }
          const aggs = s.aggs.map((a) => ({ ...a, i: ci(a.col) }))
          head = [...keys.map((i) => head[i]), ...aggs.map((a) => a.name || a.fn + " of " + a.col)]
          body = [...groups.values()].map((g) => [
            ...g.key,
            ...aggs.map((a) => {
              const nums = g.rows.map((r) => r[a.i]).filter((v) => typeof v === "number")
              switch (a.fn) {
                case "count":
                  return g.rows.length
                case "sum":
                  return nums.reduce((x, y) => x + y, 0)
                case "avg":
                  return nums.length ? nums.reduce((x, y) => x + y, 0) / nums.length : null
                case "min":
                  return nums.length ? Math.min(...nums) : null
                case "max":
                  return nums.length ? Math.max(...nums) : null
                case "distinct":
                  return new Set(g.rows.map((r) => lookupKey(r[a.i]))).size
                default:
                  return null
              }
            }),
          ])
          break
        }
        case "dedupe": {
          const seen = new Set()
          body = body.filter((r) => {
            const k = r.map(lookupKey).join("\u0001")
            if (seen.has(k)) return false
            seen.add(k)
            return true
          })
          break
        }
        case "fillDown": {
          const i = ci(s.col)
          let last = null
          for (const r of body) {
            if (r[i] == null || r[i] === "") r[i] = last
            else last = r[i]
          }
          break
        }
        case "top":
          body = body.slice(0, Math.max(0, +s.n || 0))
          break
        case "removeBlank":
          body = body.filter((r) => r.some((v) => v != null && v !== ""))
          break
        case "unpivot": {
          const keep = s.keep.map(ci).filter((i) => i >= 0)
          const others = head.map((_, i) => i).filter((i) => !keep.includes(i))
          const nh = [...keep.map((i) => head[i]), t("Attribute", "السمة"), t("Value", "القيمة")]
          const nb = []
          for (const r of body) for (const i of others) nb.push([...keep.map((k) => r[k]), head[i], r[i]])
          head = nh
          body = nb
          break
        }
        default:
      }
    }
    return [head, ...body]
  }

  let selectedObject = null // { kind: "chart" | "slicer", id }

  /* Called every frame: position object elements over the grid. */
  function placeObjects() {
    if (!ui.objects || !G) return
    const z = G.z
    ui.objects.style.clipPath = `inset(${(G.top0 + G.FH) * z}px 0 0 ${(G.left0 + G.FW) * z}px)`
    // objects live in the main (bottom-right) pane, whichever split pane is active
    const ap = G.ap
    G.ap = {}
    const rects = new Map(sheetObjects().map((o) => [o.id, objectRect(o)]))
    G.ap = ap
    for (const o of sheetObjects()) {
      const el = objEls.get(o.id)
      if (!el) continue
      const r = rects.get(o.id)
      el.style.transform = `translate(${r.x * z}px, ${r.y * z}px)`
      el.style.width = r.w * z + "px"
      el.style.height = r.h * z + "px"
      el.style.setProperty("--z", z)
    }
  }

      } else {

    for (const [id, el] of objEls)

  }
  const handlesHTML = () => '<i class="ds-hdl nw"></i><i class="ds-hdl n"></i><i class="ds-hdl ne"></i><i class="ds-hdl e"></i><i class="ds-hdl se"></i><i class="ds-hdl s"></i><i class="ds-hdl sw"></i><i class="ds-hdl w"></i>'
  function findObject(id) {
    return sh.charts.find((o) => o.id === id) ? { kind: "chart", list: "charts", o: sh.charts.find((o) => o.id === id) } : sh.slicers.find((o) => o.id === id) ? { kind: "slicer", list: "slicers", o: sh.slicers.find((o) => o.id === id) } : null
  }
  function selectObject(id) {
    selectedObject = id ? { id, kind: findObject(id)?.kind } : null
    for (const [oid, el] of objEls) el.classList.toggle("on", oid === id)
    updateContextTabs()
    renderTabs()
    renderRibbon()
    if (selectedObject?.kind === "chart" && sidePanel?.id === "chart") chartPanel(id)
  }
  function updateObject(id, patch, label) {
    const f = findObject(id)
    if (!f) return
    doOps([{ t: "meta", s: sh.id, k: f.list, v: sh[f.list].map((o) => (o.id === id ? { ...o, ...patch } : o)) }], { label: label || t("Object", "كائن") })
  }
  function deleteObject(id) {
    const f = findObject(id)
    if (!f) return
    doOps([{ t: "meta", s: sh.id, k: f.list, v: sh[f.list].filter((o) => o.id !== id) }], { label: t("Delete", "حذف") })
    selectObject(null)
    if (sidePanel?.id === "chart") closePanel()
  }
  /* Drag to move, handles to resize; positions snap to a cell + offset anchor. */
  function bindObject(el, id) {
    el.addEventListener("pointerdown", (e) => {
      if (e.target.closest(".ds-slicerbtn,.ds-slicerclear")) return
      e.preventDefault()
      e.stopPropagation()
      closePopups()
      if (edit.active) commitEdit(null)
      selectObject(id)
      el.focus({ preventScroll: true })
      const f = findObject(id)
      if (!f || readOnlyNow() || (sh.protect && !sh.protect.allow?.objects)) return
      const hdl = e.target.closest(".ds-hdl")
      const dir = hdl ? [...hdl.classList].find((c) => c !== "ds-hdl") : null
      const start = { x: e.clientX, y: e.clientY, rect: objectRect(f.o) }
      let moved = false
      const move = (ev) => {
        const dx = (ev.clientX - start.x) / G.z
        const dy = (ev.clientY - start.y) / G.z
        if (Math.abs(dx) + Math.abs(dy) > 2) moved = true
        let { x, y, w, h: hh } = start.rect
        if (!dir) {
          x += dx
          y += dy
        } else {
          if (dir.includes("e")) w = Math.max(80, w + dx)
          if (dir.includes("s")) hh = Math.max(60, hh + dy)
          if (dir.includes("w")) {
            w = Math.max(80, w - dx)
            x = start.rect.x + start.rect.w - w
          }
          if (dir.includes("n")) {
            hh = Math.max(60, hh - dy)
            y = start.rect.y + start.rect.h - hh
          }
        }
        el.style.transform = `translate(${x * G.z}px, ${y * G.z}px)`
        el.style.width = w * G.z + "px"
        el.style.height = hh * G.z + "px"

      window.addEventListener("pointermove", move)
      window.addEventListener("pointerup", up)
    })
    el.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
      if (e.target.closest(".ds-slicerbtn,.ds-slicerclear") && !readOnlyNow()) slicerClick(el, e)
    })
    el.addEventListener("dblclick", () => {
      const f = findObject(id)
      if (f?.kind === "chart") chartPanel(id)
    })
    el.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {

      } else if (e.key === "Escape") {

      } else if (e.key.startsWith("Arrow") && !readOnlyNow()) {
        e.preventDefault()

        const r = objectRect(f.o)
        const step = e.shiftKey ? 10 : 1
        updateObject(id, { anchor: anchorAt(r.x + (e.key === "ArrowLeft" ? -step : e.key === "ArrowRight" ? step : 0), r.y + (e.key === "ArrowUp" ? -step : e.key === "ArrowDown" ? step : 0)) })
      }
    })
    el.addEventListener("contextmenu", (e) => {
      e.preventDefault()
      e.stopPropagation()
      const f = findObject(id)
      const rb = ui.root.getBoundingClientRect()
      menu(
        [
          f?.kind === "chart" ? { label: t("Format chart…", "تنسيق المخطط…"), icon: "chart", run: () => chartPanel(id) } : null,
          f?.kind === "chart" ? { label: t("Download as image", "تنزيل كصورة"), icon: "download", run: () => chartPng(f.o) } : null,
          { label: t("Delete", "حذف"), icon: "trash", disabled: readOnlyNow(), run: () => deleteObject(id) },
        ],
        { x: e.clientX - rb.left, y: e.clientY - rb.top }
      )
    })
  }
  /* Position (unscaled, stage coordinates) → anchor {r, c, dx, dy}. */
  function anchorAt(x, y) {
    const cx = Math.max(G.left0 + G.FW, x)
    const cy = Math.max(G.top0 + G.FH, y)
    const c = sh.cols.index(sh.cols.pos(G.fc) + G.sx + (cx - G.left0 - G.FW), MAXC)
    const r = sh.rows.index(sh.rows.pos(G.fr) + G.sy + (cy - G.top0 - G.FH), MAXR)
    return { r, c, dx: Math.round(x - xOf(c)), dy: Math.round(y - yOf(r)) }
  }

  /* ---------- chart data ---------- */
  function refRows(text, defaultSid) {
    if (!text) return null
    const r = parseA1(String(text).replace(/^=/, ""))
    if (!r) {
      const nm = wb.name(String(text).toUpperCase(), defaultSid)
      if (nm) return refRows(nm.ref, defaultSid)
      return null
    }
    const sid = r.sheet != null ? wb.sheetId(r.sheet) : defaultSid
    if (sid == null) return null
    const s = wb.byId.get(sid)
    const ref = new Ref(sid, r.r1, r.c1, Math.min(r.r2, Math.max(s.maxR, r.r1)), Math.min(r.c2, Math.max(s.maxC, r.c1)))
    return { ref, m: wb.rangeMat(ref), sheet: s }
  }
  function chartData(ch) {
    const src = refRows(ch.src, sh.id)
    if (!src) return { cats: [], series: [], fmt: null }
    let m = src.m.v
    const s = src.sheet
    const nf = styleOf(s.styleIdAt(src.ref.r1 + (m.length > 1 ? 1 : 0), src.ref.c2)).nf || null
    const catNf = styleOf(s.styleIdAt(src.ref.r1 + (m.length > 1 ? 1 : 0), src.ref.c1)).nf || null
    if (ch.byRow) m = m[0].map((_, c) => m.map((row) => row[c]))
    // headers: the first row is a header when any of its cells (after the first) is text
    const hasHead = ch.header ?? (m.length > 1 && m[0].slice(1).some((v) => typeof v === "string"))
    // categories: the first column when it is text/dates or the chart is scatter
    const firstColCats = m[0] && m[0].length > 1 && (ch.type === "scatter" || m.slice(hasHead ? 1 : 0).some((r) => typeof r[0] === "string") || (catNf && compileFormat(catNf)?.isDate))
    const body = m.slice(hasHead ? 1 : 0)
    const cats = firstColCats ? body.map((r) => (r[0] == null ? "" : typeof r[0] === "number" ? formatValue(r[0], catNf).t : plainText(r[0]))) : body.map((_, i) => String(i + 1))
    const catVals = firstColCats ? body.map((r) => r[0]) : body.map((_, i) => i + 1)
    const start = firstColCats ? 1 : 0
    const series = []
    for (let c = start; c < (m[0]?.length || 0); c++) {
      const name = hasHead ? plainText(m[0][c]) || t("Series ", "سلسلة ") + (c - start + 1) : t("Series ", "سلسلة ") + (c - start + 1)
      const vals = body.map((r) => (typeof r[c] === "number" ? r[c] : r[c] instanceof XErr || r[c] == null || r[c] === "" ? null : textToNumber(String(r[c]))))
      const conf = (ch.seriesConf || [])[c - start] || {}
      series.push({ name: conf.name || name, vals, type: conf.type, axis: conf.axis, color: conf.color })
    }
    return { cats, catVals, series, fmt: ch.yFmt || nf, catNf }
  }
  function niceScale(lo, hi, ticks = 5) {
    if (lo === hi) {
      lo = lo === 0 ? 0 : lo - Math.abs(lo) * 0.5
      hi = hi === 0 ? 1 : hi + Math.abs(hi) * 0.5
    }
    const span = hi - lo
    const raw = span / ticks
    const mag = Math.pow(10, Math.floor(Math.log10(raw)))
    const step = [1, 2, 2.5, 5, 10].map((k) => k * mag).find((s) => span / s <= ticks + 0.5) || 10 * mag
    const min = Math.floor(lo / step) * step
    const max = Math.ceil(hi / step) * step
    const out = []
    for (let v = min; v <= max + step / 2; v += step) out.push(roundDec(v, 10))
    return { min, max, step, ticks: out }
  }
  function chartColors(ch) {
    if (ch.colors?.length) return ch.colors
    const base = docTheme().colors
    return [...base, ...base.map((c) => tint(c, 0.4)), ...base.map((c) => tint(c, -0.3))]
  }
  /* The SVG for a chart at its own size (w × h). */
  function chartSVG(ch) {
    const W2 = ch.w || 480
    const H2 = ch.h || 288
    const dark = !ch._light && ui.root.dataset.theme === "dark"
    const fg = ch.fg || (dark ? "#e5e7eb" : "#1f2937")
    const sub = dark ? "#9ca3af" : "#6b7280"
    const gridC = dark ? "#374151" : "#e5e7eb"
    const bg = ch.bg || (dark ? "#111827" : "#ffffff")
    const colors = chartColors(ch)
    const data = chartData(ch)
    const fmt = (v) => (data.fmt ? formatValue(v, data.fmt).t : Math.abs(v) >= 1e6 ? numText(roundDec(v / 1e6, 2)) + "M" : Math.abs(v) >= 1e4 ? numText(roundDec(v / 1e3, 1)) + "K" : numText(roundDec(v, 2)))
    const font = `font-family="Segoe UI, system-ui, sans-serif"`
    let out = `<svg viewBox="0 0 ${W2} ${H2}" width="100%" height="100%" preserveAspectRatio="none" ${font} xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="${W2}" height="${H2}" rx="6" fill="${bg}" stroke="${dark ? "#374151" : "#d1d5db"}"/>`
    let top = 10
    const title = ch.title ?? (data.series.length === 1 ? data.series[0].name : "")
    if (title) {
      out += `<text x="${W2 / 2}" y="${top + 16}" text-anchor="middle" font-size="15" font-weight="600" fill="${fg}">${esc(title)}</text>`
      top += 28
    }
    if (!data.series.length || !data.cats.length) return out + `<text x="${W2 / 2}" y="${H2 / 2}" text-anchor="middle" font-size="13" fill="${sub}">${esc(t("Select data with numbers to chart", "حدد بيانات بها أرقام لإنشاء مخطط"))}</text></svg>`
    const type = ch.type || "column"
    const pie = type === "pie" || type === "doughnut"
    const legendPos = ch.legend || (pie || data.series.length > 1 ? "bottom" : "none")
    const legendItems = pie ? data.cats.map((c, i) => [c, colors[i % colors.length]]) : data.series.map((s, i) => [s.name, s.color || colors[i % colors.length]])
    let left = 10
    let right = W2 - 10
    let bottom = H2 - 10
    // legend
    let legendSvg = ""
    if (legendPos !== "none") {
      if (legendPos === "bottom" || legendPos === "top") {
        let x = 0
        const items = legendItems.map(([name, col]) => {
          const label = String(name).slice(0, 24)
          const w = 18 + label.length * 6.4 + 10
          const it = { label, col, x, w }
          x += w
          return it
        })
        const total = x
        const ly = legendPos === "bottom" ? bottom - 12 : top + 4
        const x0 = Math.max(10, (W2 - total) / 2)
        for (const it of items) legendSvg += `<rect x="${x0 + it.x}" y="${ly - 9}" width="11" height="11" rx="2" fill="${it.col}"/><text x="${x0 + it.x + 15}" y="${ly}" font-size="11" fill="${fg}">${esc(it.label)}</text>`
        if (legendPos === "bottom") bottom -= 24
        else top += 22
      } else {
        const lw = Math.min(150, Math.max(...legendItems.map(([n]) => String(n).length)) * 6.4 + 30)
        const lx = legendPos === "right" ? right - lw + 6 : left
        legendItems.slice(0, 20).forEach(([name, col], i) => (legendSvg += `<rect x="${lx}" y="${top + 6 + i * 18}" width="11" height="11" rx="2" fill="${col}"/><text x="${lx + 15}" y="${top + 15 + i * 18}" font-size="11" fill="${fg}">${esc(String(name).slice(0, 22))}</text>`))
        if (legendPos === "right") right -= lw
        else left += lw
      }
    }
    out += legendSvg
    if (pie) {
      const vals = data.series[0].vals.map((v) => Math.max(0, v || 0))
      const total = vals.reduce((s, v) => s + v, 0) || 1
      const cx = (left + right) / 2
      const cy = (top + bottom) / 2
      const R = Math.max(10, Math.min(right - left, bottom - top) / 2 - 8)
      const inner = type === "doughnut" ? R * 0.55 : 0
      let a0 = -Math.PI / 2
      vals.forEach((v, i) => {
        const a1 = a0 + (v / total) * Math.PI * 2
        const large = a1 - a0 > Math.PI ? 1 : 0
        const p = (a, r) => [cx + r * Math.cos(a), cy + r * Math.sin(a)]
        const [x1, y1] = p(a0, R)
        const [x2, y2] = p(a1, R)
        let d
        if (v / total > 0.9999) d = `M${cx - R},${cy}A${R},${R} 0 1 1 ${cx + R},${cy}A${R},${R} 0 1 1 ${cx - R},${cy}` + (inner ? `M${cx - inner},${cy}A${inner},${inner} 0 1 0 ${cx + inner},${cy}A${inner},${inner} 0 1 0 ${cx - inner},${cy}` : "")
        else if (inner) {
          const [x3, y3] = p(a1, inner)
          const [x4, y4] = p(a0, inner)
          d = `M${x1},${y1}A${R},${R} 0 ${large} 1 ${x2},${y2}L${x3},${y3}A${inner},${inner} 0 ${large} 0 ${x4},${y4}Z`
        } else d = `M${cx},${cy}L${x1},${y1}A${R},${R} 0 ${large} 1 ${x2},${y2}Z`
        out += `<path d="${d}" fill="${colors[i % colors.length]}" stroke="${bg}" stroke-width="1.5" fill-rule="evenodd"><title>${esc(data.cats[i])}: ${esc(fmt(v))} (${roundDec((v / total) * 100, 1)}%)</title></path>`
        if ((ch.labels ?? true) && v / total > 0.04) {
          const [lx, ly] = p((a0 + a1) / 2, inner ? (R + inner) / 2 : R * 0.65)
          out += `<text x="${lx}" y="${ly + 4}" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" font-weight="600" fill="${readableOn(colors[i % colors.length])}">${roundDec((v / total) * 100, 0)}%</text>`
        }
        a0 = a1
      })
      return out + "</svg>"
    }
    const horizontal = type === "bar" || type === "stackedBar" || type === "percentBar"
    const stacked = /^stacked|^percent/.test(type)
    const percent = /^percent/.test(type)
    const scatter = type === "scatter"
    const seriesType = (s, i) => (type === "combo" ? s.type || (i === 0 ? "column" : "line") : s.type || (type.includes("ine") ? "line" : type.includes("rea") ? "area" : scatter ? "scatter" : horizontal ? "bar" : "column"))
    const secondary = data.series.some((s) => s.axis === "secondary")
    // value ranges
    const n = data.cats.length
    const rangeOf = (filter) => {
      let lo = 0
      let hi = 0
      if (stacked) {
        for (let k = 0; k < n; k++) {
          let pos = 0
          let neg = 0
          for (const s of data.series.filter(filter)) {
            const v = s.vals[k] || 0
            if (v >= 0) pos += v
            else neg += v
          }
          hi = Math.max(hi, pos)
          lo = Math.min(lo, neg)
        }
        if (percent) return [Math.min(0, lo ? -100 : 0), 100]
      } else
        for (const s of data.series.filter(filter))
          for (const v of s.vals)
            if (v != null) {
              hi = Math.max(hi, v)
              lo = Math.min(lo, v)
            }
      if (!stacked) {
        const all = data.series.filter(filter).flatMap((s) => s.vals.filter((v) => v != null))
        if (all.length && Math.min(...all) > 0 && (type.includes("ine") || scatter) && Math.min(...all) > (Math.max(...all) - Math.min(...all)) * 2) lo = Math.min(...all)
      }
      return [lo, hi]
    }
    const [plo, phi] = rangeOf((s) => s.axis !== "secondary")
    const sc = niceScale(ch.yMin != null && ch.yMin !== "" ? +ch.yMin : plo, ch.yMax != null && ch.yMax !== "" ? +ch.yMax : phi)
    if (ch.yMin != null && ch.yMin !== "") sc.min = +ch.yMin
    if (ch.yMax != null && ch.yMax !== "") sc.max = +ch.yMax
    sc.ticks = sc.ticks.filter((v) => v >= sc.min - 1e-9 && v <= sc.max + 1e-9)
    const sc2 = secondary ? niceScale(...rangeOf((s) => s.axis === "secondary")) : null
    // x scale for scatter
    let xs = null
    if (scatter) {
      // categories that aren't numbers plot at 1, 2, 3 …
      if (data.catVals.some((v) => typeof v !== "number")) data.catVals = data.catVals.map((_, i) => i + 1)
      const xv = data.catVals.filter((v) => typeof v === "number")
      xs = niceScale(Math.min(...xv, 0), Math.max(...xv, 1))
    }
    const tickW = Math.max(...sc.ticks.map((v) => fmt(v).length)) * 6.4 + 10
    if (ch.yTitle) left += 18
    if (ch.xTitle) bottom -= 18
    const labelEvery = Math.max(1, Math.ceil((n * 40) / Math.max(40, right - left)))
    const plot = horizontal ? { x1: left + Math.min(140, Math.max(...data.cats.map((c) => String(c).length)) * 6.2 + 12), x2: right - 8, y1: top + 4, y2: bottom - 20 } : { x1: left + tickW, x2: right - (secondary ? tickW : 8), y1: top + 6, y2: bottom - (n > 8 && !scatter ? 34 : 20) }
    const vpos = (v, s2 = sc) => (horizontal ? plot.x1 + ((v - s2.min) / (s2.max - s2.min || 1)) * (plot.x2 - plot.x1) : plot.y2 - ((v - s2.min) / (s2.max - s2.min || 1)) * (plot.y2 - plot.y1))
    const band = (horizontal ? plot.y2 - plot.y1 : plot.x2 - plot.x1) / Math.max(1, n)
    const cpos = (k) => (horizontal ? plot.y1 + band * (k + 0.5) : scatter ? plot.x1 + ((data.catVals[k] - xs.min) / (xs.max - xs.min || 1)) * (plot.x2 - plot.x1) : plot.x1 + band * (k + 0.5))
    // grid and value axis
    for (const v of sc.ticks) {
      const p = vpos(v)
      if (ch.grid !== false) out += horizontal ? `<line x1="${p}" y1="${plot.y1}" x2="${p}" y2="${plot.y2}" stroke="${gridC}"/>` : `<line x1="${plot.x1}" y1="${p}" x2="${plot.x2}" y2="${p}" stroke="${gridC}"/>`
      out += horizontal ? `<text x="${p}" y="${plot.y2 + 14}" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10.5" fill="${sub}">${esc(fmt(v))}</text>` : `<text x="${plot.x1 - 6}" y="${p + 3.5}" text-anchor="end" font-size="10.5" fill="${sub}">${esc(percent ? v + "%" : fmt(v))}</text>`
    }
    if (sc2) for (const v of sc2.ticks) out += `<text x="${plot.x2 + 6}" y="${vpos(v, sc2) + 3.5}" font-size="10.5" fill="${sub}">${esc(fmt(v))}</text>`
    // category axis
    const zero = vpos(Math.max(sc.min, Math.min(0, sc.max)))
    out += horizontal ? `<line x1="${zero}" y1="${plot.y1}" x2="${zero}" y2="${plot.y2}" stroke="${sub}"/>` : `<line x1="${plot.x1}" y1="${zero}" x2="${plot.x2}" y2="${zero}" stroke="${sub}"/>`
    if (scatter) for (const v of xs.ticks) out += `<text x="${plot.x1 + ((v - xs.min) / (xs.max - xs.min || 1)) * (plot.x2 - plot.x1)}" y="${plot.y2 + 14}" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10.5" fill="${sub}">${esc(numText(v))}</text>`
    else
      data.cats.forEach((c, k) => {
        if (k % labelEvery) return
        const label = String(c).slice(0, 18)
        if (horizontal) out += `<text x="${plot.x1 - 6}" y="${cpos(k) + 3.5}" text-anchor="end" font-size="10.5" fill="${sub}">${esc(label)}</text>`
        else if (n > 8) out += `<text transform="translate(${cpos(k)},${plot.y2 + 10}) rotate(-35)" text-anchor="end" font-size="10.5" fill="${sub}">${esc(label)}</text>`
        else out += `<text x="${cpos(k)}" y="${plot.y2 + 14}" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10.5" fill="${sub}">${esc(label)}</text>`
      })
    if (ch.yTitle) out += `<text transform="translate(${left - 4},${(plot.y1 + plot.y2) / 2}) rotate(-90)" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="${sub}">${esc(ch.yTitle)}</text>`
    if (ch.xTitle) out += `<text x="${(plot.x1 + plot.x2) / 2}" y="${bottom + 14}" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="${sub}">${esc(ch.xTitle)}</text>`
    // series
    const barSeries = data.series.map((s, i) => [s, i]).filter(([s, i]) => ["column", "bar"].includes(seriesType(s, i)))
    const stackPos = new Array(n).fill(0)

  /* ======================================================================
     What-if analysis (goal seek, scenarios, data tables), Solver, and
     macros. Trials change cell values directly and recalculate dependents,
     then everything is restored; only the final answer becomes an op.
     ====================================================================== */
  function refCell(text) {
    const r = parseA1(String(text || "").replace(/^=/, ""))
    if (!r) return null
    const sid = r.sheet != null ? wb.sheetId(r.sheet) : sh.id
    if (sid == null) return null
    return { sid, r: r.r1, c: r.c1, r2: r.r2, c2: r.c2 }
  }
  /* Temporarily set cells (no undo, no sync), returning a restore function. */
  function trial(cells) {
    const saved = []
    for (const { sid, r, c } of cells) {
      const s = wb.byId.get(sid)
      const cell = s.cells.get(ck(r, c))
      saved.push({ sid, r, c, had: !!cell, v: cell?.v, f: cell?.f, ast: cell?.ast })
    }
    const set = (values) => {
      const keys = []
      cells.forEach(({ sid, r, c }, i) => {
        const s = wb.byId.get(sid)
        let cell = s.cells.get(ck(r, c))
        if (!cell) s.cells.set(ck(r, c), (cell = { v: null, f: null, s: 0 }))
        cell.f = null
        cell.ast = undefined
        cell.v = values[i]
        s.colVer[c]++
        wb.calc.track(s, r, c, cell)
        keys.push(gk(sid, r, c))
      })
      wb.calc.run(keys)
    }
    const restore = () => {
      const keys = []
      for (const x of saved) {
        const s = wb.byId.get(x.sid)
        if (!x.had) s.cells.delete(ck(x.r, x.c))
        else {
          const cell = s.cells.get(ck(x.r, x.c))
          cell.v = x.v
          cell.f = x.f
          cell.ast = x.ast
          wb.calc.track(s, x.r, x.c, cell)
        }
        s.colVer[x.c]++
        keys.push(gk(x.sid, x.r, x.c))
      }
      wb.calc.run(keys)
      calcGen++
      invalidate()
    }
    return { set, restore }
  }
  const valueAt = (x) => wb.getValue(x.sid, x.r, x.c)

              body: h("div", h("p", res.ok ? t("Goal seeking found a solution.", "وجد استهداف الهدف حلًا.") : t("Goal seeking may not have found a solution.", "ربما لم يجد استهداف الهدف حلًا.")), h("p", t("Target value: ", "القيمة المستهدفة: ") + numText(goal)), h("p", t("Current value: ", "القيمة الحالية: ") + plainText(res.value)), h("p", t("Changing cell: ", "الخلية المتغيرة: ") + numText(res.x))),
              buttons: [{ label: t("Cancel", "إلغاء"), value: false }, { label: t("OK", "موافق"), primary: true, value: true }],
            }).done
            if (keep === true && isFinite(res.x)) doOps([{ t: "cells", s: change.sid, d: [[change.r, change.c, { v: roundDec(res.x, 12), f: null }]] }], { label: t("Goal seek", "استهداف الهدف") })

  function goalSeek(target, change, goal) {
    const tr = trial([change])
    const x0 = Number(valueAt(change)) || 0
    const f = (x) => {
      tr.set([x])
      const v = valueAt(target)
      return typeof v === "number" ? v - goal : NaN
    }
    let a = x0
    let fa = f(a)
    let b = x0 === 0 ? 1 : x0 * 1.1
    let fb = f(b)
    let x = a
    let ok = false
    // secant iterations
    for (let i = 0; i < 100 && isFinite(fa) && isFinite(fb); i++) {
      if (Math.abs(fb) < 1e-9 * Math.max(1, Math.abs(goal))) {
        x = b
        ok = true
        break
      }
      const denom = fb - fa
      if (denom === 0) break
      const next = b - (fb * (b - a)) / denom
      a = b
      fa = fb
      b = next
      fb = f(b)
      x = b
    }
    if (!ok) {
      // bracket and bisect
      let lo = x0 - Math.max(1, Math.abs(x0)) * 10
      let hi = x0 + Math.max(1, Math.abs(x0)) * 10
      let flo = f(lo)
      let fhi = f(hi)
      for (let k = 0; k < 40 && flo * fhi > 0; k++) {
        lo -= Math.abs(hi - lo)
        hi += Math.abs(hi - lo)
        flo = f(lo)
        fhi = f(hi)
      }
      if (flo * fhi <= 0) {
        for (let i = 0; i < 200; i++) {
          const m = (lo + hi) / 2
          const fm = f(m)
          if (Math.abs(fm) < 1e-9 * Math.max(1, Math.abs(goal))) {
            x = m
            ok = true
            break
          }
          if (flo * fm < 0) hi = m
          else {
            lo = m
            flo = fm
          }
          x = m
        }
      }
    }
    f(x)
    const value = valueAt(target)
    tr.restore()
    return { ok: ok || (typeof value === "number" && Math.abs(value - goal) < 1e-6 * Math.max(1, Math.abs(goal))), x, value }
  }

     Import and export: CSV / TSV / JSON / HTML, file reading, downloads.
     XLSX and XLS live in the next part.

  function downloadBlob(blob, name) {
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob)
    const a = h("a", { href: url, download: name.replace(/[\\/:*?"<>|]+/g, "_") })
    ui.root.append(a)
    a.click()
