  }
  const baseName = () => (doc?.title || wb.title || "Workbook").replace(/[\\/:*?"<>|]+/g, "_")

  /* ---------- delimited text ---------- */
  function detectDelimiter(text) {
    const lines = text.split(/\r?\n/).slice(0, 20).filter((l) => l.length)
    let best = ","
    let bestScore = -1
    for (const d of [",", ";", "\t", "|"]) {
      const counts = lines.map((l) => {
        let n = 0
        let q = false
        for (const ch of l) {
          if (ch === '"') q = !q
          else if (ch === d && !q) n++
        }
        return n
      })
      const nonzero = counts.filter((n) => n > 0)
      if (!nonzero.length) continue
      const mean = nonzero.reduce((s, x) => s + x, 0) / nonzero.length
      const consistent = counts.filter((n) => n === Math.round(mean)).length / counts.length
      const score = consistent * 10 + Math.min(mean, 50) / 10
      if (score > bestScore) {
        bestScore = score
        best = d
      }
    }
    return best
  }
  function parseDelimited(text, delim = ",") {
    const rows = []
    let row = []
    let cur = ""
    let q = false
    const s = text.replace(/^﻿/, "")
    for (let i = 0; i < s.length; i++) {
      const ch = s[i]
      if (q) {
        if (ch === '"') {
          if (s[i + 1] === '"') {
            cur += '"'
            i++
          } else q = false
        } else cur += ch
        continue
      }
      if (ch === '"' && cur === "") q = true
      else if (ch === delim) {
        row.push(cur)
        cur = ""
      } else if (ch === "\n" || ch === "\r") {
        if (ch === "\r" && s[i + 1] === "\n") i++
        row.push(cur)
        rows.push(row)
        row = []
        cur = ""
      } else cur += ch
    }
    if (cur !== "" || row.length) {
      row.push(cur)
      rows.push(row)
    }
    return rows
  }
  async function readText(file, encoding = "auto") {
    const buf = await file.arrayBuffer()
    if (encoding !== "auto") return new TextDecoder(encoding).decode(buf)
    const bytes = new Uint8Array(buf)
    if (bytes[0] === 0xff && bytes[1] === 0xfe) return new TextDecoder("utf-16le").decode(buf)
    if (bytes[0] === 0xfe && bytes[1] === 0xff) return new TextDecoder("utf-16be").decode(buf)
    try {
      return new TextDecoder("utf-8", { fatal: true }).decode(buf)
    } catch {
      // Arabic Windows exports are usually Windows-1256
      return new TextDecoder("windows-1256").decode(buf)
    }
  }
  /* A workbook JSON from rows of text (one sheet). */
  function rowsToSheetJSON(name, rows, opts = {}) {
    const wb2 = new Workbook()
    const s = wb2.addSheet(name || "Sheet1")
    const d = []
    rows.forEach((row, r) =>
      row.forEach((v, c) => {
        if (v == null || v === "") return
        if (typeof v === "number" || typeof v === "boolean") return d.push([r, c, { v }])
        const p = opts.convert === false ? { v: String(v) } : parseInput(String(v))
        const patch = p.f != null && opts.formulas !== false ? { f: p.f } : p.f != null ? { v: String(v) } : { v: encVal(p.v) }
        if (p.nf) patch.s = { nf: p.nf }
        d.push([r, c, patch])
      })
    )
    applyOps(wb2, [{ t: "cells", s: s.id, d }])
    if (opts.header && rows.length) applyOps(wb2, [{ t: "fmt", s: s.id, items: [{ rects: [[0, 0, 0, Math.max(0, ...rows.map((r) => r.length)) - 1]], p: { b: 1 } }] }])
    // reasonable column widths from content
    const widths = []
    for (const row of rows.slice(0, 500)) row.forEach((v, c) => (widths[c] = Math.max(widths[c] || 0, String(v ?? "").length)))
    widths.forEach((w, c) => w > 10 && s.cols.sizes.set(c, Math.min(400, Math.round(w * 7.5 + 12))))
    if (opts.header) s.freeze = { r: 1, c: 0 }
    return sheetToJSON(s)
  }

  /* ---------- importing ---------- */
  async function importFile(file, where = "newbook", opts = {}) {
    const name = file.name.replace(/\.[^.]+$/, "")
    const ext = (file.name.split(".").pop() || "").toLowerCase()
    let json
    if (ext === "xlsx" || ext === "xlsm" || ext === "xltx") json = await readXlsx(await file.arrayBuffer())
    else if (ext === "xls") json = readXls(await file.arrayBuffer())
    else if (ext === "ods") json = await readOds(await file.arrayBuffer())
    else if (ext === "xlsb" || ext === "numbers") json = await readWithSheetJS(await file.arrayBuffer())
    else if (ext === "json") {
      const text = await readText(file)
      const data = JSON.parse(text)
      if (data && data.v === 1 && Array.isArray(data.sheets)) json = data
      else json = { sheets: [rowsToSheetJSON(name.slice(0, 31), jsonToRows(data), { header: true })] }
    } else {
      const text = await readText(file, opts.encoding || "auto")
      const delim = opts.delim || (ext === "tsv" || ext === "tab" ? "\t" : detectDelimiter(text))
      json = { sheets: [rowsToSheetJSON(name.slice(0, 31), parseDelimited(text, delim), { header: opts.header, convert: opts.convert, formulas: false })] }
    }
    if (!json?.sheets?.length) throw new Error(t("The file has no sheets.", "لا يحتوي الملف على أوراق."))
    if (where === "newbook") return openImported(name, json)
    // add the sheets to this workbook
    const ops = []
    let first = null
    let nextId = Math.max(wb.nextId, ...wb.sheets.map((s) => s.id + 1))
    const renames = new Map()
    for (const s of json.sheets) {
      const nm = wb.uniqueSheetName(String(s.name || "Sheet").slice(0, 31))
      if (nm !== s.name) renames.set(s.name, nm)
      const id = nextId++
      first = first ?? id
      ops.push({ t: "addSheet", at: wb.sheets.length, sheet: { ...s, id, name: nm, tables: (s.tables || []).map((tb) => ({ ...tb, name: uniqueTableName(tb.name) })) } })
    }
    if (where === "replace" && json.sheets.length === 1) {
      const s = json.sheets[0]
      const cur = sh
      ops.length = 0
      ops.push({ t: "clear", s: cur.id, rects: [[0, 0, MAXR - 1, MAXC - 1]], what: "all" })
      const d = (s.cells || []).map(([r, c, v, f, si, extra]) => [r, c, { v: f ? null : v, f: f || null, s: si ? (s.styles || [])[si - 1] : null, ...(extra || {}) }])
      ops.push({ t: "cells", s: cur.id, d })
      doOps(ops, { label: t("Import", "استيراد") })
      return
    }
    if (where === "here" && json.sheets.length) {
      const s = json.sheets[0]
      const d = (s.cells || []).map(([r, c, v, f, si, extra]) => [sel.r + r, sel.c + c, { v: f ? null : v, f: f ? shiftFormula(f, sel.r, sel.c) : null, s: si ? (s.styles || [])[si - 1] : null, ...(extra || {}) }])
      doOps([{ t: "cells", s: sh.id, d }], { label: t("Import", "استيراد") })
      return
    }
    doOps(ops, { label: t("Import", "استيراد") })
    if (json.names?.length) doOps([{ t: "wbmeta", k: "names", v: [...[...wb.names.values()], ...json.names.filter((n) => !wb.names.has(n.name.toUpperCase()))] }])
    activateSheet(first)
    void renames
  }

  /* ---------- exporting ---------- */
  function exportDelimited(delim) {
    const u = sh.usedRange()
    if (!u) return toast(t("This sheet is empty.", "هذه الورقة فارغة."))
    const lines = []
    for (let r = 0; r <= u.r2; r++) {
      const row = []
      for (let c = 0; c <= u.c2; c++) {
        let s = displayOf(sh, r, c)
        if (s.includes(delim) || /["\r\n]/.test(s) || /^\s|\s$/.test(s)) s = '"' + s.replace(/"/g, '""') + '"'
        row.push(s)
      }
      lines.push(row.join(delim))
    }
    downloadBlob(new Blob(["﻿" + lines.join("\r\n")], { type: delim === "\t" ? "text/tab-separated-values" : "text/csv" }), baseName() + " - " + sh.name + (delim === "\t" ? ".tsv" : ".csv"))
  }

  /* ---------- OLE2 compound file ---------- */
  function cfbStreams(bytes) {
    const dv = new DataView(bytes.buffer, bytes.byteOffset, bytes.byteLength)
    const sig = [0xd0, 0xcf, 0x11, 0xe0, 0xa1, 0xb1, 0x1a, 0xe1]
    if (!sig.every((b, i) => bytes[i] === b)) throw new Error(t("This isn't an Excel 97-2003 file.", "هذا ليس ملف Excel 97-2003."))

    const miniSize = 1 << dv.getUint16(32, true)
    const nFat = dv.getUint32(44, true)
    const dirStart = dv.getUint32(48, true)
    const miniCutoff = dv.getUint32(56, true)
    const miniFatStart = dv.getUint32(60, true)
    let difatNext = dv.getUint32(68, true)
    const off = (s) => (s + 1) * secSize
    // the FAT's own sectors: 109 in the header, the rest in a DIFAT chain
    const fatSecs = []
    for (let i = 0; i < 109 && fatSecs.length < nFat; i++) fatSecs.push(dv.getUint32(76 + i * 4, true))
    let guard = 0
    while (difatNext < 0xfffffffa && fatSecs.length < nFat && guard++ < 100000) {
      const o = off(difatNext)
      for (let i = 0; i < secSize / 4 - 1 && fatSecs.length < nFat; i++) fatSecs.push(dv.getUint32(o + i * 4, true))
      difatNext = dv.getUint32(o + secSize - 4, true)
    }
    const fat = new Uint32Array(fatSecs.length * (secSize / 4))
    fatSecs.forEach((s, k) => {
      for (let i = 0; i < secSize / 4; i++) fat[k * (secSize / 4) + i] = off(s) + i * 4 + 4 <= bytes.length ? dv.getUint32(off(s) + i * 4, true) : 0xfffffffe
    })
    const chain = (start, table) => {
      const out = []
      const seen = new Set()
      for (let s = start; s < 0xfffffffa && !seen.has(s) && s < table.length + 1; s = table[s]) {
        seen.add(s)
        out.push(s)
      }
      return out
    }
    const readChain = (start, size) => {
      const secs = chain(start, fat)
      const out = new Uint8Array(secs.length * secSize)
      secs.forEach((s, i) => out.set(bytes.subarray(off(s), Math.min(bytes.length, off(s) + secSize)), i * secSize))
      return size == null ? out : out.subarray(0, size)
    }
    const dir = readChain(dirStart)
    const ddv = new DataView(dir.buffer, dir.byteOffset, dir.byteLength)
    const entries = []
    for (let o = 0; o + 128 <= dir.length; o += 128) {
      const nameLen = ddv.getUint16(o + 64, true)
      let name = ""
      for (let i = 0; i + 2 < nameLen; i += 2) name += String.fromCharCode(ddv.getUint16(o + i, true))
      entries.push({ name, type: dir[o + 66], start: ddv.getUint32(o + 116, true), size: ddv.getUint32(o + 120, true) })
    }
    const root = entries[0]
    let mini = null
    let miniFat = null
    const get = (name) => {
      const e = entries.find((x) => x.type === 2 && x.name.toLowerCase() === name.toLowerCase())
      if (!e) return null
      if (e.size >= miniCutoff) return readChain(e.start, e.size)
      if (!mini) {
        mini = readChain(root.start, root.size)
        const mf = readChain(miniFatStart)
        miniFat = new Uint32Array(mf.buffer.slice(mf.byteOffset, mf.byteOffset + (mf.length & ~3)))
      }
      const out = new Uint8Array(e.size)
      let p = 0
      for (const s of chain(e.start, miniFat)) {
        const n = Math.min(miniSize, e.size - p)
        out.set(mini.subarray(s * miniSize, s * miniSize + n), p)
        p += n
      }
      return out
    }
    return { get, names: entries.map((e) => e.name) }
  }

            const type = A(ce, "office", "value-type")
            const formula = odfFormula(A(ce, "table", "formula"), name)
            const st = A(ce, "table", "style-name") || colStyle[c]
            let v = null
            if (type === "float" || type === "percentage" || type === "currency") v = +A(ce, "office", "value")
            else if (type === "boolean") v = A(ce, "office", "boolean-value") === "true"
            else if (type === "date") {
              const dv2 = A(ce, "office", "date-value") || ""
              const m = /^(-?\d+)-(\d\d)-(\d\d)(?:T(\d\d):(\d\d):(\d\d(?:\.\d+)?))?/.exec(dv2)
              if (m) v = serialFromYMD(+m[1], +m[2], +m[3]) + ((+m[4] || 0) * 3600 + (+m[5] || 0) * 60 + (+m[6] || 0)) / 86400
            } else if (type === "time") v = parseIsoDuration(A(ce, "office", "time-value"))
            else if (type === "string" || (!type && ce.textContent)) {
              const ps = kidsNS(ce, "text", "p")
              v = A(ce, "office", "string-value") ?? (ps.length ? ps.map((p) => p.textContent).join("\n") : ce.textContent)
            }
            const cs = A(ce, "table", "number-columns-spanned")
            const rs = A(ce, "table", "number-rows-spanned")
            if ((+cs > 1 || +rs > 1) && k === 0) sheet.merges.push([rr, c, rr + (+rs || 1) - 1, c + (+cs || 1) - 1])
            const s = sidx(st)
            const ccount = v == null && !formula ? Math.min(crep, s ? 256 : 0) : Math.min(crep, 2000)
            for (let j = 0; j < ccount; j++) sheet.cells.push([rr, c + j, formula ? null : v, formula || 0, s])
            c += crep
          }
        }
        r += rep
        if (r >= MAXR) break
      }
    }
    // named ranges
    for (const nr of deep(content, "table", "named-range")) {
      const addr2 = A(nr, "table", "cell-range-address") || ""
      const f = odfFormula("=[" + addr2.replace(/:/g, ":") + "]", null)
      if (f) out.names.push({ name: A(nr, "table", "name"), ref: "=" + f.replace(/(^|[!:])([A-Z]+)(\d+)/g, "$1$$$2$$$3"), scope: null })
    }
    for (const ne of deep(content, "table", "named-expression")) {
      const f = odfFormula(A(ne, "table", "expression"), null)
      if (f) out.names.push({ name: A(ne, "table", "name"), ref: "=" + f, scope: null })
    }
    if (!out.sheets.length) throw new Error(t("This file has no sheets in it.", "لا يحتوي هذا الملف على أوراق."))
    return out
  }

  /* ======================================================================
     XLSX extras: PivotTables Excel can use, and a Durar part that carries
     what Excel has no place for (macros, slicers, queries, scenarios and the
     full pivot definitions) so a file round-trips without losing them.
     Excel keeps Custom XML parts it doesn't understand when it saves.
     ====================================================================== */
  const DURAR_NS = "urn:durar:sheets:v1"
  const PIVOT_AGG = { sum: "sum", count: "count", avg: "average", max: "max", min: "min", countNums: "countNums", product: "product", stdev: "stdDev", var: "var", distinct: "count" }
  const PIVOT_AGG_IN = { sum: "sum", count: "count", average: "avg", max: "max", min: "min", countNums: "countNums", product: "product", stdDev: "stdev", stdDevp: "stdev", var: "var", varp: "var" }

  /* The pivot's source as rows (header first), its sheet and range; null when it's gone. */
  function pivotSourceInfo(p, s) {
    const prev = sh
    sh = s
    try {
      if (p.table) {
        const tb = wb.table(String(p.table).toUpperCase())
        if (!tb) return null
        const rows = wb.rangeMat(new Ref(tb.sid, tb.r1, tb.c1, tb.r2 - (tb.totals ? 1 : 0), tb.c2)).v
        return { rows, table: tb.name }
      }
      const src = refRows(p.src, s.id)
      if (!src) return null
      return { rows: src.m.v, sheet: src.sheet.name, ref: rectAddr(src.ref.r1, src.ref.c1, src.ref.r2, src.ref.c2) }
    } finally {
      sh = prev
    }
  }

  /* Writes one PivotTable (definition + cache + empty records) for pivot p on sheet s.
     Excel rebuilds the results when it opens the file (refreshOnLoad). Returns false when
     the pivot uses something Excel would read differently; its cells still carry the values. */
  function xlsxPivot(p, s, out) {
    if (!p.out || !p.at) return false
    const uses = [...(p.rows || []), ...(p.cols || []), ...(p.filters || [])]
    if (uses.some((f) => f.group)) return false
    const info = pivotSourceInfo(p, s)
    if (!info || !info.rows?.length) return false
    const head = info.rows[0].map((h0, i) => plainText(h0) || "Column" + (i + 1))
    if (new Set(head.map((x) => x.toLowerCase())).size !== head.length) return false
    const fi = (name) => head.indexOf(name)
    const rowsF = (p.rows || []).map((f) => fi(f.f))
    const colsF = (p.cols || []).map((f) => fi(f.f))
    const pageF = (p.filters || []).map((f) => fi(f.f))
    const valsF = (p.vals || []).filter((v) => fi(v.f) >= 0)
    if ([...rowsF, ...colsF, ...pageF].some((i) => i < 0)) return false
    const recs = info.rows.slice(1).filter((r) => r.some((v) => v != null && v !== ""))
    const axis = new Set([...rowsF, ...colsF, ...pageF])
    // shared items for axis fields, in first-seen order (the order Excel uses)
    const items = new Map()
    for (const i of axis) {
      const seen = new Map()
      for (const r of recs) {
        const v = r[i]
        const key = v == null || v === "" ? "\u0000blank" : typeof v + ":" + String(v)
        if (!seen.has(key)) seen.set(key, v == null || v === "" ? null : v)
      }
      items.set(i, [...seen.values()])
    }
    const cacheFields = head.map((name, i) => {
      if (!items.has(i)) {
        const nums = recs.map((r) => r[i]).filter((v) => typeof v === "number")
        const allNum = nums.length && nums.length === recs.filter((r) => r[i] != null && r[i] !== "").length
        return `<cacheField name="${xesc(name)}" numFmtId="0"><sharedItems${allNum ? ` containsSemiMixedTypes="0" containsString="0" containsNumber="1" minValue="${Math.min(...nums)}" maxValue="${Math.max(...nums)}"` : ""}/></cacheField>`
      }
      const list = items.get(i)
      const vals = list.filter((v) => v != null)
      const allNum = vals.length > 0 && vals.every((v) => typeof v === "number")
      const blank = list.some((v) => v == null)
      const attrs = allNum ? ` containsSemiMixedTypes="0" containsString="0" containsNumber="1"${vals.every(Number.isInteger) ? ' containsInteger="1"' : ""} minValue="${Math.min(...vals)}" maxValue="${Math.max(...vals)}"` : ""
      const xml = list.map((v) => (v == null ? "<m/>" : allNum ? `<n v="${v}"/>` : typeof v === "boolean" && !allNum ? `<s v="${v ? "TRUE" : "FALSE"}"/>` : `<s v="${xesc(plainText(v))}"/>`)).join("")
      return `<cacheField name="${xesc(name)}" numFmtId="0"><sharedItems${attrs}${blank ? ' containsBlank="1"' : ""} count="${list.length}">${xml}</sharedItems></cacheField>`
    })
    const filterOf = new Map((p.filters || []).map((f) => [fi(f.f), f.sel ? new Set(f.sel.map(String)) : null]))
    const pivotFields = head.map((_, i) => {
      const isVal = valsF.some((v) => fi(v.f) === i)
      const ax = rowsF.includes(i) ? "axisRow" : colsF.includes(i) ? "axisCol" : pageF.includes(i) ? "axisPage" : null
      if (!ax) return `<pivotField${isVal ? ' dataField="1"' : ""} showAll="0"/>`
      const sel = filterOf.get(i)
      const list = items.get(i)
      const its = list.map((v, k) => `<item x="${k}"${sel && !sel.has(String(plainText(v ?? ""))) ? ' h="1"' : ""}/>`).join("")
      return `<pivotField axis="${ax}"${isVal ? ' dataField="1"' : ""}${sel ? ' multipleItemSelectionAllowed="1"' : ""} showAll="0"><items count="${list.length + 1}">${its}<item t="default"/></items></pivotField>`
    })
    const n = ++out.pivots
    const cacheId = out.pivots
    const [r1, c1, r2, c2] = p.out
    const colsWithValues = valsF.length > 1 ? [...colsF, -2] : colsF
    const style = /^(light|medium|dark)-(\d+)$/.exec(p.opts?.style || "medium-2")
    const styleName = style ? "PivotStyle" + style[1][0].toUpperCase() + style[1].slice(1) + style[2] : "PivotStyleMedium2"
    const def =
      `<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?>\n<pivotTableDefinition xmlns="${XML_NS}" name="${xesc(p.name || "PivotTable" + n)}" cacheId="${cacheId}" applyNumberFormats="0" applyBorderFormats="0" applyFontFormats="0" applyPatternFormats="0" applyAlignmentFormats="0" applyWidthHeightFormats="1" dataCaption="Values" updatedVersion="6" minRefreshableVersion="3" createdVersion="6" useAutoFormatting="1" itemPrintTitles="1" indent="0" outline="1" outlineData="1" multipleFieldFilters="0"${p.opts?.grandRows === false ? ' rowGrandTotals="0"' : ""}${p.opts?.grandCols === false ? ' colGrandTotals="0"' : ""}>` +
      `<location ref="${rectAddr(r1, c1, r2, c2)}" firstHeaderRow="1" firstDataRow="${Math.max(1, (p.colsHeaderRows || 1))}" firstDataCol="${Math.max(1, rowsF.length)}"${pageF.length ? ` rowPageCount="${pageF.length}" colPageCount="1"` : ""}/>` +
      `<pivotFields count="${head.length}">${pivotFields.join("")}</pivotFields>` +
      (rowsF.length ? `<rowFields count="${rowsF.length}">${rowsF.map((i) => `<field x="${i}"/>`).join("")}</rowFields>` : "") +
      (colsWithValues.length ? `<colFields count="${colsWithValues.length}">${colsWithValues.map((i) => `<field x="${i}"/>`).join("")}</colFields>` : "") +
      (pageF.length ? `<pageFields count="${pageF.length}">${pageF.map((i) => `<pageField fld="${i}" hier="-1"/>`).join("")}</pageFields>` : "") +
      (valsF.length ? `<dataFields count="${valsF.length}">${valsF.map((v) => `<dataField name="${xesc(v.name || (AGGS()[v.agg] || "Sum") + " of " + v.f)}" fld="${fi(v.f)}" subtotal="${PIVOT_AGG[v.agg] || "sum"}" baseField="0" baseItem="0"/>`).join("")}</dataFields>` : "") +
      `<pivotTableStyleInfo name="${styleName}" showRowHeaders="1" showColHeaders="1" showRowStripes="0" showColStripes="0" showLastColumn="1"/></pivotTableDefinition>`
    const source = info.table ? `<worksheetSource name="${xesc(info.table)}"/>` : `<worksheetSource ref="${info.ref}" sheet="${xesc(info.sheet)}"/>`
    const cache = `<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?>\n<pivotCacheDefinition xmlns="${XML_NS}" xmlns:r="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships" r:id="rId1" refreshOnLoad="1" refreshedBy="Durar Sheets" refreshedDate="${Math.floor(Date.now() / 86400000) + 25569}" createdVersion="6" refreshedVersion="6" minRefreshableVersion="3" recordCount="0"><cacheSource type="worksheet">${source}</cacheSource><cacheFields count="${head.length}">${cacheFields.join("")}</cacheFields></pivotCacheDefinition>`
    const records = `<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?>\n<pivotCacheRecords xmlns="${XML_NS}" xmlns:r="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships" count="0"/>`
    const R = "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships/"
    out.files.push(
      { name: `xl/pivotTables/pivotTable${n}.xml`, data: def },
      { name: `xl/pivotTables/_rels/pivotTable${n}.xml.rels`, data: `<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?>\n<Relationships xmlns="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/package/2006/relationships"><Relationship Id="rId1" Type="${R}pivotCacheDefinition" Target="../pivotCache/pivotCacheDefinition${n}.xml"/></Relationships>` },
      { name: `xl/pivotCache/pivotCacheDefinition${n}.xml`, data: cache },
      { name: `xl/pivotCache/_rels/pivotCacheDefinition${n}.xml.rels`, data: `<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?>\n<Relationships xmlns="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/package/2006/relationships"><Relationship Id="rId1" Type="${R}pivotCacheRecords" Target="pivotCacheRecords${n}.xml"/></Relationships>` },
      { name: `xl/pivotCache/pivotCacheRecords${n}.xml`, data: records }
    )
    out.ctypes.push(
      `<Override PartName="/xl/pivotTables/pivotTable${n}.xml" ContentType="application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.pivotTable+xml"/>`,
      `<Override PartName="/xl/pivotCache/pivotCacheDefinition${n}.xml" ContentType="application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.pivotCacheDefinition+xml"/>`,
      `<Override PartName="/xl/pivotCache/pivotCacheRecords${n}.xml" ContentType="application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.pivotCacheRecords+xml"/>`
    )
    out.caches.push({ id: cacheId, target: `pivotCache/pivotCacheDefinition${n}.xml` })
    out.sheetRel(`<Relationship Id="${out.relId()}" Type="${R}pivotTable" Target="../pivotTables/pivotTable${n}.xml"/>`)
    return true
  }

  /* The Durar part: base64 JSON inside one element, so no character in it can upset XML. */
  function durarPart(book) {
    const data = {
      v: 1,
      scripts: book.scripts || [],
      queries: book.queries || [],
      scenarios: book.scenarios || [],
      sheets: book.sheets.map((s) => ({ name: s.name, pivots: s.pivots || [], slicers: s.slicers || [] })),
    }
    const bytes = enc.encode(JSON.stringify(data))
    let bin = ""
    for (let i = 0; i < bytes.length; i += 0x8000) bin += String.fromCharCode.apply(null, bytes.subarray(i, i + 0x8000))
    return `<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?>\n<durar xmlns="${DURAR_NS}">${btoa(bin)}</durar>`
  }
  function durarPartFiles() {
    const guid = "{" + [8, 4, 4, 4, 12].map((n) => Array.from({ length: n }, () => "0123456789ABCDEF"[Math.floor(Math.random() * 16)]).join("")).join("-") + "}"
    return [
      { name: "customXml/itemProps1.xml", data: `<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="no"?>\n<ds:datastoreItem ds:itemID="${guid}" xmlns:ds="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/customXml"><ds:schemaRefs><ds:schemaRef ds:uri="${DURAR_NS}"/></ds:schemaRefs></ds:datastoreItem>` },
      { name: "customXml/_rels/item1.xml.rels", data: `<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?>\n<Relationships xmlns="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/package/2006/relationships"><Relationship Id="rId1" Type="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships/customXmlProps" Target="itemProps1.xml"/></Relationships>` },
    ]
  }

  /* Reading: the Durar part when present; otherwise Excel's own PivotTables become Durar pivots. */
  async function xlsxExtrasIn(z, wbRels, sheetTargets, out) {
    let durar = null
    for (const rel of wbRels.values()) {
      if (!/\/customXml$/.test(rel.type)) continue
      const xml = await z.text(rel.target)
      if (!xml || !xml.includes(DURAR_NS)) continue
      try {
        const root = parseXml(xml).documentElement
        const bin = atob(root.textContent.trim())
        durar = JSON.parse(new TextDecoder().decode(Uint8Array.from(bin, (ch) => ch.charCodeAt(0))))
      } catch {
        durar = null
      }
    }
    if (durar) {
      for (const k of ["scripts", "queries", "scenarios"]) if (Array.isArray(durar[k]) && durar[k].length) out[k] = durar[k]
      for (const ds of durar.sheets || []) {
        const s = out.sheets.find((x) => x.name === ds.name)
        if (!s) continue
        if (ds.pivots?.length) s.pivots = ds.pivots
        if (ds.slicers?.length) s.slicers = ds.slicers
      }
      return
    }
    // an Excel file: its PivotTables
    for (let i = 0; i < sheetTargets.length; i++) {
      const s = out.sheets[i]
      if (!s || !sheetTargets[i]) continue
      const rels = await relsOf(z, sheetTargets[i])
      for (const rel of rels.values()) {
        if (!/\/pivotTable$/.test(rel.type)) continue
        try {
          const p = await excelPivot(z, rel.target, out, s)
          if (p) (s.pivots ||= []).push(p)
        } catch (e) {
          console.warn("Durar Sheets: a PivotTable couldn't be read", e)
        }
      }
    }
  }
  async function excelPivot(z, path, out, s) {
    const def = parseXml(await z.text(path)).documentElement
    const prels = await relsOf(z, path)
    const cacheRel = [...prels.values()].find((r) => /\/pivotCacheDefinition$/.test(r.type))
    if (!cacheRel) return null
    const cache = parseXml(await z.text(cacheRel.target)).documentElement
    const ws = all(cache, "worksheetSource")[0]
    if (!ws) return null
    const names = all(cache, "cacheField").map((f) => f.getAttribute("name"))
    const fieldsOf = (tag) => all(kid(def, tag), tag === "pageFields" ? "pageField" : "field").map((f) => +(f.getAttribute("x") ?? f.getAttribute("fld"))).filter((i) => i >= 0)
    const loc = parseA1(kid(def, "location")?.getAttribute("ref") || "")
    if (!loc) return null
    const pfs = all(kid(def, "pivotFields"), "pivotField")
    const sharedOf = (i) => [...(all(cache, "cacheField")[i]?.getElementsByTagName("sharedItems")[0]?.children || [])].map((x) => (x.localName === "m" ? "" : x.getAttribute("v")))
    const filters = fieldsOf("pageFields").map((i) => {
      const hidden = all(pfs[i], "item").filter((it) => it.getAttribute("h") === "1").map((it) => +it.getAttribute("x"))
      const shared = sharedOf(i)
      return { f: names[i], sel: hidden.length ? shared.filter((_, k) => !hidden.includes(k)) : null }
    })
    const p = {
      id: uid(),
      name: def.getAttribute("name") || "PivotTable",
      rows: fieldsOf("rowFields").map((i) => ({ f: names[i] })),
      cols: fieldsOf("colFields").map((i) => ({ f: names[i] })),
      vals: all(kid(def, "dataFields"), "dataField").map((d) => ({ f: names[+d.getAttribute("fld")], agg: PIVOT_AGG_IN[d.getAttribute("subtotal") || "sum"] || "sum", name: d.getAttribute("name") || undefined })),
      filters,
      calc: [],
      opts: { grandRows: def.getAttribute("rowGrandTotals") !== "0", grandCols: def.getAttribute("colGrandTotals") !== "0", style: "medium-2" },
      at: [loc.r1, loc.c1],
      out: [loc.r1, loc.c1, loc.r2, loc.c2],
    }
    if (ws.getAttribute("name")) p.table = ws.getAttribute("name")
    else p.src = quoteSheet(ws.getAttribute("sheet") || s.name) + "!" + ws.getAttribute("ref")
    return p
  }

  /* ======================================================================
     VBA: macros from .xlsm and .xls files. The VBA source is read out of
     vbaProject.bin (MS-OVBA), translated to JavaScript, and run in the same
     sandbox as Durar macros through a small Excel object model (Range, Cells,
     Worksheets, ActiveCell, Selection, WorksheetFunction, MsgBox …).
     The translator covers the VBA that macros are usually made of; any
     statement it can't translate is listed, and stops the macro if reached.
     ====================================================================== */

  /* ---------- reading vbaProject.bin ---------- */
  // MS-OVBA 2.4.1: chunks of up to 4096 bytes, LZ77 copy tokens whose offset/length split
  // depends on how far into the chunk the decompressor is
  function ovbaDecompress(buf, start = 0) {
    if (buf[start] !== 1) throw new Error("not a compressed VBA container")
    const out = []
    let pos = start + 1
    while (pos + 2 <= buf.length) {
      const header = buf[pos] | (buf[pos + 1] << 8)
      pos += 2
      const end = Math.min(buf.length, pos - 2 + (header & 0x0fff) + 3)
      const base = out.length
      if (!(header & 0x8000)) {
        for (let i = 0; i < 4096 && pos < buf.length; i++) out.push(buf[pos++])
        continue
      }
      while (pos < end) {
        const flags = buf[pos++]
        for (let bit = 0; bit < 8 && pos < end; bit++) {
          if (!(flags & (1 << bit))) {
            out.push(buf[pos++])
            continue
          }
          const token = buf[pos] | (buf[pos + 1] << 8)
          pos += 2
          const d = out.length - base
          let bits = 4
          while (1 << bits < d) bits++
          bits = Math.min(bits, 12)
          const lengthMask = 0xffff >> bits
          const length = (token & lengthMask) + 3
          const offset = (token >> (16 - bits)) + 1
          const from = out.length - offset
          for (let i = 0; i < length; i++) out.push(out[from + i])
        }
      }
    }
    return new Uint8Array(out)
  }
  /* Modules of a VBA project: [{ name, kind: "module" | "document" | "class", code }]. */
  function readVbaProject(cfb) {
    const dirRaw = cfb.get("dir")
    if (!dirRaw) return []
    const dir = ovbaDecompress(dirRaw)
    const u16 = (o) => dir[o] | (dir[o + 1] << 8)
    const u32 = (o) => (dir[o] | (dir[o + 1] << 8) | (dir[o + 2] << 16) | (dir[o + 3] << 24)) >>> 0
    let codepage = 1252
    const modules = []
    let cur = null
    let pos = 0
    const text = (o, n) => {
      try {
        return new TextDecoder("windows-" + codepage).decode(dir.subarray(o, o + n))
      } catch {
        return String.fromCharCode(...dir.subarray(o, o + n))
      }
    }
    while (pos + 6 <= dir.length) {
      const id = u16(pos)
      const size = u32(pos + 2)
      const data = pos + 6
      pos = data + size
      if (id === 0x0009) pos += 2 // PROJECTVERSION: a 4-byte field plus a 2-byte minor version
      if (id === 0x0003) codepage = u16(data)
      else if (id === 0x0019) cur = { name: text(data, size), stream: null, offset: 0, kind: "module" }
      else if (id === 0x001a && cur) cur.stream = text(data, size)
      else if (id === 0x0031 && cur) cur.offset = u32(data)
      else if (id === 0x0022 && cur) cur.kind = "document"
      else if (id === 0x002b && cur) {
        modules.push(cur)
        cur = null
      }
    }
    const out = []
    for (const m of modules) {
      const raw = cfb.get(m.stream || m.name)
      if (!raw) continue
      let code
      try {
        code = new TextDecoder("windows-" + codepage).decode(ovbaDecompress(raw, m.offset))
      } catch {
        continue
      }
      if (/^\s*Attribute VB_Exposed|VB_PredeclaredId = True/m.test(code) && !/^\s*Attribute VB_Base = "0\{/m.test(code) && m.kind === "module") m.kind = "class"
      code = code
        .split(/\r?\n/)
        .filter((l) => !/^\s*Attribute\s+VB_/i.test(l))
        .join("\n")
        .trim()
      // document modules (ThisWorkbook, Sheet1) are often empty
      if (!/\b(Sub|Function)\b/i.test(code)) continue
      out.push({ name: m.name, kind: m.kind, code })
    }
    return out
  }
  function vbaScripts(cfb) {
    try {
      return readVbaProject(cfb).map((m) => ({ id: uid(), name: m.name, lang: "vba", code: m.code + "\n", by: "vba" }))
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn("Durar Sheets: the VBA project couldn't be read", e)
      return []
    }
  }

  /* ---------- VBA → JavaScript ---------- */

      if (o && typeof o["set_" + name] === "function") return o["set_" + name](...args, v)
      return $let($m(o, name, args), v)
    }
    const $aset = (x, args, v) => {
      if (x instanceof VArr) return x.set(args, v)
      if (x instanceof Dictionary) return x.set_item(args[0], v)
      if (x instanceof Rng) return $let(x.item(...args), v)
      throw new Error("Type mismatch: not an array")
    }
    const $each = (x) => {
      if (x == null) throw new Error("Object variable not set")
      if (x[Symbol.iterator]) return x
      throw new Error("For Each needs a range, an array or a collection")
    }
    const $call = (f) => f()
    rt.run = (entry) => {
      try {
        entry()
      } catch (e) {
        if (e instanceof End) return
        throw new Error("Line " + rt.line + ": " + (e && e.message ? e.message : e))
      }
    }
    Object.assign(rt, { $num, $bool, $cat, $add, $div, $idiv, $mod, $cmp, $not, $and, $or, $xor, $like, $arr, $p, $m, $ix, $set, $let, $mset, $aset, $each, $call, $xl: xl, $fn: fn, $err: err, $Collection: Collection, $Dictionary: Dictionary })
    return rt
  }

  /* JavaScript for the sandbox: the runtime, the translated module and the call to one Sub. */
  function vbaProgram(src, entry) {
    const tr = vbaTranslate(src)
    const proc = tr.procs.find((p) => p.name.toLowerCase() === String(entry || "").toLowerCase()) || tr.procs.find((p) => p.kind === "sub" && !p.params)
    if (!proc) return { error: t("This module has no Sub to run.", "لا تحتوي هذه الوحدة على إجراء Sub لتشغيله."), tr }
    const js = `const $rt = (${vbaRuntime.toString()})(workbook, log, ${JSON.stringify(BIFF_PALETTE)})
const { $num, $bool, $cat, $add, $div, $idiv, $mod, $cmp, $not, $and, $or, $xor, $like, $arr, $p, $m, $ix, $set, $let, $mset, $aset, $each, $call, $xl, $fn, $err, $Collection, $Dictionary } = $rt
${tr.js}
$rt.run(() => p_${proc.name.toLowerCase()}())`
    return { js, tr, proc }
  }
  const isVba = (s) => s?.lang === "vba" || /^\s*(Option\s+Explicit|(Public\s+|Private\s+)?(Sub|Function)\s+\w+\s*\()/im.test(s?.code || "")
  async function runVba(script, entry) {
    const prog = vbaProgram(script.code, entry)
    if (prog.error) return { error: prog.error, logs: [], ops: [] }
    const res = await runMacro(prog.js)
    if (res.ops?.length) applyMacroOps(res.ops)
    const msgs = (res.logs || []).filter((l) => l.startsWith("MsgBox: ")).map((l) => l.slice(8))
    if (msgs.length) alertBox(msgs.join("\n\n"))
    return { ...res, problems: prog.tr.problems, proc: prog.proc.name }
  }

  /* ======================================================================
     Storage and collaboration.
     Server mode: workbooks live in ERPNext (DocType "Durar Spreadsheet")
     through the durar_sheets Server Script. Every change is an op batch
     appended with optimistic concurrency (base revision). When someone else
     saved first, local ops are undone, the remote ops applied, and the local
     ops re-applied on top (rebased), so edits merge cell by cell.
     Local mode: without the Server Script, files stay in this browser.
     Pending ops are mirrored to IndexedDB so nothing is lost offline.
     ====================================================================== */
  const SESSION = uid()
  const DOCTYPE = "Durar Spreadsheet"
  let backend = null // "server" | "local"
  let serverInfo = null

  async function api(op, data = {}, opts = {}) {
    let res
    let body
    try {
      res = await fetch("/api/method/" + METHOD, {
        method: "POST",
        credentials: "same-origin",
        keepalive: !!opts.keepalive,
        headers: { Accept: "application/json", "Content-Type": "application/x-www-form-urlencoded; charset=UTF-8", "X-Frappe-CSRF-Token": F.csrf_token || "" },
        body: new URLSearchParams({ op, data: JSON.stringify(data) }),
      })
      body = await res.json().catch(() => ({}))
    } catch {
      throw Object.assign(new Error(t("No connection. Your changes are kept on this device.", "لا يوجد اتصال. تغييراتك محفوظة على هذا الجهاز.")), { status: 0 })
    }
    if (!res.ok || body.exc || body.exc_type) {
      let detail = ""
      try {
        detail = JSON.parse(JSON.parse(body._server_messages || "[]")[0] || "{}").message || ""
      } catch {
        /* no readable message */
      }
      throw Object.assign(new Error(String(detail || body.exception || res.statusText || "Request failed").replace(/<[^>]+>/g, "").slice(0, 300)), { status: res.status, missing: res.status === 404 || /not found|does not exist|DoesNotExistError/i.test(String(body.exc_type || body.exception || detail)) })
    }
    return body.message
  }

  /* ---------- IndexedDB (offline cache, local files, pending ops) ---------- */
  const idb = {
    db: null,
    async open() {
      if (this.db) return this.db
      this.db = await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
        const req = indexedDB.open("durar-sheets", 1)
        req.onupgradeneeded = () => {
          const d = req.result
          if (!d.objectStoreNames.contains("files")) d.createObjectStore("files")
          if (!d.objectStoreNames.contains("pending")) d.createObjectStore("pending")
        }
        req.onsuccess = () => resolve(req.result)
        req.onerror = () => reject(req.error)
      })
      return this.db
    },
    async tx(store, mode, fn) {
      try {
        const db = await this.open()
        return await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
          const tr = db.transaction(store, mode)
          const st = tr.objectStore(store)
          const r = fn(st)
          tr.oncomplete = () => resolve(r?.result)
          tr.onerror = () => reject(tr.error)
          tr.onabort = () => reject(tr.error)
        })
      } catch (e) {
        console.warn("Durar Sheets: browser storage unavailable", e)
        return undefined
      }
    },
    get: (store, key) => idb.tx(store, "readonly", (s) => s.get(key)),
    put: (store, key, val) => idb.tx(store, "readwrite", (s) => s.put(val, key)),
    del: (store, key) => idb.tx(store, "readwrite", (s) => s.delete(key)),
    async all(store, prefix) {
      try {
        const db = await this.open()
        return await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
          const out = []
          const tr = db.transaction(store, "readonly")
          const req = tr.objectStore(store).openCursor()
          req.onsuccess = () => {
            const c = req.result
            if (!c) return resolve(out)
            if (!prefix || String(c.key).startsWith(prefix)) out.push([c.key, c.value])
            c.continue()
          }
          req.onerror = () => reject(req.error)
        })
      } catch {
        return []
      }
    },
  }
  const KEY = (name) => ME + ":" + name

  /* ---------- snapshots: JSON, gzip + base64 when large ---------- */
  async function encodeSnapshot(json) {
    const text = JSON.stringify(json)
    if (text.length < 100000 || typeof CompressionStream === "undefined") return text
    const bytes = await streamBytes(enc.encode(text), new CompressionStream("gzip"))
    let bin = ""
    for (let i = 0; i < bytes.length; i += 0x8000) bin += String.fromCharCode.apply(null, bytes.subarray(i, i + 0x8000))
    return "gz:" + btoa(bin)
  }
  async function decodeSnapshot(s) {
    if (!s) return null
    if (typeof s === "object") return s
    if (s.startsWith("gz:")) {
      const bin = atob(s.slice(3))
      const bytes = new Uint8Array(bin.length)
      for (let i = 0; i < bin.length; i++) bytes[i] = bin.charCodeAt(i)
      return JSON.parse(new TextDecoder().decode(await streamBytes(bytes, new DecompressionStream("gzip"))))
    }
    return JSON.parse(s)
  }

  /* ---------- the sync engine ---------- */
  const sync = {
    pending: [], // [{ ops, inv }]
    inflight: null,
    base: 0,
    snapRev: 0,
    sinceSnapBytes: 0,
    timer: 0,
    pollTimer: 0,
    failures: 0,
    state: "saved", // saved | saving | offline | error | local | readonly
    lastVersionAt: 0,
    others: [],
    lastPresence: "",
    reset() {
      this.pending = []
      this.inflight = null
      this.failures = 0
      clearTimeout(this.timer)
      clearTimeout(this.pollTimer)
    },
    push(ops, inv) {
      if (!doc) return
      this.pending.push({ ops, inv: inv || [] })
      this.sinceSnapBytes += JSON.stringify(ops).length
      this.persist()
      this.setState(doc.local ? "saving" : navigator.onLine === false ? "offline" : "saving")
      if (doc.local) this.saveLocal()
      else this.schedule(700)
    },
    schedule(ms) {
      clearTimeout(this.timer)
      this.timer = setTimeout(() => this.flush(), ms)
    },
    persist: debounce(async function () {
      if (!doc) return
      if (doc.local) return
      await idb.put("pending", KEY(doc.name), { base: sync.base, batches: [...(sync.inflight ? [sync.inflight] : []), ...sync.pending].map((e) => e.ops), at: Date.now(), title: doc.title })
    }, 250),
    setState(s, msg) {
      this.state = s
      renderSaveState(msg)
    },
    async flush(force) {
      if (!doc || destroyed) return
      if (doc.local) return this.saveLocal()
      if (this.inflight || (!this.pending.length && !force)) return
      if (doc.canWrite === false) return
      const batch = this.pending.splice(0)
      const ops = batch.flatMap((e) => e.ops)
      this.inflight = { ops, inv: batch.flatMap((e) => e.inv), batch }
      this.setState("saving")
      try {
        const payload = { name: doc.name, base: this.base, session: SESSION, ops, summary: summarize(ops), presence: presenceInfo() }
        const wantSnap = force || this.base + 1 - this.snapRev >= 40 || this.sinceSnapBytes > 300000
        if (wantSnap) payload.snapshot = await encodeSnapshot(wb.toJSON())
        if (wantSnap && Date.now() - this.lastVersionAt > 30 * 60000) payload.version = "auto"
        const res = await api("push", payload)
        if (res.conflict) {
          // someone saved first: rebase our ops (still in this.inflight) over theirs and retry
          const mine = this.inflight
          this.inflight = null
          this.pending.unshift(...mine.batch)
          if (res.reload) return this.reloadKeeping()
          await this.applyRemote(res.changes || [], res.revision)
          return this.flush(force)
        }
        this.base = res.revision
        if (payload.snapshot) {
          this.snapRev = res.revision
          this.sinceSnapBytes = 0
          if (payload.version) this.lastVersionAt = Date.now()
        }
        doc.revision = res.revision
        this.inflight = null
        this.failures = 0
        if (res.presence) this.setPresence(res.presence)
        this.persist()
        if (this.pending.length) this.schedule(200)
        else {
          this.setState("saved")
          idb.del("pending", KEY(doc.name))
          cacheServerDoc()
        }
      } catch (e) {
        const mine = this.inflight
        this.inflight = null
        if (mine) this.pending.unshift(...mine.batch)
        this.failures++
        if (e.status === 403 || e.status === 401) {
          doc.canWrite = false
          this.setState("readonly", t("You no longer have permission to edit. Your changes are kept on this device.", "لم تعد لديك صلاحية التحرير. تغييراتك محفوظة على هذا الجهاز."))
          updateRibbonState()
          return

    },
    async saveNow(withSnapshot) {
      if (!doc) return
      if (doc.local) {
        await this.saveLocal(true)
        return toast(t("Saved on this device.", "تم الحفظ على هذا الجهاز."))
      }
      await this.flush(withSnapshot)
      if (this.state === "saved") toast(t("All changes saved to ERPNext.", "تم حفظ كل التغييرات في ERPNext."))
    },
    saveLocal: debounce(async function (now) {
      if (!doc?.local) return
      const json = wb.toJSON()
      json.title = doc.title
      const meta = { ...doc.meta, title: doc.title, folder: doc.folder || "", modified: Date.now(), size: JSON.stringify(json).length, template: !!doc.template }

    }, 600),
    /* Undo local ops, apply remote ones, redo local ops transformed. */
    async applyRemote(changes, revision) {
      const fresh = changes.filter((c) => c.rev > this.base)
      if (!fresh.length) {
        if (revision) this.base = Math.max(this.base, revision)
        return
      }
      if (edit.active && !editingFormula()) await commitEdit(null)
      const local = [...(this.inflight ? this.inflight.batch : []), ...this.pending]
      const results = []
      for (let i = local.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) results.push(applyOps(wb, local[i].inv))
      const remoteOps = []
      for (const ch of fresh) {
        for (const op of ch.ops) {
          const before = op.t === "delSheet" ? { ...op, name: wb.sheetName(op.s) } : op.t === "meta" && op.k === "name" ? { ...op, old: op.old || wb.sheetName(op.s) } : op
          results.push(applyOps(wb, [op]))
          remoteOps.push(before)
          for (const e of local) e.ops = e.ops.map((o) => xformOp(o, before, wb)).filter(Boolean)
          for (const stack of [undoStack, redoStack])
            for (const e of stack) {
              e.inv = e.inv.map((o) => xformOp(o, before, wb)).filter(Boolean)
              e.ops = e.ops.map((o) => xformOp(o, before, wb)).filter(Boolean)
            }
        }
        this.base = ch.rev
      }
      for (const e of local) {
        const r = applyOps(wb, e.ops)
        e.inv = r.inverse
        results.push(r)
      }
      if (revision) this.base = Math.max(this.base, revision)
      settleResults(wb, results)
      const names = [...new Set(fresh.map((c) => c.name || c.user).filter(Boolean))]
      afterRemote(results, names)
      void remoteOps
    },
    async pull() {
      if (!doc || doc.local || destroyed || this.inflight || this.pulling) return
      this.pulling = true
      try {
        const res = await api("pull", { name: doc.name, since: this.base, session: SESSION, presence: presenceInfo() })
        if (res.reload) return this.reloadKeeping()
        if (res.changes?.length) await this.applyRemote(res.changes, res.revision)
        if (res.title && res.title !== doc.title) {
          doc.title = res.title

        }
        if (res.can_write === false && doc.canWrite) {

        }
        this.setPresence(res.presence || [])

          if (this.pending.length) this.schedule(100)
        }
      } catch (e) {
        if (e.status === 0) this.setState("offline", e.message)
        else if (e.status === 404 || e.status === 403) {
          toast(t("This workbook was deleted or is no longer shared with you.", "تم حذف هذا المصنف أو لم يعد مشتركًا معك."), { error: true })

        }

    /* The server has trimmed the changes between our base and its revision, so they can't be

    async reloadKeeping() {
      if (!doc || doc.local) return
      const batches = [...(this.inflight ? [this.inflight] : []), ...this.pending].map((e) => e.ops)
      if (batches.length) await idb.put("pending", KEY(doc.name), { base: this.base, batches, at: Date.now(), title: doc.title })
      toast(t("This workbook changed a lot elsewhere. Reloading the latest version…", "تغيّر هذا المصنف كثيرًا في مكان آخر. جارٍ تحميل أحدث نسخة…"))
      return openDoc(doc.name)
    },
    schedulePoll() {

      this.pollTimer = setTimeout(() => this.pull(), ms)
    },
    presence: debounce(function () {
      if (!doc || doc.local) return
      const info = JSON.stringify(presenceInfo())
      if (info === sync.lastPresence) return
      sync.lastPresence = info
      if (sync.others.length) sync.pull()
    }, 700),
    setPresence(list) {
      // A refresh creates a new session; older tabs from this account are still me.
      this.others = list.filter((p) => p.session !== SESSION && p.user !== ME)
      presence = this.others
        .filter((p) => p.info)
        .map((p) => ({ user: p.user, name: p.name || p.user, color: personColor(p.user), sheet: p.info.sheet, sel: (p.info.sel || []).map(([r1, c1, r2, c2]) => ({ r1, c1, r2, c2 })), r: p.info.r, c: p.info.c }))

      invalidate()
    },
  }
  function presenceInfo() {
    if (!sh) return null
    return { sheet: sh.id, sel: sel.ranges.slice(0, 6).map((g) => [g.r1, g.c1, g.r2, g.c2]), r: sel.r, c: sel.c, editing: edit.active }
  }
  const PEOPLE_COLORS = ["#e11d48", "#7c3aed", "#0891b2", "#ea580c", "#16a34a", "#db2777", "#2563eb", "#ca8a04", "#9333ea", "#0d9488"]
  function personColor(user) {
    let h0 = 0
    for (const ch of String(user)) h0 = (h0 * 31 + ch.charCodeAt(0)) >>> 0
    return PEOPLE_COLORS[h0 % PEOPLE_COLORS.length]
  }
  function afterRemote(results, names) {
    if (!wb.byId.has(sh?.id)) sh = wb.sheets[clamp(wb.active, 0, wb.sheets.length - 1)]
    calcGen++
    sh.rows.touch()
    sh.cols.touch()
    renderSheetTabs()
    updateSizer()
    invalidate()
    if (!edit.active) updateFormulaBar()
    updateStats()
    refreshObjects()
    updateContextTabs()
    updateRibbonState()
    sidePanel?.refresh?.()
    if (names.length && results.some((r) => r.changed.size || r.structural)) ui.msg.textContent = t("Updated by ", "حدّثه ") + names.slice(0, 2).join(", ")
    later(() => (ui.msg.textContent = ""), 4000)
  }
  /* A short description of a batch for the activity log. */
  function summarize(ops) {
    const parts = []
    for (const op of ops.slice(0, 20)) {
      const s = op.s != null ? wb.sheetName(op.s) : ""
      const box = (list) => {
        if (!list.length) return ""
        let r1 = Infinity
        let c1 = Infinity
        let r2 = -1
        let c2 = -1
        for (const [r, c] of list) {
          r1 = Math.min(r1, r)
          c1 = Math.min(c1, c)
          r2 = Math.max(r2, r)
          c2 = Math.max(c2, c)
        }
        return rectAddr(r1, c1, r2, c2)
      }
      switch (op.t) {
        case "cells":
          parts.push(t("Edited ", "حرّر ") + s + "!" + box(op.d))
          break
        case "fmt":
          parts.push(t("Formatted ", "نسّق ") + s + "!" + op.items.flatMap((i) => i.rects).slice(0, 2).map((g) => rectAddr(...g)).join(", "))
          break
        case "insR":
        case "insC":
        case "delR":
        case "delC":
          parts.push((op.t[0] === "i" ? t("Inserted ", "أدرج ") : t("Deleted ", "حذف ")) + op.n + (op.t[3] === "R" ? t(" row(s) in ", " صف في ") : t(" column(s) in ", " عمود في ")) + s)
          break
        case "addSheet":
          parts.push(t("Added sheet ", "أضاف الورقة ") + op.sheet.name)
          break
        case "delSheet":
          parts.push(t("Deleted a sheet", "حذف ورقة"))
          break
        case "sort":
          parts.push(t("Sorted ", "فرز ") + s + "!" + rectAddr(...op.rect))
          break
        case "replace":
          parts.push(t("Replaced the workbook", "استبدل المصنف"))
          break
        default:
          parts.push(op.t + (s ? " · " + s : ""))
      }
    }
    return [...new Set(parts)].slice(0, 4).join("; ").slice(0, 280)
  }
  function renderSaveState(msg) {
    if (!ui.saveState) return
    const st = !doc ? "" : doc.canWrite === false ? "readonly" : sync.state
    const labels = {
      saved: [icon("cloud"), t("Saved to ERPNext", "محفوظ في ERPNext")],
      saving: [icon("refresh", "spin"), t("Saving…", "جارٍ الحفظ…")],
      offline: [icon("offline"), t("Offline · saved on this device", "غير متصل · محفوظ على هذا الجهاز")],
      error: [icon("alert"), t("Couldn't save · retrying", "تعذر الحفظ · إعادة المحاولة")],
      local: [icon("save"), t("Saved on this device", "محفوظ على هذا الجهاز")],
      readonly: [icon("eye"), t("View only", "عرض فقط")],
    }
    const [ic, label] = labels[st] || ["", ""]
    ui.saveState.innerHTML = ic + `<span>${esc(label)}</span>`
    ui.saveState.dataset.state = st
    ui.saveState.title = msg || label
  }
  function renderPeople() {
    if (!ui.people) return
    const seen = new Map()
    for (const p of sync.others) if (!seen.has(p.user)) seen.set(p.user, p)
    ui.people.innerHTML = ""
    for (const p of [...seen.values()].slice(0, 6)) {
      const name = p.name || p.user
      const initials = name.split(/\s+/).map((w) => w[0]).slice(0, 2).join("").toUpperCase()
      const b = h("button.ds-avatar", { type: "button", title: name + (p.info?.sheet ? " · " + wb.sheetName(p.info.sheet) + "!" + addr(p.info.r || 0, p.info.c || 0) : ""), style: { background: personColor(p.user) } }, initials)
      b.addEventListener("click", () => {
        if (p.info?.sheet && wb.byId.has(p.info.sheet)) {
          activateSheet(p.info.sheet)
          setSel(p.info.r || 0, p.info.c || 0)
        }

      ui.people.append(b)

    if (seen.size > 6) ui.people.append(h("span.ds-avatar.more", "+" + (seen.size - 6)))
  }

  /* ---------- realtime (Frappe's socket: doc_update after every save) ---------- */
  let rtHandler = null
  function subscribeRealtime() {
    unsubscribeRealtime()
    if (!doc || doc.local) return
    try {
      const sock = F.realtime?.doc_subscribe ? F.realtime : F.socketio
      sock?.doc_subscribe?.(DOCTYPE, doc.name)
      rtHandler = (data) => {
        if (data?.doctype === DOCTYPE && data?.name === doc?.name) later(() => sync.pull(), 150)
      }
      F.realtime?.on?.("doc_update", rtHandler)
    } catch {
      /* polling still works */
    }
  }
  function unsubscribeRealtime() {
    try {
      if (rtHandler) F.realtime?.off?.("doc_update", rtHandler)
      if (doc && !doc.local) (F.realtime?.doc_unsubscribe ? F.realtime : F.socketio)?.doc_unsubscribe?.(DOCTYPE, doc.name)
    } catch {
      /* ignore */
    }
    rtHandler = null
  }

  /* ---------- opening documents ---------- */
  function newWorkbookJSON(title = t("Book1", "مصنف1")) {
    return { v: 1, title, props: { theme: "durar" }, sheets: [{ id: 1, name: t("Sheet1", "ورقة1"), cells: [], rows: { d: DEF_ROW_H }, cols: { d: DEF_COL_W }, freeze: [0, 0] }], names: [] }
  }
  /* The offline copy is a full serialization of the workbook. Write it once things are quiet,
     not after every save, so a large workbook doesn't stall while someone types. */
  let cacheDue = false
  const cacheLater = debounce(() => cacheServerDocNow(), 2500)
  function cacheServerDoc() {
    cacheDue = true
    cacheLater()
  }
  cacheServerDoc.flush = () => cacheDue && cacheLater.flush()
  async function cacheServerDocNow() {
    cacheDue = false
    if (!doc || doc.local) return
    try {
      await idb.put("files", KEY("srv:" + doc.name), { meta: { name: doc.name, title: doc.title, folder: doc.folder, modified: Date.now() }, snapshot: wb.toJSON(), rev: sync.base })
    } catch {
      /* cache is optional */
    }
  }
  /* json is a workbook JSON or an already built Workbook whose values are not calculated yet. */
  function loadWorkbook(json, meta) {
    unsubscribeRealtime()
    sync.reset()
    undoStack.length = 0
    redoStack.length = 0
    views.clear()
    clip = null
    painter = null
    stopAnts()
    findHits = null
    traces = []
    invalidCircles = null
    selectedObject = null
    presence = []
    for (const el of objEls.values()) el.remove()
    objEls.clear()
    wb = json instanceof Workbook ? json : Workbook.fromJSON(json, { calc: false })
    // recalculations, the first full one included, run in slices; the page stays responsive
    wb.calc.async = true
    wb.calc.onProgress = () => updateCalcState()
    wb.calc.onIdle = () => {
      invalidate()
      refreshObjects()
      updateStats()
      if (!edit.active) updateFormulaBar()
      updateCalcState()
      sidePanel?.refresh?.()
    }
    wb.title = meta.title
    doc = meta
    sh = wb.sheets[clamp(wb.active, 0, wb.sheets.length - 1)]
    if (sh.hidden) sh = wb.sheets.find((s) => !s.hidden) || sh
    sel = view().sel
    wb.calc.rebuild(true)
    ui.title.value = doc.title
    ui.title.readOnly = doc.canWrite === false || doc.local === undefined
    ui.root.classList.toggle("readonly", doc.canWrite === false)
    ui.empty.hidden = true
    closeBackstage()
    renderSheetTabs()
    renderTabs()
    renderRibbon()
    updateSizer()
    applyScroll()
    readPalette()
    invalidate()
    refreshObjects()
    updateFormulaBar()
    updateStatusMode()
    updateStats()
    updateCalcState()
    renderSaveState()
    rememberRecent(doc)
    setHash(doc.local ? "" : doc.name)
    focusGrid()
  }
  /* An "open" request sent early (at boot, while "ping" is in flight) and used by openDoc. */
  let prefetch = null
  function prefetchOpen(name) {
    const p = api("open", { name })
    p.catch(() => {})
    prefetch = { name, p }
  }
  function openRequest(name) {
    const hit = prefetch?.name === name ? prefetch.p : null
    prefetch = null
    return hit || api("open", { name })
  }
  async function openDoc(name, opts = {}) {
    showLoading(t("Opening…", "جارٍ الفتح…"))
    try {
      if (String(name).startsWith("local:")) {
        const rec = await idb.get("files", KEY(name))
        if (!rec) throw new Error(t("That file is no longer on this device.", "لم يعد هذا الملف على هذا الجهاز."))
        loadWorkbook(rec.snapshot, { name, title: rec.meta.title, folder: rec.meta.folder || "", local: true, canWrite: true, canShare: false, owner: ME, meta: rec.meta, template: rec.meta.template })
        sync.setState("local")
        return
      }
      const pendP = idb.get("pending", KEY(name))
      const res = await openRequest(name)
      const json = (await decodeSnapshot(res.snapshot)) || newWorkbookJSON(res.title)
      const pend = await pendP
      // rebuild the state the pending ops were made against
      const changes = res.changes || []
      const upTo = pend && pend.base >= res.snapshot_rev ? pend.base : res.revision
      const replay = changes.filter((ch) => ch.rev <= upTo)
      // sort and remove-duplicates order rows by their values, so only they need values first
      const needsValues = replay.some((ch) => ch.ops.some((op) => op.t === "sort" || op.t === "dedupe"))
      const wb2 = Workbook.fromJSON(json, { calc: needsValues })
      for (const ch of replay) applyOps(wb2, ch.ops)
      loadWorkbook(wb2, { name, title: res.title, folder: res.folder || "", owner: res.owner, revision: res.revision, canWrite: !!res.can_write, canShare: !!res.can_share, local: false, template: !!res.is_template, created: res.creation, modified: res.modified })
      sync.base = upTo
      sync.snapRev = res.snapshot_rev || 0
      sync.lastVersionAt = res.last_version ? Date.parse(res.last_version.replace(" ", "T")) || 0 : 0
      if (pend?.batches?.length && res.can_write) {
        // unsaved work from before (offline or a crash): re-apply and send it
        for (const ops of pend.batches) {
          const r = applyOps(wb, ops)
          sync.pending.push({ ops, inv: r.inverse })
        }
        wb.calc.rebuild(true)
        const later2 = changes.filter((c) => c.rev > upTo)
        if (later2.length) await sync.applyRemote(later2, res.revision)
        if (pend.base < (res.snapshot_rev || 0)) toast(t("Unsaved changes from earlier were restored on top of the latest version. Check them.", "تمت استعادة التغييرات غير المحفوظة السابقة فوق أحدث نسخة. راجعها."))
        else toast(t("Unsaved changes from earlier were restored.", "تمت استعادة التغييرات غير المحفوظة السابقة."))
        afterRemote([], [])
        sync.schedule(300)
      } else {
        const rest = changes.filter((c) => c.rev > upTo)
        if (rest.length) await sync.applyRemote(rest, res.revision)
        sync.base = res.revision
      }
      sync.setState(res.can_write ? "saved" : "readonly")
      sync.setPresence(res.presence || [])
      subscribeRealtime()
      sync.schedulePoll()
      cacheServerDoc()
      if (!res.can_write) toast(t("You can view this workbook. Ask its owner for edit access.", "يمكنك عرض هذا المصنف. اطلب من مالكه صلاحية التحرير."))
    } catch (e) {
      // offline: open the cached copy read-write; changes queue until the connection returns
      if (e.status === 0) {
        const rec = await idb.get("files", KEY("srv:" + name))
        if (rec) {
          loadWorkbook(rec.snapshot, { ...rec.meta, name, local: false, canWrite: true, canShare: false })
          sync.base = rec.rev || 0
          const pend = await idb.get("pending", KEY(name))
          if (pend?.batches) for (const ops of pend.batches) sync.pending.push({ ops, inv: applyOps(wb, ops).inverse })
          wb.calc.rebuild(true)
          invalidate()
          sync.setState("offline")
          sync.schedule(5000)
          return
        }
      }
      alertBox(t("The workbook couldn't be opened: ", "تعذر فتح المصنف: ") + e.message)
      if (!doc) openBackstage()
    } finally {
      hideLoading()
    }
  }
  async function createDoc(title, json, opts = {}) {
    json = json || newWorkbookJSON(title)
    json.title = title
    if (backend === "server" && !opts.local) {
      showLoading(t("Creating…", "جارٍ الإنشاء…"))
      try {
        const res = await api("create", { title, folder: opts.folder || "", snapshot: await encodeSnapshot(json), is_template: opts.template ? 1 : 0 })
        hideLoading()
        return openDoc(res.name)
      } catch (e) {
        hideLoading()
        if (e.status !== 0 && !e.missing) return alertBox(t("ERPNext refused to create the workbook: ", "رفض ERPNext إنشاء المصنف: ") + e.message)
        toast(t("ERPNext is unreachable; the workbook is saved on this device for now.", "تعذر الوصول إلى ERPNext؛ المصنف محفوظ على هذا الجهاز حاليًا."))
      }
    }
    const name = "local:" + uid()
    const meta = { name, title, folder: opts.folder || "", created: Date.now(), modified: Date.now(), template: !!opts.template }
    await idb.put("files", KEY(name), { meta, snapshot: json })
    return openDoc(name)
  }
  async function openImported(name, json) {
    // Finish saving the current file before loadWorkbook resets its sync state.
    commitIfEditing()
    if (doc?.local) {
      sync.saveLocal.cancel()
      const snapshot = wb.toJSON()
      snapshot.title = doc.title
      await idb.put("files", KEY(doc.name), { meta: { ...doc.meta, title: doc.title, folder: doc.folder || "", modified: Date.now(), template: !!doc.template }, snapshot })
    } else if (doc) {
      const deadline = Date.now() + 10000
      while (sync.inflight && Date.now() < deadline) await sleep(25)
      if (sync.inflight) throw new Error(t("The current workbook is still saving. Try importing again shortly.", "لا يزال المصنف الحالي قيد الحفظ. حاول الاستيراد بعد قليل."))
      await sync.flush()
      // Offline changes remain recoverable when the old workbook is reopened.
      sync.persist.cancel()
      if (sync.pending.length) await idb.put("pending", KEY(doc.name), { base: sync.base, batches: sync.pending.map((e) => e.ops), at: Date.now(), title: doc.title })
    }
    return createDoc(name, json)
  }

  /* ---------- file list ---------- */
  async function listFiles() {
    const out = []
    if (backend === "server") {
      try {
        const res = await api("list", {})
        for (const f of res.files || []) out.push({ ...f, local: false, modified: Date.parse(String(f.modified).replace(" ", "T")) || 0 })
      } catch (e) {
        if (e.status === 0) {
          for (const [, rec] of await idb.all("files", ME + ":srv:")) out.push({ ...rec.meta, local: false, offline: true })

      }
    }
    for (const [, rec] of await idb.all("files", ME + ":local:")) out.push({ ...rec.meta, local: true })

  async function listFolders() {

  function rememberRecent(d) {

  function setHash(name) {
    try {

      const h0 = new URLSearchParams(url.hash.slice(1))
      if (name) h0.set("durar-sheet", name)
      else h0.delete("durar-sheet")
      const next = h0.toString()
      if (url.hash.slice(1) !== next) history.replaceState(history.state, "", url.pathname + url.search + (next ? "#" + next : ""))

  /* ======================================================================
     Built-in templates, built with the same ops as user edits.

  function tplBook(build) {
    const book = new Workbook()
    const sheets = []
    const api2 = {
      sheet(name) {
        const s = book.addSheet(name)
        sheets.push(s)
        const A = (a1) => {
          const r = parseA1(a1)
          return [r.r1, r.c1, r.r2, r.c2]
        }
        const S = {
          s,
          set(a1, value, style) {
            const [r, c] = A(a1)
            const p = typeof value === "string" ? parseInput(value) : { v: value }
            const patch = p.f != null ? { f: p.f } : { v: encVal(p.v) }
            const st = { ...(p.nf ? { nf: p.nf } : {}), ...(style || {}) }
            if (Object.keys(st).length) patch.s = st
            applyOps(book, [{ t: "cells", s: s.id, d: [[r, c, patch]] }])
            return S
          },
          rows(a1, rows, style) {
            const [r0, c0] = A(a1)
            const d = []
            rows.forEach((row, i) =>
              row.forEach((v, j) => {
                if (v == null) return
                const p = typeof v === "string" ? parseInput(v) : { v }
                const patch = p.f != null ? { f: p.f } : { v: encVal(p.v) }
                const st = { ...(p.nf ? { nf: p.nf } : {}), ...(typeof style === "function" ? style(i, j) : style || {}) }
                if (Object.keys(st).length) patch.s = st
                d.push([r0 + i, c0 + j, patch])
              })
            )
            applyOps(book, [{ t: "cells", s: s.id, d }])
            return S
          },
          fmt(a1, p) {
            applyOps(book, [{ t: "fmt", s: s.id, items: [{ rects: [A(a1)], p }] }])
            return S
          },
          widths(list) {
            list.forEach((w, c) => w && s.cols.sizes.set(c, w))
            s.cols.touch()
            return S
          },
          height(r, hpx) {
            s.rows.sizes.set(r, hpx)
            s.rows.touch()
            return S
          },
          merge(a1) {
            applyOps(book, [{ t: "merge", s: s.id, add: [A(a1)], del: [] }])
            return S
          },
          table(a1, name, style = "medium-2", totals = false) {
            const [r1, c1, r2, c2] = A(a1)
            const columns = []
            for (let c = c1; c <= c2; c++) columns.push(plainText(s.get(r1, c)?.v) || "Column" + (c - c1 + 1))
            s.tables.push({ name, r1, c1, r2, c2, header: true, totals, columns, style, banded: true, filter: true, fcols: {} })
            book.indexTables()
            return S
          },
          cf(rule) {
            s.cf.push({ id: uid(), ...rule, ranges: rule.ranges.map((x) => A(x)) })
            return S
          },
          dv(rule) {
            s.dv.push({ id: uid(), blank: true, dropdown: true, prompt: {}, error: { style: "stop" }, ...rule, ranges: rule.ranges.map((x) => A(x)) })
            return S
          },
          chart(o) {
            s.charts.push({ id: uid(), w: 460, h: 280, ...o })
            return S
          },
          freeze(r, c) {
            s.freeze = { r, c }
            return S
          },
          grid(on) {
            s.grid = on
            return S
          },
        }
        return S
      },
      name(name, ref) {
        book.setName({ name, ref })
      },
    }
    build(api2)
    book.calc.rebuild(true)
    return book.toJSON()
  }
