  /* ======================================================================
     Boot: build the interface, wire events, find the storage backend and
     open the requested (or most recent) workbook.
     ====================================================================== */
  const cleanups = []
  function on(target, type, fn, opts) {
    target.addEventListener(type, fn, opts)
    cleanups.push(() => target.removeEventListener(type, fn, opts))
  }
  function wire() {
    // Frappe's document shortcuts see the shadow host instead of the focused
    // textarea and can redirect printable keys to the Desk search bar. Keep
    // keyboard events inside the block, after its own handlers have run. Do
    // not preventDefault: native text input, IME and clipboard still need it.
    for (const type of ["keydown", "keypress", "keyup"]) {
      on(ui.root, type, (e) => e.stopPropagation())
    }
    on(ui.scroller, "scroll", onScroll, { passive: true })
    on(canvas, "pointerdown", onPointerDown)
    on(canvas, "pointermove", onPointerMove)
    on(window, "pointerup", onPointerUp)
    on(window, "pointercancel", onPointerUp)
    on(canvas, "pointerleave", () => !drag && hideHover())
    on(ui.stage, "contextmenu", (e) => {
      if (e.target === canvas) onContextMenu(e)
    })
    on(
      ui.scroller,
      "wheel",
      (e) => {
        if (!sh) return
        if (!(e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey)) {
          // split panes: the top pane scrolls rows and the left pane scrolls columns on their own;
          // everything else is the native scroller, which drives the bottom-right pane
          if (!G?.split) return
          const b = ui.stage.getBoundingClientRect()
          const x = (e.clientX - b.left) / G.z
          const y = (e.clientY - b.top) / G.z
          const k = e.deltaMode === 1 ? 16 : e.deltaMode === 2 ? G.vh : 1
          const dy = (e.shiftKey ? 0 : e.deltaY) * k
          const dx = (e.shiftKey ? e.deltaY : e.deltaX) * k
          const v = view()
          let used = false
          if (y < G.top0 + G.FH && dy) {
            v.sy0 = clamp((v.sy0 || 0) + dy, 0, sh.rows.pos(MAXR))
            used = true
          }
          if (x < G.left0 + G.FW && dx) {
            v.sx0 = clamp((v.sx0 || 0) + dx, 0, sh.cols.pos(MAXC))
            used = true
          }
          if (used) {
            e.preventDefault()
            invalidate()
          }
          return
        }
        e.preventDefault()
        setZoom(zoomOf() * (e.deltaY < 0 ? 1.1 : 1 / 1.1))
      },
      { passive: false }
    )
    // pinch zoom on touch screens
    let pinch = null
    on(
      ui.scroller,
      "touchstart",
      (e) => {
        if (e.touches.length === 2) pinch = { d: Math.hypot(e.touches[0].clientX - e.touches[1].clientX, e.touches[0].clientY - e.touches[1].clientY), z: zoomOf() }
      },
      { passive: true }
    )
    on(
      ui.scroller,
      "touchmove",
      (e) => {
        if (!pinch || e.touches.length !== 2) return
        const d = Math.hypot(e.touches[0].clientX - e.touches[1].clientX, e.touches[0].clientY - e.touches[1].clientY)
        setZoom(pinch.z * (d / pinch.d))
      },
      { passive: true }
    )
    on(ui.scroller, "touchend", () => (pinch = null), { passive: true })

    // the in-cell editor doubles as the grid's keyboard sink
    on(ui.editor, "keydown", (e) => {
      if (e.isComposing) return
      if (!edit.active) {
        const ctrl = e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey
        const key = e.key.toLowerCase()
        if (ctrl && !e.altKey && !e.shiftKey && (key === "c" || key === "x")) {
          // fill the internal clipboard now, and give the browser a selection so it fires
          // the copy event that puts text and HTML on the system clipboard
          setClip(key === "x" && !readOnlyNow())
          ui.editor.value = " "
          ui.editor.select()
          later(() => !edit.active && (ui.editor.value = ""), 60)
          return
        }
        if (ctrl && !e.altKey && !e.shiftKey && key === "v") {
          if (readOnlyNow()) return e.preventDefault()
          // the paste event normally arrives; if the browser withholds it, paste our own clipboard
          clearTimeout(pasteFallback)
          pasteFallback = setTimeout(() => {
            pasteFallback = 0
            if (clip) pasteInternal(clip, lastRange())
          }, 150)
          return
        }
        if (shortcut(e) || gridKey(e)) {
          e.preventDefault()
          return
        }
        if (e.key === "Enter" && (e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey) && !readOnlyNow()) return
        return
      }
      editorKey(e)
    })
    on(ui.editor, "input", (e) => {
      if (!edit.active) {
        const text = ui.editor.value
        ui.editor.value = ""
        if (!text || e.isComposing) return
        if (readOnlyNow()) return
        startEdit({ mode: "enter", text })
        const el = inputEl()
        el.setSelectionRange(el.value.length, el.value.length)
        syncHighlight()
        return
      }
      syncHighlight()
    })
    on(ui.editor, "compositionstart", () => {
      if (!edit.active && !readOnlyNow()) startEdit({ mode: "enter", text: "" })
    })
    on(ui.editor, "compositionend", () => syncHighlight())
    on(ui.editor, "click", () => edit.active && setMode("edit"))
    on(ui.editor, "keyup", () => edit.active && (updateHint(), updateAuto()))
    on(ui.editor, "copy", (e) => onCopy(e, false))
    on(ui.editor, "cut", (e) => {
      if (readOnlyNow()) return onCopy(e, false)
      onCopy(e, true)
    })
    on(ui.editor, "paste", (e) => {
      if (edit.active) return
      if (readOnlyNow()) return e.preventDefault()
      onPaste(e)
    })
    on(ui.editor, "scroll", () => (ui.editHL.scrollTop = ui.editor.scrollTop))
    on(ui.rich, "keydown", (e) => editorKey(e))
    on(ui.rich, "input", () => placeEditor())

    // formula bar
    on(ui.fx, "focus", () => {
      if (!sh) return
      if (!edit.active) {
        if (readOnlyNow() || (sh.protect && isLocked(sel.r, sel.c))) return
        const keepCaret = ui.fx.selectionStart
        startEdit({ mode: "edit", from: "bar" })
        ui.fx.setSelectionRange(keepCaret, keepCaret)
      } else if (edit.from !== "bar") {
        edit.from = "bar"
        setMode("edit")
      }
    })
    on(ui.fx, "input", () => {
      if (!edit.active) startEdit({ mode: "edit", from: "bar", text: ui.fx.value })
      syncHighlight()
      autoGrowFx()
    })
    on(ui.fx, "keydown", (e) => {
      if (!edit.active) return
      e.stopPropagation()
      editorKey(e)
    })
    on(ui.fx, "keyup", () => edit.active && (updateHint(), updateAuto()))
    on(ui.fx, "scroll", () => (ui.fxHL.scrollTop = ui.fx.scrollTop))
    on(ui.$(".ds-fxcancel"), "click", () => cancelEdit())
    on(ui.$(".ds-fxok"), "click", () => commitEdit(null))
    on(ui.$(".ds-fxexpand"), "click", () => {
      ui.root.classList.toggle("fx-tall")
      autoGrowFx()
      requestAnimationFrame(() => (updateSizer(), invalidate()))
    })

    // name box
    on(ui.namebox, "focus", () => ui.namebox.select())
    on(ui.namebox, "keydown", async (e) => {
      e.stopPropagation()
      if (e.key === "Escape") {
        updateFormulaBar()
        focusGrid()
      }
      if (e.key !== "Enter") return
      e.preventDefault()
      const v = ui.namebox.value.trim()
      if (goToRef(v)) return focusGrid()
      if (validName(v) && !readOnlyNow()) {
        // typing a new name defines it for the selection, as in Excel
        const g = lastRange()
        setNames([...namesList(), { name: v, ref: "=" + quoteSheet(sh.name) + "!" + rangeText(g).replace(/([A-Z]+)(\d+)/g, "$$$1$$$2"), scope: null }], t("Define name", "تعريف اسم"))
        toast(t(`Name "${v}" now refers to ${rangeText(g)}.`, `يشير الاسم "${v}" الآن إلى ${rangeText(g)}.`))
        return focusGrid()
      }
      toast(t("Reference isn't valid.", "المرجع غير صالح."))
    })
    on(ui.$(".ds-namedrop"), "click", (e) =>
      menu(
        wb ? [...[...wb.names.values()].map((n) => ({ label: n.name, title: n.ref, run: () => goToRef(n.name) })), ...[...wb.tableMap.values()].map((tb) => ({ label: tb.name, icon: "table", run: () => goToRef(tb.name) })), "-", { label: t("Name manager…", "إدارة الأسماء…"), run: () => runCmd("nameManager") }] : [],
        e.currentTarget
      )
    )

    // title, buttons, tabs, status
    on(ui.title, "change", () => renameDoc(ui.title.value))
    on(ui.title, "keydown", (e) => {
      e.stopPropagation()
      if (e.key === "Enter") ui.title.blur()
      if (e.key === "Escape") {
        ui.title.value = doc?.title || ""
        ui.title.blur()
      }
    })
    on(ui.root, "click", (e) => {
      const b = e.target.closest("[data-cmd]")
      if (!b || !ui.root.contains(b) || b.closest(".ds-ribbon,.ds-qat")) return
      runCmd(b.dataset.cmd)
    })
    on(ui.$(".ds-allsheets"), "click", (e) => wb && allSheetsMenu(e.currentTarget))
    on(ui.zoomRange, "input", () => setZoom(+ui.zoomRange.value / 100))
    on(ui.stats, "contextmenu", statsMenu)
    on(ui.stats, "click", (e) => statsMenu(e))
    on(ui.auto, "mousedown", (e) => {
      const li = e.target.closest("li")
      if (!li) return
      e.preventDefault()
      acceptAuto(+li.dataset.i)
    })
    on(ui.dvbtn, "click", () => openCellDropdown())
    on(ui.side.querySelector(".ds-sideclose"), "click", () => closePanel())

    // popups close on outside clicks
    on(
      document,
      "pointerdown",
      (e) => {
        if (!popup) return
        const path = e.composedPath()
        if (path.includes(popup.el)) return
        if (path.some((n) => n.classList?.contains("ds-split") || n.classList?.contains("menu"))) {
          // the toggling button reopens its own menu
        }
        closePopups()
      },
      true
    )
    // shortcuts when focus is on a ribbon button or similar
    on(ui.root, "keydown", (e) => {
      const tag = e.target.nodeName
      if (e.target === ui.editor || e.target === ui.fx || tag === "INPUT" || tag === "TEXTAREA" || tag === "SELECT" || e.target.isContentEditable) return
      if (dialogs.length || !wb) return
      if (e.key === "Escape") {
        closePopups()
        focusGrid()
        return
      }
      if ((e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey || e.key.startsWith("F")) && shortcut(e)) e.preventDefault()
    })
    // layout and theme
    const ro = new ResizeObserver(() => {
      ui.root.classList.toggle("ds-narrow", ui.root.clientWidth < 760)
      ui.root.classList.toggle("ds-tiny", ui.root.clientWidth < 480)
      fitRibbon()
      if (sh) {
        updateSizer()
        invalidate()
      }
    })
    ro.observe(ui.root)
    ro.observe(ui.scroller)
    cleanups.push(() => ro.disconnect())
    const mo = new MutationObserver(() => applyTheme())
    mo.observe(document.documentElement, { attributes: true, attributeFilter: ["data-theme", "dir"] })
    cleanups.push(() => mo.disconnect())
    const mq = matchMedia("(prefers-color-scheme: dark)")
    on(mq, "change", applyTheme)
    on(window, "resize", () => invalidate())
    on(document, "visibilitychange", () => {
      if (document.hidden) sync.flush()
      else if (doc && !doc.local) sync.pull()
    })
    on(window, "online", () => {
      if (doc && !doc.local) {
        sync.flush()
        sync.pull()
      }
    })
    on(window, "beforeunload", (e) => {
      if (doc && !doc.local && (sync.pending.length || sync.inflight)) {
        sync.flush()
        e.preventDefault()
        e.returnValue = ""
      }
      if (doc?.local) sync.saveLocal.flush?.()
    })
    on(window, "hashchange", () => {
      const name = new URLSearchParams(location.hash.slice(1)).get("durar-sheet")
      if (name && name !== doc?.name) openDoc(name)
    })
    on(document, "fullscreenchange", () => {
      if (!document.fullscreenElement) ui.root.classList.remove("ds-full")
      requestAnimationFrame(() => (updateSizer(), invalidate()))
    })
  }
  function autoGrowFx() {
    const tall = ui.root.classList.contains("fx-tall")
    ui.fx.style.height = "auto"
    const hgt = tall ? Math.min(220, Math.max(70, ui.fx.scrollHeight)) : 28
    ui.fx.style.height = hgt + "px"
    ui.fxHL.style.height = hgt + "px"
  }

  function destroy() {
    destroyed = true
    try {
      if (doc && !doc.local) {
        sync.persist.flush?.()
        if (sync.pending.length) sync.flush()
      }
      if (doc?.local) sync.saveLocal.flush?.()
      if (doc && !doc.local) cacheServerDoc.flush()
    } catch {
      /* best effort */
    }
    unsubscribeRealtime()
    clearTimeout(sync.timer)
    clearTimeout(sync.pollTimer)
    stopAnts()
    for (const id of timers) clearTimeout(id)
    for (const fn of cleanups.splice(0)) fn()
    if (rafId) cancelAnimationFrame(rafId)
    closePopups()
    ui.root?.remove()
  }
  host.__durarSheetsDestroy = destroy

  /* Hooks for the browser tests only (the harness sets window.__durarSheetsTest). */
  if (window.__durarSheetsTest) {
    window.__ds = {
      cellPoint(a1) {
        const r = parseA1(a1)
        if (!G) G = geometry()
        return { x: (xOf(r.c1) + sh.cols.size(r.c1) / 2) * G.z, y: (yOf(r.r1) + sh.rows.size(r.r1) / 2) * G.z }
      },
      value(a1, sheet) {
        const r = parseA1(a1)
        const s = sheet ? wb.sheetByName(sheet) : sh
        const v = wb.getValue(s.id, r.r1, r.c1)
        return v instanceof XErr ? v.code : v
      },
      text: (a1) => {
        const r = parseA1(a1)
        return displayOf(sh, r.r1, r.c1)
      },
      formula: (a1, sheet) => {
        const r = parseA1(a1)
        return (sheet ? wb.sheetByName(sheet) : sh).get(r.r1, r.c1)?.f ?? null
      },
      style: (a1, sheet) => {
        const r = parseA1(a1)
        return { ...(sheet ? wb.sheetByName(sheet) : sh).styleAt(r.r1, r.c1) }
      },
      state: () => ({ sheet: sh?.name, sheets: wb?.sheets.map((s) => s.name), sel: JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(sel)), mode, doc: doc && { ...doc, meta: undefined }, sync: { base: sync.base, pending: sync.pending.length, state: sync.state }, undo: undoStack.length, charts: sh?.charts.length, pivots: sh?.pivots.length, tables: sh?.tables.map((x) => x.name), cf: sh?.cf.length, dv: sh?.dv.length, merges: sh?.merges.length, freeze: sh?.freeze, zoom: sh && zoomOf(), filterHidden: sh ? [...sh.rows.fhidden] : [], split: sh ? view().split || null : null, calcJob: !!wb?.calc.job, geom: G && { left0: G.left0, top0: G.top0, FW: G.FW, FH: G.FH, sx: G.sx, sy: G.sy, sx0: G.sx0, sy0: G.sy0, z: G.z } }),
      run: (id, ...a) => runCmd(id, ...a),
      ops: (ops) => doOps(ops),
      select: (a1) => {
        const r = parseA1(a1)
        setRange({ r1: r.r1, c1: r.c1, r2: r.r2, c2: r.c2 })
      },
      sheetId: () => sh.id,
      pull: () => sync.pull(),
      flush: () => sync.flush(),
      json: () => wb.toJSON(),
      xlsx: async (opts = {}) => {
        const blob = await writeXlsx(wb, opts)
        const buf = await blob.arrayBuffer()
        const json = await readXlsx(buf)
        let b64 = null
        if (opts.bytes) {
          const bytes = new Uint8Array(buf)
          let bin = ""
          for (let i = 0; i < bytes.length; i += 0x8000) bin += String.fromCharCode.apply(null, bytes.subarray(i, i + 0x8000))
          b64 = btoa(bin)
        }
        return { size: blob.size, json, b64 }
      },
      print: (what) => buildPrintDoc(what || "sheet").count,
      vba: async (code, entry) => {
        const r = await runVba({ code, lang: "vba" }, entry)
        return { logs: r.logs, error: r.error, problems: r.problems, ops: r.ops?.length || 0 }
      },
      scripts: () => wb.scripts.map((s) => ({ name: s.name, lang: s.lang || "js", code: s.code })),
      readLegacy: async (name, b64) => {
        const bytes = Uint8Array.from(atob(b64), (ch) => ch.charCodeAt(0))
        return /\.xls$/i.test(name) ? readXls(bytes.buffer) : readOds(bytes.buffer)
      },
      importBytes: async (name, b64) => {
        const bytes = Uint8Array.from(atob(b64), (ch) => ch.charCodeAt(0))
        await importFile(new File([bytes], name))
        return doc?.title
      },
      traceFinish: () => {
        const c = wb.calc
        const f = c.finish.bind(c)
        window.__fin = []
        c.finish = () => {
          if (c.job) window.__fin.push(new Error().stack.split("\n").slice(1, 9).join(" | "))
          f()
        }
        const st = c.start.bind(c)
        c.start = (...a) => {
          st(...a)
          window.__fin.push("start -> job " + !!c.job + " progress " + JSON.stringify(c.job?.progress))
        }
      },
      pdf: async (what) => {
        const b = await exportPdf(what || "sheet")
        if (!b) return null
        const bytes = new Uint8Array(await b.arrayBuffer())
        let text = ""
        for (let i = 0; i < bytes.length; i += 0x8000) text += String.fromCharCode.apply(null, bytes.subarray(i, i + 0x8000))
        return text
      },
    }
  }

  async function boot() {
    applyLocale()
    buildShell()
    defineCommands()
    wire()
    applyTheme()
    renderTabs()
    renderQat()
    renderSaveState()
    showLoading(t("Loading Durar Sheets…", "جارٍ تحميل جداول درر…"))
    // the workbook that will most likely open: request it now instead of after "ping" answers
    const fromHash = new URLSearchParams(location.hash.slice(1)).get("durar-sheet")
    const recent = readPref("recent", [])
    const guess = fromHash || (readPref("reopenLast", true) && recent[0] && !recent[0].local ? recent[0].name : null)
    if (guess && !String(guess).startsWith("local:")) prefetchOpen(guess)
    try {
      serverInfo = await api("ping")
      backend = "server"
    } catch (e) {
      backend = "local"
      if (e.status === 0) {
        // offline: server files are still available from the cache
        backend = (await idb.all("files", ME + ":srv:")).length ? "server" : "local"
      }
    }
    hideLoading()
    if (fromHash) return openDoc(fromHash)
    const last = recent.find((r) => (backend === "server" ? true : r.local))
    if (last && readPref("reopenLast", true)) {
      await openDoc(last.name)
      if (doc) return
    }
    openBackstage("home")
  }
  boot().catch((e) => {
    console.error("Durar Sheets failed to start", e)
    host.append(Object.assign(document.createElement("p"), { textContent: "Durar Sheets could not start: " + (e.message || e) }))
  })
})()
